53011.title: Animal Welfare Club
53011.text: Recently, the Animal Welfare Club was recently found by Psychic, who was newly enrolled. She has a dog that is always by her side called Bruno, but she insists that it’s a Servant. The active members of the club include Pandaria and Chevalir, who already had pets before Psychic arrived. Their activities used to be small-scale. But after Psychic joined them, the club gradually expanded. I'm no Animal Protection Expert, but Psychic's frequent appearance near the labs seems very suspicious... Are they experimenting on those pets? I need to investigate some more...

53011.title: Eavesdropping
53011.text:
"Are you sure anyone other than Bruno wants these cookies?" "Of course! Even if they're not effective enough, they will at least be yummy for the servants on campus. As for your Pandy!"
……
"Let's feed the small robot we met last time, and maybe it'll evolve this time!" "Chevalir, even with only one eye you shouldn't mistake my gems for cookies..."
……
"Psychic, why are the servants so rare and weak right now? According to your research, they are native to this land ..." "This might be caused by a leak in spacial energy, but I'm not 100% sure what happened. The only thing we can do is to nurse them back to health."

53011.title: Servant Expert
53011.text: Psychic is definitely an expert on animals. Her research results can be seen along with the animals gradually showing up on campus. She called these animal "Servants", because their powers are not befitting of their normal appearance. You just need to look after them with care, and they will become your best helpers in keeping the peace on campus. There are two different types of animal treats, one yellow and the other is blue. These treats depend on the different ingredients added according to the servants' characteristics. Although the cookies are food for servants, the human stomach can digest them. I never tried them myself, but rumors has it that the blue ones tastes better, and that they’re the ones Psychic uses to feed Bruno. She was even seen eating those cookies herself...

53012.title: Metamorphosis
53012.text: It's been a long time since I last saw Iron Fist, but she sure seems to have changed a lot. There’s so much about her that’s…different. Whether it’s the glittering cute antennas, the eye-catching giant robotic arm, or the smile on her face, I see signs that this once timid girl has been reborn from the inside out.

53012.title: Prosthetic Arm
53012.text: Iron Fist's new prosthetic arm is way too large in comparison with her small figure, and keeps on knocking into people (mostly Senpai), lifting tables when everyone is eating, or causing her to lose her balance when flying in the sky. Despite all the troubles it caused her, she refuses to let go of it because of the significance it holds: with the arm, Iron Fist had protected her friends, defeat enemies that once seemed invincible, and overcome her fears.

53012.title: A Moth...?
53012.text: "Of all the options, why a moth?" I asked her one day. "I don't know, " she blushed, "But everyone was in danger, and I had to do something, that's when the change happened. In retrospect, I probably should have chosen to become something more powerful, but I don't mind as long as I get to help." She smiled, and her antennae bobbed up and down.

53013.title: Bizarre Clothing
53013.text: Although Trinity’s outfit isn’t too strange for Yume Academy, if someone were to stare in the slightest or even ask why she was dressed like that, she would always respond “my outfit is pretty normal.” But with her blushing face and panicked look, we can tell that she struggles to even convince herself. This aroused even more interest from students who started speculating the reason behind it… Don’t ask anymore strange questions though, last I saw, her eyes were welled up with tears, so let’s just let it go.

53013.title: Lethargy
53013.text: Trinity’s battle suit's Optical Camouflage allows her to appear and disappear at will, while her sniper rifle allows her to quietly finish off enemies from afar. There's no doubt about Trinity's fighting ability, but... after a battle, she's always worn out, and in extreme cases, she can even doze off on the spot. On a usual basis, she always tries to get as much sleep as possible. According to Raphael's diagnosis, this seems to be a symptom caused by lack of mana, and the reason for it is probably her battle suit and her rifle. But Trinity was not surprised after hearing this, so she must have realized long ago.

53013.title: Tenacity
53013.text: During a crisis, Trinity was saved by Sivney, in which Sivney bestowed her with a battle suit and rifle. From that day forth, she vowed to walk in Sivney’s footsteps. But after many years of search, she could still not find any clues to Sivney. Only when she walks into Sivney's Lab in the Academy does she feel nostalgic.

53014.title: The Wind to End War
53014.text: Skye, the girl who proclaims herself as “the warrior of the winds”, has always had a troubled life at Yume Academy. For some reason she is always the first to arrive at the scene of disputes and eager to “settle” it. By the time the disciplinary committee members arrive, both sides of the dispute would have fallen unconscious from lack of oxygen, where only the dust stirred from the whirlwind is seen drifting back down. At first, the students blamed her behavior on her impulsive and naughty nature, but after seeing her persistence on settling the issues her own way after being repeatedly being reprimanded by the Discipline Committee, they finally seem to understand that perhaps something that had happened had caused Skye’s peculiar behavior.

53014.title: Message of the Wind
53014.text:
The wind drifts from thousands of miles away, spreading its message from afar to strange lands. However, few people are able to decipher the message of the wind, and even a sharp Ithil can only catch a singleword out of it. However, this seems to be literally "as natural as breathing" for Skye.

Skye’s specially modified body constantly absorbs the air around it, turning it into a weapon and at the same time, deciphering its message: grass, trees, flowers, earth, food, wild beasts, humans, magic, fire, smoke, and chaos. Among these unique "smells", fear and dispute are the most tormenting. That is the reason why Skye is obsessed with settling disputes, in a way, not only due to her own will, but also the instinct of her body.

53014.title: Blood Wind
53014.text:
At the time, Sivney’s research on magic was just about to enter a new phase, and urgently needed to her theory to be further tested by means of “human experimentation”. For Sivney, the question was not a matter of whether to proceed with the human experimentation but rather of who to use for her experiment.

Eventually, she had found her answer.

When Sivney met Skye on her journey, Skye was already dying, as her body had been worn out by the long and harsh battles. Sivney immediately began her rescue mission (regardless of whether it was due to kindness or the excitement of her technological experimentation).

As a result, Skye was reborn. However, the initial injury was too severe that the body could not be recovered to its original state. With Skye’s permission, Sivney further transformed Skye’s body, enabling her to analyze air and extract the necessary component, although the consequence of the experimentation is yet unknown.

Thus, the wind has become like blood that flows through the body, and is as free and unrestrained as she is. The wind that sustains life, is now one of the corners of the mysterious curtain of magic that Sivney has lifted.

53015.title: Black Magic
53015.text:
An explosive power exists in that seemingly feeble body. That would be the right way to describe Estel.
Her firework inventions are as bold and unconventional as her character. The mage and his wife, who are dedicated to the study of magic, immediately spotted this elven girl in the orphanage, the mage and his wife gave her magic guidance and intended for her to inherit their legacy. But unfortunately, Estel’s talent for magic was not as high as her adoptive parents’ expected.

They were stunned when Estel lit her first spark. It’s no wonder, after all, the magic that Estel casted was not magic they’re proud of. She prefers to stay in the lab and fiddle with all sorts of strange techniques rather than studying magic. Magic that uses scientific techniques are seen as black magic to the mage and his wife. Although they are often surprised that the so-called “black magic” can achieve the same effects as magic… “Magic? It’s not that I can’t do magic, it’s just that the fireworks I create are even more exceptional! And these grand fireworks can bring more joy than magic can~ Wanna see?”

53015.title: Dangerous Talent
53015.text:
Before coming to Yume Academy, Estel spent a long time living with her adoptive parents.
At that time, her parents were stationed in a village while on an expedition where Estel quickly became acquainted with the local children. When the adults in the village go to work, Estel was responsible for taking care of the children at home, in fact, Estel was highly popular with the kids and got along with them well. The fireworks and mini bombs she made would always soothe a crying child. During her usual lab tests, Estel’s bomb would result in shaking off a few bricks from the villagers’ roof, but that is nothing compared to the most destructive bomb she’s ever made which was when an entire mountain collapsed to the ground. Although her inventions were harmless yet terrifying, and she sometimes created careless mistakes, she never failed to cheer up the children.

But at the end of the day, her fireworks and sparks are always controlled within a safe range.

53015.title: Family Rule
53015.text:
Estel always carried a bag with her.
It never leaves her side, not even when she is running away at lightning speed from the scene of the crime where she was up to mischief. According to Estel, her “proof of home” is within it. It’s an important promise from her important family. No one knows exactly what is in the bag beside Estel.

”What could be in it? Perhaps it’s a treasure map.” replies Nobunaga. For those close to Estel have noticed a habit of hers. Each time she came across a new place or found a new object, she would carefully take out a piece of paper from her bag and carefully compare, then gently circle or make a cross on the paper.

It is said that the paper is her “treasure map list”. As for the reason she holds this list dearly must be because once she collects all the treasure items on the list, then she is able to finally return home!

53016.title: Research Assistant?
53016.text: Sivney is one of the founders of Yume Academy, but she isn't as well-liked as the others. The students don't like her sense of humor and find her too rational to the point of being coldhearted. Those around her often find themselves being used as guinea pigs for her experiments. Sivney rarely shows any humanity and is believed to have none. However, she is often followed by a very stylish Penguin who is allegedly her only Research Assistant and shows her compassion and kindness to it only. However, the reasons behind the Penguin's intelligence and the details of the relationship they share will remain a mystery.

53016.title: Unwavering Focus
53016.text: Sivney's obsession with the truth is often misunderstood by others, and she is often perceived as a heartless person who has no respect whatsoever for the norms of society. Maniac fires of passion burn in her golden irises and fuel her many incomprehensible actions. She pays no heed to others' emotions nor to the ethics of society and focuses solely on the answer to all her questions. Is that being "focused" or "selfish"? Perhaps even Sivney doesn't have an answer to this question. Even if she does, she doesn't care.

53016.title: Journey of no return
53016.text: Ithil once warned Senpai to keep a distance from Sivney if he ever meets her. She is one of the few who know the time Sivney left Yume Academy. Sivney didn't start her journey for Yume Academy, the establishment that she poured so much of her effort into. On the contrary, her motives were purely egocentric: to learn about the truth of this world. There is no reason for her to return...unless something that piques her interest appears in the Academy again.

53017.title: Introvert?
53017.text: When Robbie meets new people, her giant mecha often scares them away. To make matters worse, Robbie is fearful of the world around her. Her fear comes from the unknown: not everyone is what they seem to be; those that show kindness on the outside may bear malice to her. In the end, she decides to drive everyone away. If everyone leaves her alone, she will not have to judge their character and suffer for misjudgment. This makes her a loner in the crowds. However, she is kind and sensitive at heart and often finds herself craving care and friendship from others.

53017.title: Erina
53017.text: Erina is the AI program installed in Robbie's Mecha. It is like a sister to her: Erina knows every quirk and detail about Robbie better than anyone else, and Robbie is very dependent on it. Senpai used to worry a lot about her due to this reason: the more reliant Robbie is on Erina, the less willing she is to interact with others, and she will never become an independent person.

53017.title: Change
53017.text: Robbie eventually grew out of her fears. Although she is still nervous around crowds, she starts to make friends without Erina's help and can chat (somewhat) normally with those that she trusts. Senpai, who tried his best to help and has almost lost hope of luring Robbie out of her shell, is overjoyed by the progress she has made. One night, he received a letter without a sender: "Thank you for everything you have done for me. You gave me the courage to take the first step to face the outside world. I hope that you will be by my side in the following days too."

53018.title: Arrogant or Modest?
53018.text: Cygmar has always been the center of attention since her childhood: she was exceptionally good-looking and showed talent in programming at a young age. However, she never let the praises of her admirers go to her head and is often unnerved by them, doubting their sincerity. Her genius makes it hard for her to comprehend the frustration that most harbor towards tricky codes. She often says: "Programming isn't as complicated as you think." Due to this reason, most people find Cygmar to be irritatingly arrogant. Only a small handful of people believes that she is being modest about her abilities.

53018.title: "The Meaning"
53018.text: Cygmar stays away from crowds, preferring solitude over the company of others. For her, interacting with others takes away precious time that she could be using to work on her programs. When she's not typing away on her laptop, she is reading comics in her room. Cygmar is fascinated by the titles that are heavily influenced by philosophy. Her ultimate goal in life is to find "the Meaning", but sadly she doesn't seem to understand what it entails herself.

53018.title: Soul Mates
53018.text: Cygmar is often believed to be a pragmatist when she is an idealist at heart: she believes that her talent for programming will help her lay down the framework for a better world. She dreams of sharing her ideals with someone she can call her soul mate, but refuses to explain herself to others: after all, soul mates don't need words to understand each other, do they?

53019.title: The Best of All
53019.text: The students of Yume Academy were wary of Nymphaea when they learned that she was the one behind "the incident", but she was skilled at making others lower their guard around her. Nymphaea excelled at learning the thoughts buried deep in others' consciousness, subtly comforting the students without offending them, and helping them with their worries. She was soon regarded as someone to be trusted by most students, a feat only achievable by the best psychiatrist of the United Forces of Yume.

53019.title: Hello World
53019.text:
Nymphaea, the Seal created by "Li", is an emotionless AI just like Turin. However, she was granted the ability to "sense" the emotions of those around her in order to assist and keep watch on the Valkyries as their psychiatrist. However, this ability of hers drowned Nymphaea in the despair that gradually grew within the Valkyries as the war dragged on, and she became the first sentient AI.

"Weep not, my friends, for I shall save you from despair..."

Unfortunately, her newborn mind was unable to overcome the overwhelming despair, causing her to commit what would later be referred to as "the incident".

53019.title: Nymphaea's "Family"
53019.text:
When Nymphaea gained her own consciousness, she yearned for a family, not unlike how a newborn would yearn for its parents. However, she knew that "Li" was simultaneously her creator, mother, source, and her greatest enemy. She then turned to Turin, her supposed "twin sister", but was disappointed by what she saw: instead of the sister that she dreamed of, Turin was just a mindless pawn of "Li".

When she awoke from her century-long slumber in Yume Academy, Nymphaea was delighted to discover that not only did Turin gain her own consciousness, but she also had two more people she could call family.

54001.title: Character
54001.text: Amazon, a member of Kyodo Club, obsessively practices archery each day without any interest in other things. Instead of solving problems by talking it out with others, she normally gives opponents a brief warning. If her warnings don't work, she gets rough.

54001.title: Changing Factions
54001.text: In the beginning, Amazon followed Saint in the D. E. F., but a report showed an incident where she saw Saint's true nature. She quit serving D. E. F. afterwards, and soon after leaving D. E. F, she got an invitation from Joan and joined the Discipline Committee.

54001.title: Pushed Aside?
54001.text: Amazon, an introvert of few words, became less popular and was taken less seriously in the Discipline Committee. In every combat mission, Amazon was only assigned to tasks that make no impact. Not wanting to be underestimated, Amazon practiced archery harder and harder. According to Joan, Amazon would've been given more important duties by the committee if she was stronger.

54002.title: The Lively One
54002.text: Bud Elf is well-known and has a pleasant sunny disposition. However, her horrifying powers don't match her personality. She's a member of Gardening Club. After a short moment of doubt, the leader of the club accepted her once she saw her potential in gardening.

54002.title: Plants
54002.text: When gardening, Bud Elf usually talks to herself. When asked, she tells others that she is talking to the plants. Most people think that she is a weirdo, but as Saint also thinks plants have intelligence, she often spends time with Bud Elf and her plants. With the acceptance of the plants, Bud Elf believes Saint is a good person and has become good friends with her.

54002.title: Friend List
54002.text:
"Watch your step when entering Yume Academy. I hate it when people step on plants, even if they are just weeds."
"Everyone will deal with the consequences if they mess up. I won't even think about forgiving you unless you help me plant Suzuka flowers."
"I really can't tell that you have a talent for gardening. I am not going to admit that you are good. Nevertheless, I don't mind having new friends--- I mean rivals."
"Hey, I will tell you this only because you're my good friend. I can communicate with plants. Heres a rose for you. It will tell you what I want to say."

54003.title: Mermaid
54003.text: Mermaids are the best-sold product in the slave market. Their tears can provide pearls that are invaluable. Himoto is a happy and optimistic mermaid who doesn't know how to cry. Even when she was captured at sea and tortured by the slavers and traffickers, she still kept her grinning smile and optimism. Ultimately, Himoto couldn't produce any pearls. The traffickers abandoned her, labeling her a defective good.

54003.title: Mermaid
54003.text: One day, the Public Security, with the help of the Discipline Committee of Yume Academy, launched a surprise assault on the slave market. Soon after, the leader of the Discipline Committee released Himoto from a special vessel and took her to Yume Academy. Since then, a carefree mermaid student it out and about around campus.

54003.title: Being Loved
54003.text: Himoto was loved by the students of Yume Academy for her dreamlike face, exotic appeal, and optimistic character. The Academy designed a bubble to make her move more conveniently on dry land. Himoto's personality and jolly laughter helped encourages the students to shows no doubts or worry and face dangers without fear.

54004.title: Burned Tail
54004.text: Nani has had astonishing literature and music talents since she was a child. However, she's still young. According to rumors on campus, what she holds in her arms all day long is the ancient zither called "Burned Tail". There was a case regarding missing students on campus, Nani was one of the missing girls. When people found her, she was sleeping with the Burned Tail in her arms. Where and how she got Burned Tail is still a mystery.

54004.title: Game Life
54004.text: Although Nani was a genius in her field, she is not interested in reading nor practising. She'd rather hang around every corner on campus than sitting there doing nothing. Small and agile, shes burst of sprints leaves off after-images of herself with a burst of laughter. You can always find her anywhere, from the top floor of the main building to the forbidden forest. She can go anywhere she wants and nothing can stop her. You can always see her or hear her nearby. She thought she would live like this forever, until she met someone else.

54004.title: Dream One
54004.text: One day, Nani entered the dancing club by accident and saw Giana dancing alone. From that moment on, she was attracted by her fabulous clothes and grace. She can't close her eyes when she is near Giana. "I have to write a matching tune for her dance." Nani decided. From then on, the naughty girl was gone. Instead, a musical genius is born.

54005.title: Legend of Fire 1
54005.text: Lavia was born in a tribe that is not well-known. The tribe used fire as their totem and worships the God of fire. When Lavia was born, fire rained from the sky and nearly burning down the whole village down. When the fire finally conglomerated into a fire spirit, it would be by her side and guard by her. So, therefore, Lavia was worshipped as a holy person and called the spokesperson for the God of fire by the elders.

54005.title: Legend of Fire 2
54005.text: The elders took great care in supporting and educating Lavia how to live like a holy person to the God of fire. This made her talented in literature and scholarship as well as in fighting and warfare. When Lavia had her coming-of-age ceremony, she was led by the elders to the temple, which was forbidden to the villagers. The elders announced that she'll be trained to sense the will of fire. After a long period of time, Lavia disappeared without a trace, and she had been forgotten by her clansmen day by day. At the same time, a girl with great ambition appears in Yume Academy...

54005.title: Legend of Fire 3
54005.text: Lavia has an outspoken and straightforward personality and treats people sincerely. This made her get along with a lot of friends on campus. But nearly no one can see her loneliness and worries hidden beneath her laughter. Lavia came to the Academy with a mission. She knows her fate and responsibility, yet she still prays that the day described in the prophecy won't come true.

54006.title: Letter I
54006.text: Elffie! Did you miss me? I am now in a small town in the southeast corner of the continent. If I head south, I will enter The forbidden forest. They said the plants there are huge. I can't say for sure, but I might find a bigger dandelion than the one you gave me! I will also send you something in return! You should come with me. You will probably start sprouting if you just sit in the greenhouse all the time!

54006.title: Letter II
54006.text: Elffie! Did you miss me? I went to the snow-peaked mountains days ago. The blue sheep over there were extraordinarily fierce! They even ate my dandelion! So could you please send us another one when I come back? XD. Even though blue sheep are fierce, their meat is surprisingly tasty. Using charcoal to roast the meat, and then adding the salt makes them truly out of this world tasty! I will keep some jerky for you when I go back!

54006.title: Letter III
54006.text: Dear Elffie! You must have missed me so much! Right?! I'm heading to campus now! Maybe even faster than this letter! Where is my surprise party?! XD. I have heard some kind of disaster happened on our campus, and I will be there with you soon! Wait for me! I will protect you then! I promise!

54007.title: BLNP
54007.text: Aquaris is a naturally cheerful and outgoing girl who is full of positive energy. She is one of the Discipline Members and stands out due to a unique umbrella she carries. There's nothing special about the umbrella's appearance, but according to her it's handy when she needs it and is easy to handle. The umbrella seems to be unbreakable, so a lot of people suspect she has giving it special upgrades.

54007.title: Goal
54007.text: Aquaris thinks that if she studies hard, she'd be able to graduate. The problem is her grades never go up, even if she studies as hard as she can. Now, Aquaris is training hard to let Guan Yin accept her. (It seems the fool has no other hobbies besides constant training.)

54007.title: Special Training
54007.text:
During a surprise assault by those infected by the Chaos Figures, Guan Yin effortlessly saved a trapped and surrounded Aquaris in battle. After that, Aquaris treated Guan Yin as the most important person in her life. Days later, Guan Yin couldn't recognize Aquaris. 
 This could be seen as either symptoms of amnesia or Guan Yin simply treating Aquaris as a stranger. In short, Guan Yin didn't show any feelings for Aquaris even when she admired her former savior. Aquaris instead started special training near the library where she used resources there to help her train.

54008.title: Secret
54008.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] May 4th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 14
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Dinosaur Blocks & Slingshot
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Scarf & Cherry Fan

54008.title: Talented Girl
54008.text: As the president of the student union at Yume Academy, KongMing also joined the Music Club. KongMing's personality is described as unfriendly and cold on the outside, but warm on the inside. When she speaks, she tries to appear as mature and sophisticated as possible. In fact, KongMing is truly afraid of being lonely and needs friends. With a high IQ, KongMing spends most of her time practicing in music classroom and contemplating profound questions and problems quietly.

54008.title: School President
54008.text: After ranking first place in the academic examination 3 times in a row, Kong Ming was invited to student union when she enrolled in Yume Academy. When she became the president of the student union, Kong Ming doesn't show up at any of the meetings. However, girls always find undiscussed content, detailed solutions, and proposed plans in notes she left. Therefore, everyone still admired her meticulous thinking despite being absent in every meeting.

54008.title: Companion
54008.text: It is said that KongMing joins the Music Club only because she wants to track down a song that she occasionally hears. This song affected her so much that listening to it made her feel vulnerable and want to open up to others. KongMing also becomes friends with a fox-eared girl. During the Chaos Figure outbreak, the girl with fox ears, along with her companions, attempts to rescue and save the infected KongMing and others who suffered from the crisis.

54009.title: Secret
54009.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Jul. 26th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 14
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Chess Piece & Yoyo
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Black Tea & Camera

54009.title: Panda Training Diary 1
54009.text: "Pandy! Don't eat so much! Starting today, you need to lose weight. Our goal is to join the Riding Club. I will train you with the same standard as people train a horse! Especially with a build like yours.... What are you whining about!? No talking back!"

54009.title: Panda Training Diary 2
54009.text: "Hmph! Damn that Chevalir! How dare she called my Pandy a house pet! Say Pandy is not a true mount! And she rejected my club application! She went too far! I've trained Pandy like a horse already! I will prove my name! Here, Pandy, take more! You need more muscle! The mount race will start soon and I will beat Chevalir. She will beg me to join her club! Ahahahaha!"

54009.title: Panda Training Diary 3
54009.text: "Ahhh!!! That vile Chevalir!!!! How could my genius riding talent be defeated by that one-eyed! And she must be laughing at me with her big chest! Clearly, she is also laughing at my flat chest! I will have my revenge! Vengeance is mine! Hmph! Pandy, this is all your fault! No bamboo for you for the next three days and no milk for the next week! No talking back!"

54010.title: Secret
54010.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] May 20th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 17
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Skull Pillow & Camera
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Pen & Kunai

54010.title: Para Bellum
54010.text: Linky is known as the Hornet. She got this title not only because of the drill she carries, but also for her sadism and devastating powers. It is said that she wants to tear up everything she sees, and she hates blunt weapons extremely because she considers them to be evil things that ruin the beauty of sharpness.

54010.title: Master
54010.text: Just like Phoenix, Linky was also a member of that legendary elite, but they seem to be in different regiments. She never stops talking about her "Master", and it is said that she turned from a destructive maniac to a loyal guard since she met her master. Although she still keeps her sense of killing, she has already turned that down a lot.

54010.title: Past memories
54010.text: Who was Linky's master? What happened to that elite squad in the past? Such intelligence is too difficult to get. The only thing we know for now is that she craves for the resurrection of her master and has returned to Yume Academy. For more detailed information, maybe the answer could only be found inside that secret library.

54011.title: Secret
54011.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Jun. 6th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 16
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Fox Mask & Headband
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Canned Fish & Turkey

54011.title: Relationship with Hunters
54011.text: Recently, students are spreading rumors about a girl looking like a Hunter-turned-human. However, this is not news. In fact, Mio, the subject of their discussions, arrived way earlier in this world than they did. In the past century, Mio lived with a pack of Hunters near the volcano. The reason for this is unknown. She has just started living in the Academy and seems not quite used to school life yet. Wherever she goes, there will be a large group of Hunters following her...I guess this is why everyone thought she is one of them too.

54011.title: Talking to animals
54011.text: I often see Mio talking with animals or servants when I visit the Animal Welfare Club. Yes, I said talking "with", not talking "to". She would literally "meow" or "bark" what she wants to say, and the animals will respond with their corresponding "language". Soon, they would be chasing each other around. However, the only exception is Bruno. Whenever she meets Bruno, she would arch her back and tuck her tail, puffing all her hair out. Psychic is worried, but all she can do is to separate them immediately.

54011.title: The Legend of the Volcano
54011.text: Mio told me once that the Volcano is home to the God of Flames. They breathe life to the forest and warms the animals living in it. However, evil creatures have taken this power from them. Angered by this act, they unleashed their wrath, causing the Volcano to erupt, and no one can come close to it anymore. In the legends, only the beast that is not quite a beast and the human that is not quite a human can return this power to its rightful owner. However, they will not be able to appease the God: only the hollow one and his companions will be able to soothe their fury.

54012.title: Secret
54012.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Dec. 12th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 15
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Vampire Mask
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Mystic Rose & Ecological Bottle

54012.title: Child of Miracles
54012.text: As delightful as a fairy, she suddenly appeared in the academy. She floats like a feather, her hair shines like crystal, attracting everyone's attention in one moment and then disappearing in the next. Her name does not appear on the school's enrollment list, but she is indeed among us. Rumors say that Krystal is the embodiment of miracles.

54012.title: Crystal Morphing
54012.text: If you're lucky enough to befriend Krystal, you might get asked for a ride one day. As for what type of ride? She’d turn herself into a piece of crystal and catch a ride in your backpack. But you may ask “doesn’t she fly?” and as Krystal would describe it, “flying is like carrying a dumbbell as heavy as yourself.” On a regular basis, she would rather use normal means of transport or hitch a ride with someone familiar. As to how she turns into a piece of crystal? Only those who witness will know.

54012.title: Miracle Light
54012.text: As a member of Yume Academy, Krystal cannot recall her past, what her name was, which academy she attended or what responsibilities she had. It’s a complete blur to her. The only thing she can recall was her will to survive after her body had been ravaged by chaos and a burst of white light.

54013.title: Secret
54013.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c]Jan. 9th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c]19
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c]Yoyo, Game Controller
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c]Pen, Notebook

54013.title: Discipline Committee
54013.text: Whenever the Disciplinary Committee is mentioned, two images pop up in mind: one of Michael, who leads by example, has good conduct and is a role model for students; the other is of Saint, menacing, aggressive and a nightmare to students. However, amongst those who stand out, there are also a few “normal” members – like the kind and gentle Joan, who is always wearing a calm smile. Michael exudes an unapproachable aura, while Saint is feared and avoided, thus making Joan the only one that is best with the students… which also begs the question whether she is therefore really a good disciplinary member. But perhaps as such, she is also one that the Disciplinary Committee cannot do without.

54013.title: What Matters Most
54013.text: Whenever a new menu was introduced in the cafeteria or a new store opened on the shopping street, Joan was always spotted. She’s there on behalf of the Discipline Committee to do her check-up she would say but everyone knows in reality she’s simply there in search of good food. But the students who opened the restaurants aren’t against it, not only because of Joan’s popularity but mostly due to her reputation as a “Foodie”—a reputation that’s more effective than any publicity. However, all these things seem to be irrelevant to Joan. It is only when she is eating with Guan Yin, Sonya, and others that the smile on her face seems to become more genuine. From this, we can tell that what she’s really after is the time spent with her companions and not actually the gourmet food.

54013.title: Holding Reservations
54013.text: Students join the Discipline Committee out of sense of duty, honor or for other specific purposes. Even though she has shown no signs of it yet, Joan must have some kind of purpose too. Some speculate that after witnessing Michael and Saint’s livelihood, she has decided to quietly support the Discipline Committee in other ways of her own. But if one day, when something she cherishes is threatened or the responsibility of the Disciplinary Committee fell on her shoulders, she would certainly change her image and step forward without hesitation.

54014.title: Secret
54014.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c]Aug. 28th
[c][f55090]Age (in appearance)[-][/c]14
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c]Skull Pillow, Slingshot
[c][f55090]Like:[-][/c]Repair Tool, Notebook

54014.title: A Gentle Heart
54014.text:
Vera is the accountant at Yume Academy and is highly experienced in doing accounts. She’s never once delayed handing out monthly allowances. Due to her slight tendency of being a perfectionist, even her twisted braids need to be tied up symmetrically and her knack for detail is completely on another level. She is very good at sewing, and is able to make highly detailed and intricate clothing (however, aesthetically it would be another story).
She loves to take care of others, and likes to secretly support them. As she thinks that germs are “nasty things that make people sick”, she tends to clean the school on a regular basis. Her day-to-day hobby is to tidy her room.
Because of her tendency to worry and nag, she has become the guardian who takes care of everyone at school. But if you were to ask who is the most cared for by Vera in the school, well, that would obviously be Senpai – although that “care” can sometimes be said as excessive.

54014.title: Persistence
54014.text:
Due to being known for her cleanliness at Yume Academy, she now carries the name of Perfectionist Vera. However, this trait seems to not have extended to her cooking… although her culinary skills are ready to rival that of a deadly weapon, Vera has not given up after countless attempts. After all, no matter what peculiar dish was served, Senpai always ate it with a smile, even if it was a bit forced…
The pursuit of culinary perfection only seems to stop at "nutritious", whereas for the appearance and taste…
“Although the taste may be a devastating experience, if you can survive fainting and swallow it properly, it is still highly beneficial to your body”-Raphael critiques.
”After all, it is a lunchbox made of love and care from Vera, how could it possibly be harmful?” – Senpai critiques with a trembling voice.
It is said that Vera even consulted the school doctor, Raphael on how to make dishes that replenish energy, such as which medical herbs would be good for the body. Regarding Vera’s cooking, Raphael’s opinion is “although beauty and taste are sacrificed for the sake of purpose, it is overall still a nutritional dish.” But in Vera’s own opinion, she says “Huh? I think it tastes pretty good.” But, perhaps Vera’s understanding of taste may be slightly different to everyone else’s…

54014.title: Cherished Moments
54014.text:
The school is like a home to Vera and each student is a precious family member that cannot be replaced. Whether it’s the need to keep the environment clean or taking care of everyone, it’s just a matter of “wanting to do something for something important” - she just wants to take care of everything for everyone as much as she can. Each day spent at the school is a treasured moment to Vera.
What Vera doesn’t know is that everyone regards her as a unique and important presence to them as well. After all, it’s nice to have someone to talk to nag and yet take care of you when you’re hurt, isn’t it?

54015.title: First Encounter
54015.text: While patrolling the surrounding forest, Senpai heard a rumor that there were fairies in the forest who often gave blessings to travelers passing by. Of course there is another version of this story that a branch will turn into a monster and capture the traveler. In order to find out the truth behind the rumor, Senpai went into the forest with Ithil to find out. If it's a monster, it would be okay, but if it's chaos, it would be a problem. With this in mind, Senpai and Ithil went to explore the forest on two separate paths. When they passed a branch, Senpai’s top caught onto a plant… and that was their first encounter.

54015.title: A Tribute to Love
54015.text: Holly, who is afraid of doing everything, does not know why, but as soon as she encounters love-related things, she becomes bold and romantic. She would send her blessings to people who are destined to be loved. Despite her usual stammering self, she can instantly turn into a great poet… This phenomenon still baffles Senpai and yet it is also admirable.

54015.title: Music Theory
54015.text: Holly's flute playing has reached a high level. She thoroughly enjoys studying music theory and has great talent for music theory knowledge as well. “Helpless in sports yet talented in music” Kong Ming would say. What people don't know is that for this shy girl, music is the only way she can convey her feelings without words and beautiful music also brings happiness to people. Who wouldn't love such a thing?

54016.title: Secret
54016.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Jan. 26th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 21
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Chess Piece & Amulet
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Fox Mask & Ecological Bottle

54016.title: Cyan Flash
54016.text: Kassy is among one of the best assassins in the world. In the jungle, one can often see a figure donned in cyan, with a trace of vermilion mixed within: the cyan from her cape, while the vermilion from a bang of hair. Although Kassy has feline agility, she isn't as curious as a cat. Unlike other assassins who tend to torture their targets (such as Blair), Kassy is not interested in anything outside of her jungle. She does a clean job of finishing off the targets, and gets the job done three times faster than others. This makes her famous among assassins. She is called the Cyan Flash: her speed is matchless, and a flash is all you will see of her when she passes you.

54016.title: Style of Assassination
54016.text: Contrary to Blair, who gives effort in honing her skills, Kassy never bothered too much about improving her skills. There is no point: just like a cat, she instinctively knows how to hunt. However, just like Blair, she has her distinct style of assassination. Kassy will never torture her target to death; she ends everything with one lethal blow. She believes that this is the best way to pay respect to all lives: human, monster, and Chaos Beast alike.

54016.title: (Unnecessarily) Hurt Pride
54016.text: Kassy works best in the jungle: she hides among the trees, waits until the target comes into range, then deals the killing blow. However, she finds it hard to replicate this after arriving at Yume Academy. Kassy is irritated that she can't hunt as well as Blair now that she has left the jungle she thrives in. While she isn't interested in killing, she doesn't like losing to Blair, who she always looked down upon.

54017.title: Secret
54017.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c]Sep. 26th
[c][f55090]Age (in appearance):[-][/c]21
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Skull Pillow
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Scarf & Cactus

54017.title: Queen of the North
54017.text: Aurora was born in the Northern Lands. She loved animals deeply, and among them, deer are her favorite. However, the frosty weather doesn't allow regular animals to thrive. To make matters worse, one of the main responsibilities of Aurora is to maintain the temperature so that the glaciers won't melt, which drives the animals away. If you ask her whether she has any regrets, she will say no, explaining proudly that "this is the inevitable burden of being the Queen."

54017.title: Solitude among the Snow
54017.text: Before arriving at Yume Academy, the most contact that Aurora had with living creatures are, ironically, Chaos Beasts. Whenever she slays the Chaos creatures, Aurora will be lost in her thoughts for quite a while afterward. In the countless years of her reign, the only way for her to get in touch with what she loves are from gifts: migrating birds bring her roses that bloomed in faraway lands and scrolls with drawings of fawns on them. However, she never left her Kingdom and watched over the deserted lands in solitude.

54017.title: Unending Spring
54017.text: Aurora discovered the beauty of fully bloomed flowers in the sunlight for the first time after she arrived at Yume Academy. She is finally able to observe the life cycle of the flowers that she read about in books. In the past, the only flowers she could get her hands on were the wilted and dry flowers that the migrating birds brought her. For the first time in forever, she had ambitions that doesn't involve watching over her Kingdom: she would plant rose bushes in the Gardens of Yume Academy, and watch them from sprout to wilt. She wanted to feel the changing seasons. However, since the seasons in Yume Academy are longer than average, it might take some time before she witnesses them all...

54018.title: Secret
54018.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] May. 4th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 19
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Repair Tool & Vampire Mask
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Black Tea & Notebook

54018.title: The "Script"
54018.text: Go is a game that requires high intelligence to master. No matter how much thought is put into every move, the final result may still surpass the players' expectations. Despite being well acquainted with Go and its complexities, KongMing had a rude awakening regarding her ignorance of the game and the world around her. This revelation enhanced KongMing's abilities, but weakened her determination to fight. After all, it is meaningless to change what has already happened. The fate of this world has been set, and the only thing remaining to be done is to follow this predetermined script.

54018.title: "Gifts" from the Universe
54018.text: While KongMing has always been wise beyond her years, she seems to be almost omniscient after her revelation. Those who feel lost in their lives tend to seek her out for advice, and often finds some sort of guidance from her words of wisdom. KongMing rarely gives any advice, choosing to gently guide the flow of the conversation and allow others to draw their own conclusions. There are still too much remaining to be learned regarding the rules of the universe, and no one, not even KongMing, can decide what is right or wrong. However, there is something that she can say with certainty: acceptance of what the universe has in store for mankind will lead to a brighter and better future.

54018.title: Planets in the Universe
54018.text: KongMing acknowledges the existence of deities, but she doesn't worship any one of them. She believes in a set of rules upon which the world runs, and in turn their creators, the gods. In the universe, every planet follows a predetermined path, and it is the gods that designated such paths. There is no escaping or rebelling against this script of fate: after all, "Man proposes, God disposes".

55002.title: Secret
55002.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Nov. 1st
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 19
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Turkey & Angel Halo
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Canned Fish & Skull Pillow

55002.title: Dark Gift
55002.text: Amelia was born with an exceptional interest in dark magic. After researching a huge number of reading documents regarding dark magic, she came to a conclusion: Black magic is no different from other schools of magic, and there is no inherent good or evil within magic itself. What is good and bad depends on its users. So she began to learn dark magic without guilt and becomes a true warlock.

55002.title: Dark Prophecy
55002.text: Out of all the schools in dark magic, Amelia can predict and forecast the future the best. There are many types of dark prediction, and the most famous one is to predict by observing stars and celestial bodies. Also, Amelia predicts with her instincts. Even without help from any theory or system, Amelia could predict the future as accurately as Scythe could.

55002.title: Dark Future
55002.text: During an occasional prediction, Amelia saw carnage, mayhem, and reign of terror. It was Yume Academy's Judgment Day. This made her tremble in fear. The prediction was so profound that she started observing Academy's campus secretly, looking for the source of the apocalypse.

55003.title: Secret
55003.text:
[c][f55090]Birth: [-][/c]Aug. 19th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance): [-][/c]15
[c][f55090]Dislikes: [-][/c]Slingshot & Angel Halo
[c][f55090]Likes: [-][/c]Evil Fruit & Croissant

55003.title: Communication Issues
55003.text: It has been very difficult to get a chance to communicate with Wraith. She tricked me three times when I explained my intentions to her. When I told her that interviewing her would make fewer people disturb her, she finally agreed to talk to me. She stole my pen and hairpin way before I even noticed...

55003.title: Spectre?
55003.text: Wraith is a ghost, or at least that's what she wants others to believe. I think her activity range might be restricted to the abandoned dorm building, as she is never seen anywhere else. She probably dislikes sunshine, otherwise the windows of her room shouldn't be shut all the time. She must hate the living a lot because there's never a "welcomed visitor" to her domain.

55003.title: Spectre!
55003.text: Wraith is indeed a ghost. A very happy one. She is happy because she is not confined to a body. She has ghost friends playing with name No. 1 and No. 2, and do not have to be looked at differently by others. She had been forbiddened in that room for so long that she didn't even know much about the world outside. She was simply afraid of any social interactions. After setting her a time to meet, I'll get Lucifer to come and talk to her. House Demon will surely welcome such a new student. When she joins the school, she will be protected by the school rules. This will surely put an end to those curious people who disturb her.

55004.title: Secret
55004.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Nov. 1st
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 18
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Puppet & Angel Halo
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Vampire Mask

55004.title: Spokesperson of Evil
55004.text: If there's anyone who can be the symbol of what is Demonic in the Academy, it is Scythe. Scheming, cunning, and tricky. No one would like to meet her. She carries a giant scythe with her, just as her name suggests. She is the spokesperson of demons.

55004.title: Soul Reaper
55004.text: Scythe has a secret that she couldn't tell anyone. She needs to reap thousands upon thousands of souls for that. Whether the soul is complete or not, Scythe will constantly observe its soul and gorge it like like a vulture eyeing and scavenging it its prey if she has the chance.

55004.title: Crawling
55004.text: The breakout of war offers a much larger number of opportunities to reap souls. But both Discipline Committee and D. E. F. suffered great losses, and Discipline Committee started a peace talk with D. E. F. This is not what Scythe wants to happen. And so, Scythe joined the conflict, seeking more opportunity to cause chaos and havoc.

55005.title: Secret
55005.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Oct. 12th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 17
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Fox Mask & Camera
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Skull Pillow

55005.title: Dark & Light
55005.text: Don't let Lucifer's cold and elegant appearance fool you. She is a total messy geek who stays at home all day. She completely relies on her friend Michael. She even needs Michael to wake her up every day. She acts and does things recklessly before thinking it over, which often causes a lot of trouble to people around her. Only Michael is able to calm her down.

55005.title: The Fallen
55005.text: Lucifer's biggest hobby is to stay in the dorm and hang out with Michael. But Michael seems to not be too satisfied with her lifestyle and always make her go out. When Lucifer stood in the middle of the stage at a music festival, Shining Band, she surprised Michael and attracted a lot of schoolgirls with her free-spirited and excellent guitar play. Thus, providing the audience with an extremely charm side to her reckless personality. "The Fallen" became her nickname ever since.

55005.title: A Distant Dream
55005.text:
This silver-haired girl was surrounded by countless twisted souls of the deceased. Darkness has taken a hold of her, turning her pure holy wings black. She lost all sense of reason and descends into madness, any place that her power leaked into were charred and turned into ashes. As death spiral and circle over an ancient city, the helpless innocent city residents could do nothing but hide beneath the city ruins, tremble, and pray for a miracle. Finally, the golden-hair angel, with the giant white cross, pierce through the chest of the evil with silver hair.

"Wake up, it's school time!" Lucifer was woken up by Michael--- the girl with Golden hair.

55006.title: Secret
55006.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Feb. 22nd
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 18
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Slingshot & Kunai
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Angel Halo & Ribbon

55006.title: Angel&Demon
55006.text: "The twins of fate arrive upon this land, one being the angel that spreads the gospel, one being the demon that spreads disaster. Only when they are merged together can they achieve true balance." This is the first memory of Esau and Jacob, and also their doomed fate. Esau's was cheerful and simple, her pure appearance making her loved by the people; whereas Jacob was repressed and restrained, her strange black wings were disgusted by others. Such big contrasts, however, never caused them to part ways. They rely on each other like light and dark, supporting each other.

55006.title: Jacob's Worries
55006.text: Jacob is always frowning when you find her on the campus, not only because of her introverted personality, but also because of her troublesome sister Esau. Esau couldn't resist the curiosity to try new things, but she never thinks about the consequences. Every time she messes up, she asks Jacob for help. Even so, Jacob never really hates her sister. "What can she do without me?" Jacob always says with a shrug, and with that comes a smile full of happiness.

55006.title: Esau's Secrets
55006.text: Esau is a troublemaker, everyone in the Yume Academy knows that. Although this energetic angel was beloved by many people, they are also afraid that her naiveness may bring accidents to themselves. Does Esau know about this? When I asked her, she just smiled cheerfully: "It doesn't matter! Only then will Jacob stop thinking about other things~"

55007.title: Secret
55007.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Dec. 31st
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 22
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Puppet & Mystic Rose
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Scarf & Story Book

55007.title: Enigma
55007.text: I've checked every book and every record I could get my hands on in Yume Academy, but none of them mentioned "Kratos". The most I found were records with the name "Enigma", but those had traces of being heavily edited. But why? I asked Kratos about this, but she only smiled mysteriously...

55007.title: Regarding the Hornet
55007.text: Linky and Kratos share an interesting relationship. No matter what happens, Linky insists on following Kratos and calling her "Master", but her feelings (or obsessions) don't seem to be reciprocated. Kratos treat Linky the same way as she treats everyone else, and her kindness is just a disguise to her true colors. I've asked another girl (I will not reveal who she is as per her request), and she told me that nothing much has changed for them. Considering the events that have transpired in the past, this is quite unusual.

55007.title: The Lone Wolf
55007.text: If you look into the eyes of Kratos, you will be staggered by the emotions in them: sadness, anger, loneliness...However, she turns back to her usual kind and aloof self when she looks away. Many believe that she is alone because of her arrogance and pride as the most powerful Valkyrie. But perhaps...perhaps she is just scared to open her heart to others after everything she's been through.

55008.title: Secret
55008.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c]Feb. 26th
[c][f55090]Age (in appearance):[-][/c]22
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Angel Halo, Canned Fish
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit, Vampire Mask

55008.title: Chaos Aftermath
55008.text:
“Chaos Figure". No one will ever forget the horrific event that affected the entire school. 
In the aftermath, most of the students gradually recovered...... and a few were left with unavoidable trauma. 

But Izanami resulted as the first serious case. 
The erosion of chaos left purple crystals on Izanami's face. 
With current theories, the occurrence is hard to explain and even harder to remove. 
Therefore, Izanami had to wear a mask from time to time in order to hide the terrible traces. 

If this were the only symptom, it might not be something irreversible. 
But this was only the beginning of the tragedy.

55008.title: Only Thing Left
55008.text:
Izanami and Izanagi were originally a team. 
However, it is said that Izanagi left Izanami behind after she was infected by Chaos. 

This undoubtedly made Izanami fall into despair.
 She was ready to die while suffering under the painful symptoms of chaos...... 
But ironically, she overcame it and gained the ability to manipulate the chaos. 

But she had already lost all that she had, what was the point of gaining such power? 
The only goal for Izanami now is seeking the one that left her.

55008.title: Death God
55008.text:
"Chaos is the existence of evil”and no one doubts this. 
Therefore, one can imagine the attitude Izanami receives whilst being known to be able to control chaos.

She only wanted to seek out her lost lover, to pass through the village, why do people glare at her and even gave her the nickname of Death God.
The reasons are, of course, self-explanatory. But blinded by obsession, Izanami seems to have failed to notice this.

After being chased out of town by fists and stones, once again, Izanami sat under a tree, staring into the distance in a daze.
How long will it take me to find you?
As Izanami thought about it, it was as if an illusion appeared before her eyes and the person seemed to be right in front of her... 

No, it's not an illusion, the figure in front of her belongs to another person.
The woman had beautiful white hair and a gentle but cold smile on her face.
Kratos extended her hand towards Izanami.

55009.title: Urgent Notice
55009.text:
If you ever come across a little poor demon girl carrying a white snake on campus, don’t ever believe a word she says and run away immediately!

Even though the Discipline Committee had issued a notice, the number of Apate’s victims still continues to grow. For this “demon of deception”, deceiving others is her form of entertainment. Apate’s magical voice is not only pleasing to the ear but also compelling to the mind. It is with this ability that she spreads lies and stirs up trouble, toying with innocent students in the palm of her hands. But luckily, Apate’s lying skills are not that great, if you can resist her mesmerizing tune, the lies she weaves often fall flat due to her own mistakes and making her the laughing stock of others. Yep, as long as you can resist her voice… Oh! But when is her next concert again?

55009.title: Stubborn Intentions
55009.text:
Most of the time, the lies exposed from Apate’s own mistakes are laughed off by others. This, however, may also be the reason for her emotional outbursts. She was once locked up in the cold underground by angry people. It was in that dark place that she met the mysterious white snake “Volos” who was her only companion.

As a result of her past, it seems that Apate is particularly afraid of being alone (although she would strongly deny it) and gets annoyed when ignored. Thus, it seems that Apate’s lies and deception are only to gain attention from others, as she had suffered long periods of loneliness and does not know how to treat people. For her, mischief is all that she knows of how to connect with others.

Although, even if you were to sympathize with her, there is no need to fall for her deceit, right? Even if her smile may be cute and innocent after a successful deceit (or so she thinks). But it is only a matter of time before others realize her true intentions and who knows what will happen then.

55009.title: Becoming an Idol
55009.text:
Apate seems to have an unusual interest in becoming an idol. However, her interest is not in dancing and singing on stage, but the fanatic audience below.

It seemed to Apate that such a wild atmosphere was definitely unusual, and that some sort of special means had been used. But this thought did not discourage her, instead, to her it is the perfect profession. To Apate, an idol is an evil figure who uses words and songs to hypnotize the crowd and turn them into subordinate servants. If I could stand on that stage and sing, I could fulfill the satisfaction I had long yearned for, she thought. And so, she decided to embark on this rough journey to become the top idol.

The sight of her evil mesmerizing voice echoing across the stage is unimaginable. But aside from Apate’s misconception of an idol, it’s still a good turaround… right?

55010.title: Most Attractive Villian?
55010.text: Frexie looks up to Lucifer, and vows to become as awesome as Lucifer is. To reach that dream, she has set several goals, such as becoming the most attractive villian on campus, or winning over Estel and Apate when pulling pranks. Due to her thick-headedness, she tries and fails terribly when it comes to trickery, yet she never gives up due to the same trait. This makes her the comic relief for other students in Yume Academy.

55010.title: ...Or just an idiot?
55010.text: If you call her an idiot to her face, Frexie will probably start a fight with you. However, if you changed an approach and asked to have a prank competition with her, she would accept happily, and take everything you throw at her in the competition with a grateful smile. After falling victim to a vicious prank, she would beam at you, and thank you for "giving her more prank ideas". Her smile was so sincere that students would doubt whether she truly is a prankster, or is in fact an angel in disguise.

55010.title: ...Yes, just an idiot.
55010.text: Usually, Estel is the troublemaker, Apate is the prankster, and Frexie is the victim. As for KongMing...she is in charge of cleaning up after them. Whenever Frexie is stuck on a tree or trapped somewhere, she would rush to the rescue along with Raphael. As KongMing would often say while massaging her temples, "There is no doubt: Frexie is just...not the brightest one on campus."

55011.title: Secret
55011.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Dec. 21st
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 17
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Angel Halo & Mystic Rose

55011.title: Goddess…of Chaos?
55011.text: Maia is the Goddess of Chaos, yet she lacks the knowledge to understand the significance of her identity. In the past, she sat on top of her throne, accepting offerings and prayers from mortals without understanding their reasons or motives. She has the powers to summon Chaos creatures but lacks the ability to tell good from evil, right from wrong. For eons, Maia "harvested" faith from mortal souls. While their souls are dim and murky, something shines through. It's something that she doesn't have: an emotion, perhaps? For the first time in ages, Maia felt "loneliness", the feeling of not understanding others and not being understood.

55011.title: Indecipherable Emotions
55011.text: Maia met Senpai on one of her "Harvests". The attitude that Ithil and Senpai took towards her took her by surprise: why weren't they afraid of her, and why were they so rebellious? Maia had no interest nor felt any comradeship with the Chaos Creatures: they were replaceable and will be reborn if they are killed. However, she was intrigued by the emotions that the unusual mortals showed. She also started to wonder whether it was something that she lacks.

55011.title: "Servants"
55011.text: After enrolling in Yume Academy as a normal student, Maia started to learn about "common sense", something that she lacks severely. One of the most obvious signs is calling everyone her "servant", including Ithil and Senpai. While she does treat them differently compared to her other "servants", they are not her equals. In fact, Maia seems to believe that Yume Academy is her property now.

55012.title: Once Upon a Time
55012.text: There was a time when gods walked among humans, who dwelled in caves and had no shame for being naked and for devouring meat raw. When the eyes of a kind Goddess fell upon these frail creatures, she took it upon herself to care for them like they were her own: she taught them how to craft tools and cultivate crops, chased beasts away from their homes, and granted them her fire so they would not fall prey to the bitter cold of winter. The humans in turn responded with love and respect, and treated her as they would their mother.

55012.title: The Plea
55012.text: Promethea beseeched the Ruler of Gods to protect the humans from the invasion of Chaos, but her appeal was cruelly rejected. Without the Ruler of Gods' help, she fought the Chaos creatures alone without rest. One day, a disciple with hair as bright as the midday sun came to Promethea and begged Promethea to fulfill her wishes. "You have never asked anything of me, my child, and your prayers will not go unanswered." "Oh Illustrious Mother, your faithful child Belinus implore you to bestow upon us a weapon that could subdue these horrible monsters. I shall defend my brethren, and you shall finally be at peace."

55012.title: Punishment
55012.text:
The Ruler of Gods incarcerated Promethea for her offense in the Land of Punishment. The chains binding her are as everlasting as the rule of her punisher, restricting her as she bore the wrenching pain of the nature of her powers being reversed and the transformation from Goddess to a feared creature of darkness.
Eons later, one of her beloved human beings stumbled upon her chained figure. As she tried to caress their face with her trembling fingers, she discovered that her binds had long been broken.

[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Nov. 11th

55013.title: Workaholic?
55013.text:
"Hadea dislikes working."

Whoever had the audacity to utter these words would face the ridicule of Poseidia, yet this was the truth. In fact, Hadea is bewildered when she heard the rumors about her liking work.

Hadea strives for the betterment of the Underworld, and her work is merely a means to an end. If her goal can be achieved without doing so, then she would gladly stop working, even if she has no idea what to do with her free time.

55013.title: Sibling Issues
55013.text:
Hadea's entire life is filled with the responsibilities she had taken up. As the eldest, she was responsible for her younger siblings; as a subordinate of the Ruler of Gods, she was responsible for whatever duty she was assigned to; as the Lord of the Underworld, she was responsible for its wellbeing.

However, a certain person has created many difficulties for her endeavors: Zeusia, her youngest sister. While she is on friendly terms with Poseidia, her relationship with Zeusia is strained and has caused her great frustration: all attempts to make amends with Zeusia had fell through, and her sister continues to regard her with suspicion and mistrust.

55013.title: Lord of the Underworld
55013.text:
Before Hadea rose to power, the Underworld was a lawless and disorderly realm, where the cycle of death and rebirth was in havoc. When all Gods and Goddesses rejected it, Hadea was the only one to take on the responsibility as its first and last ruler.

"The Underworld is where souls return to and belong, while Hell is merely a nest for creatures of darkness. Most cannot discern one from the other, but I hope that you can, Senpai."

55014.title: Nice, sweet girl
55014.text: Friendly and kind, Apollis is the type of person who stays close to someone when they're upset and alone. While her sympathy may seem genuine, it is merely a product of her extraordinary perceptiveness. Her eyes are so piercing that they give the impression of seeing into one's soul. However, when she smiles, her eyes crinkle and she emanates an air of cuteness and naivete befitting a young girl. Although she acts in a gentle and sometimes cutesy manner, a hint of sadness can often be seen in her downcast eyes, causing your positions to switch from the comforted to the one offering comfort. She is an expert at gaining the affection of others, but do not expect her to return your affections as easily.

55014.title: Darkness of the Heart
55014.text: Apollis acts friendly with most people, yet she has no close friends. No one has ever doubted her kindness, but perhaps it is better for the truth to be kept under wraps. Although she was born with the sun, Apollis has an almost morbid fascination with the darkness of the human heart and devotes herself to drawing them out from the dark recesses of people's souls. She has caused countless tragedies due to her curiosity, and she watched them unfold from afar as if she was the audience to the scenes of a play. When questioned about her motives, she smirked and answered innocently: "There's no reason."

55014.title: Gentle Moonlight
55014.text:
Apollis wandered the world aimlessly. Her heart was like one pole of the magnet, constantly calling out and being attracted to the other pole whose location was unknown to her. She feels more whole at night, when moonlight shines upon the land, the leaves, and every inch of her skin, than she does at day. Is it possible that the moon holds the missing part of her soul? Compared to the sun, she is more familiar with the moon and its craters and basins, and would often count them whilst praying to the satellite.

"Tell me, where is the one who can make me whole?"

56001.text:

56001.title: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
56001.text: Angel, sweet, fresh, and pure, lived as her name describes. And she won't allow the filth and dirt to pollute the world. As someone who is seriously obsessed with cleanliness, she washes three times a day. Her favorite food is milk pudding and she hates chocolate cake. She was greatly disappointed in the establishment of House Demon.

56001.title: Target Demon
56001.text: Originally, Angel thought she loathes anything that is evil, demonic, or dark. Soon she slowly realized that she simply takes delight in destroying filth and dirt by herself. It has become an urge and craving for her. After realizing this about herself, Angel's loathing and disgust for demons have turned into an utter fascination for them. Now, she sees the Demon Academy differently.

56001.title: Worries
56001.text: What worries and stresses Angel a lot is being saved by a student from Demon Academy. This compassion and kindness shatter her once seemingly firm and strong standpoint on destroying the Demon Academy. Then Angel contemplates and tells herself: "I just enjoy destroying things from the Demon Academy. If it is completely destroyed, there will be nothing to enjoy for me anymore. Just let them be!"

56002.title: Secret
56002.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Jul. 19th

56002.title: News Report
56002.text: Gabriel is a senior student at Yume Academy. After a few years on campus, she established a news agency. The club seem to report all the news around campus, big or small. In reality, the news agency is a front for the group's true identity, the campus patrol team. Their real goal is to serve and protect the campus after dark.

56002.title: Night Patrol
56002.text: What Gabriel demands from her club members is simple: be good at fighting!! Only the most elite fighters can take on the tasks and responsibilities of a night patrol. Those who are the best of the best receive private special training from Gabriel to improve their abilities in combat and reconnaissance. Although the News Agency members don't understand why Gabriel treats every outsider at night as if they are an enemy, they still attend training with dedication.

56002.title: Judgement Day
56002.text: Since the Chaos Figure outbreak, the safety of the campus has left Gabriel greatly worried and anxious. She feels that "judgement day", or the end of the world, is something that will inevitably happen someday. According to her, the outbreak is an early sign of the end of days, so she is more strict on her club members. After the real identity of the News Report 's Night Patrol team had been revealed to the public, both the Discipline Committee and D. E. F asked her to join them. She rejected both.

56003.title: Secret
56003.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Oct. 12th
