652018.title: Common Knowledge
652018.text:
CapsuGirl is cute, really cute, so she could attract all the attention when she pass by on campus.
She always carries a capsule with her, and inside there was a little creature in white, I've checked all the records already but failed to find a clue about what it is, but I believe it should be a rare servant.
If you're trying to find her, you can take your chance nearby the Capsule Machine, she can always be found nearby those machines.

652018.title: Rumors
652018.text:
"CapsuGirl can be acquired from Capsule Machine!" "Who did that? Can I also be so lucky?"
"Capsule Machine is actually a portal connecting to the different world, and consider the capsule machine as a battery to activate the portal!" "Then why don't you just disassembly it when there's nobody around?"
"CapsuGirl must have been manipulating the odds, I didn't get anything of value in the past several draws!" "But I saw she also got nothing last time?"

652018.title: Capsule Girl
652018.text: After I finished reading last week, I happened to meet CapsuGirl when passing the Capsule Machine. She was playing with the little creature which was supposed to be in her capsule! And her tail is attached on one of the Capsule Machines, just like she's recharging! I finally know that her tail is not just for exhibition! After that, I think it's necessary to consider if the rumors are true!

[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Sep. 7th

[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] SF Pistol & Cactus
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Pen & Mystic Rose

652019.title: Perception
652019.text: Ithil was born with hypersensitivity, which enables her to notice many things in her surroundings through means other than sight. She will still be able to notice you peeping at her, even from a distance, and you will somehow feel her glaring at you, even with her eyes hidden behind a black ribbon. This ability even allows her awareness of more than what’s physically perceivable. I believe this made her who she is today.

652019.title: Cleanup Master
652019.text: It's entertaining to see Ithil cleaning up the house. She can clean a room so well that you can see your own reflection in the floor. If you have at least once done housework by yourself, you will know how hard it is. But Ithil seems to enjoy the routine, as this is her method to relieving stress. We still have yet to discover where she stores all her cleaning tools...

652019.title: Knife Juggler
652019.text: Ithil is undoubtedly a master of shivs--- even a bug on the wall would be a perfect target for her. Rumor is that she was once insulted by a drunkard who described her as a "circus freak", so Ithil taught her a lesson and shaved all her hair off as retribution.

652020.title: Secret

652020.title: D.E.F
652020.text: Since Ithil returns to the Academy, Saint transferred the position of the president of House Human to her. After that, Saint disappears without a trace. The D.E.F association, which she established, went underground. But as almost every story goes, going underground doesn't necessarily mean getting disbanded. Even without the mask, the members are still the best card player, the best marksman, and the best swordsman on campus. They are now just waiting for a chance to reassemble under the banner of a rightful ruler.

652020.title: Sword of Judgment
652020.text: Most know that Saint has a sword that never leaves her side. However, rumor goes that she has another, one that holds the power of dragons. That rumor gradually died down because no one actually saw that sword. This changed after a storm: some students claimed that they saw a huge dragon-shaped shadow on campus that night, which got the rumor mill started again.

652020.title: Dominating Power
652020.text: Rumors about Saint returning with a special power has spread all over the Academy. All who stare at her into her eyes feel like they're staring into the eyes of a monster, they'd even lose their balance as if their powers were suddenly drained out of their bodies. "It's horrible, Saint has definitely become an evil dragon." This is what Aquaris said when she was found lying on the ground and desperately pulling on something (which were actually Senpai's trousers) in order to overcome her fear. "Saint caused all the destruction here! You have to trust me! She's become a complete monster!" Of course, everyone knows Aquaris was exaggerating. But based on how much she shook, perhaps Saint really had "impressed" her a lot with her new power.

652021.title: Secret
652021.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Jun. 28th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 19
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Daisy Hairpin & Scarf

652021.title: Sword and Revolver
652021.text: Whilst dealing with the unpredictable sword, you have to watch out for the hidden revolver. Many students find Rogue's fighting style uncomfortable. Not to mention the deceptive and psychological tactics she uses in her battles, which can cause many students to suffer. Despite this, the students are not averse to training with Rogue - after all, it's an unfamiliar battle where you learn the most and Rogue is always sharing stories of her past as a mercenary. Just that...rumours say she's recently started charging fees? Uh, is that even possible...?

652021.title: Mercenary
652021.text: Rogue is a powerful mercenary and she should have earned enough money to retire or become a reputable mercenary leader by now. But as soon as she has the money, she gambles, and with her disastrous gambling skills, she ends up in the abyss. Of course, Rogue has realized this and is determined to make amends, but the way she chose to go about it was... to cheat. After being repeatedly exposed and refusing to admit, Rogue was blacklisted at pubs and casinos, and had to wander the world in search of another place that would accept her.

652021.title: Trust
652021.text: In school, having mutual trust may be a natural thing. But for mercenaries, yesterday’s comrade in arms may be today's enemy. There is no trust nor right or wrong. This is why Rogue holds a mocking attitude towards the students' relationship. However, Rogue, who holds her own life at stake, has never once bet on her sword or blade revolver. This at least shows that even Rogue has something she wants to believe in.

652022.title: Odd Habit
652022.text:
A master of swords is the best way to describe Mika.
She was once an adventurer that traveled far and wide. In a way, she can be considered to have seen many things.
She often calls “Senpai” in a serious manner, believing it is necessary to address those who deserve respect politely.

Whenever she traveled to a new destination, she would carefully observe the local architectures. It started as an unintentional act that eventually developed into a habit. She would not only observe whether a building's construction was reasonable and strong but would also ponder about its aesthetic value. In the end, she has gone as far as to even consider its human history behind the buildings saying "one that has not succumbed to time is of the highest value. Whether it's a building, a Girl, or a human being. What do you think, Senpai?"

652022.title: Fear
652022.text:
On her adventures, Mika often does not like to let others follow behind her and insists that they walk in front.
"Perhaps it’s because I’m too afraid that when I turn back, all my comrades have disappeared…” Her explanation tends to puzzle others. As the last master of swords, Mika's swordsmanship is highly skilled, but during battles, Mika seldom uses her sword skills and only uses magic to construct shields to protect everyone. The reason for this remains a secret.

652022.title: A Unique Honoring
652022.text:
For a while, after joining Yume Academy, Mika was often seen creating clay dolls in a corner.
Whenever someone asked, she would simply respond that it’s only to pass time.
Only Aquaris would gently shake her head and urge others to not bother her all the time.

For Mika, creating clay dolls is her unique way of reminiscing.
While shaping the clay in her hands, she would send her condolences. In each realistic clay doll, her emotions of remorse and sorrow are expressed. However, such behavior has decreased more and more after settling into school and interacting with Senpai and her schoolmates. But perhaps for the current Mika, it is better to enjoy the present and protect everything dear to her than regretting the past.

652023.title: Church of Violence
652023.text: The other students were apprehensive of Teresa when she first arrived at Yume Academy. The clash between her appearance and her actions were jarring: Teresa was not religious, nor gentle. She often resorted to violence instead of the bible to solve any problems. However, Teresa scoffed at this whenever anyone questions her about her conduct. To her, fighting is the best method of communication, when too many emotions cannot be expressed by words. She'd take fighting over speaking any day. "Actions befitting a member of the Church of Violence", as KongMing would say.

652023.title: Nun in Shades
652023.text: Teresa has a large collection of Sunglasses. Sunglasses on sale, sunglasses that went out of fashion, sunglasses in fashion, sunglasses that never go out of fashion, you name it, she has it. When asked about the reason behind this, she explained that she "looks cool with them on, plus they help hide facial expressions". Apparently, she would be an open book without them, which is "not cool".

652023.title: Nonchalance
652023.text: Teresa doesn't act like other nuns I know of. She nibbles on Spicy Fishies whenever she can, wears sunglasses 24-7, and offers protection in exchange for monetary gains. People who don't know her too well would look down upon her due to this. "Don't judge a book by its cover", that's what she'd say. Teresa never cares about what others say about her, as she is busy chomping on Spicy Fishies and chatting with God. "Praying night and day? Nah, God doesn't like it when I take up all of His time..."

652024.title: Secret
652024.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Mar. 14th

652024.title: A Shooting Star
652024.text: Born in the gap between time and space, Monica owns a special gift. The Girls already have a longer life span, but Monica has the ability to control time for a short period. In this everlasting flow of time, Monica has watched over the many sorrows and joys of humans. She sometimes rewinds the hands of her watch out of curiosity just to let people reunite with their deceased loved ones. But one will always wake from their dream. As she gains and loses, and sees people laughing and crying, Monica began to find other pleasures. The human soul. Their civilization. Nothing lasts forever in this world and eventually everyone will disappear and turn to ash. However, only the feelings created by the human soul continue to shine forever, just like the stars in the night sky...

652024.title: Nostalgia
652024.text: Apart from time, Monica also showed great interest in psychology. She could spend a whole day reading psychology books and sometimes, even sleep in the library just to read more which bothered Valeera a lot. As the time that Monica can manipulate is short, and it is not possible for her to go back to a very early time. But many fascinating descriptions in the book made her very curious…

652024.title: Spawn of Time
652024.text: Monica claims herself to be "Spawn of Time", she loves pocket watches, hourglasses, or anything else that is related to "time". But she doesn't treat them very carefully, as she believes "there is nothing in the world that truly captures time." For unknown reasons, Monica was particularly fond of old-fashioned pendulum clocks. Every time she sees that swaying pendulum, she feels solemn. --- "Time might never be actually captured, but it must be respected."

652025.title: Secret
652025.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Nov. 26th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 24
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Vampire Mask
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Rum & Lucky Cat

652025.title: Avaricious?
652025.text: Hermes' attention is focused solely on money or wealth. When others attempt to start a discussion on love, dreams, peace, or anything that isn't money, there will be a bored expression on her face, and she would ask: "Those are nice topics, but will they feed you at the end of the day?" Usually, there is no answer to her question. Her obsession with money has driven more than one friendly person away from her, yet she shows no signs of minding nor of explaining the reason for her attitude.

652025.title: (A lack of) Friends
652025.text: Hermes acts nonchalantly when it doesn't involve money or her business. Others are often wary to trust her with anything due to this attitude of hers, and she has few friends, a fact that she doesn't seem to take to heart. The years spent in the world outside Yume Academy taught her to focus on her own life and on the few people she calls friends. That changed after Hermes arrived at Yume Academy, where she showed unusual interest in Vera, the Student Union Accountant, and tried to befriend her. Perhaps Hermes felt connected with Vera due to both of them handling money on a daily basis.

652025.title: The Ultimate Answer
652025.text: There is an empathetical side of Hermes that she rarely shows anyone, and she is often pained by the deaths that she witnessed. She is well aware that money doesn't solve every problem that exists in the world, but she can't control herself to try to make more money. Before arriving at Yume Academy, Hermes traveled far and wide in the world, from bustling cities to abandoned plains. She saw human beings using wealth to exchange whatever they wanted: kindness, dignity, rights, and even respect. Hermes knows that money can't buy health or happiness from experience: even when she has money, she wasn't able to stop the tragedies from happening right in front of her eyes. "If the cure for the plague ravaging this world isn't money...what will it be?"

652026.title: Secret
652026.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Jun. 23th

652026.title: Perfection
652026.text: Ever elegant and composed, Eve never shows any signs of fatigue. She leads a healthy lifestyle and has high standards for herself. She detests those without manners, believing the dignity brought by manners to be more important than the respect of others. Her refined grace has charmed many, converting them into her faithful followers. Her surreal perfection remains unbroken even in the face of defeat, as if she has no doubt that victory will soon grace her with its presence.

652026.title: Heart of Stone
652026.text: Eve often takes on the role of a loving big sister, showering everyone with care at the same time. However, her gentle words are often accompanied by heartless jabs that make you doubt your place in her heart. Despite her capriciousness, countless people follow her blindly, as if trying to catch a gust of shapeless wind. In truth, she is unsympathetic and hard-hearted, caring about no one at all. After all, everyone is a tool in her eyes, and tools, even if they breathe, do not have feelings or emotions.

652026.title: Eve's Utopia
652026.text: Eve is an idealist whose allegiance lies with no one, not even Kratos. Her goal is to create a utopian world where she is the highest moral standard, and she is the only person that sees the full picture of this world. To achieve this goal, Eve will use all possible methods, be it noble ones or less than noble ones, and sacrifice everyone else, even if she doesn't know for certain whether the world will turn out to be exactly as she imagined. However, she is confident that luck is on her side.

652027.title: Secret
652027.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Jul. 29th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 24
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Chess Piece & Black Tea
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Canned Fish & Ribbon

652027.title: Gorgeous Dancer
652027.text: With her breathtaking beauty, Azucena wields her smile and dance like a weapon to attract attention and wealth. This is how she has lived her entire life, and she has never explored other possibilities. While one has a right to choose their own lifestyle, I can't help but pity her.

652027.title: Fragile Dream
652027.text: Azucena dreams of being the brightest star on stage, yet it remains a fantasy. She doesn't lack charm or skill: to strangers, she seems charismatic and proud, and her extraordinary dance abilities have brought her applause from her audience. However, her only method to achieve her goal is to fawn on others with higher social standing than hers and beg them for assistance. Unfortunately, she hasn't realized that flattery and seduction don't work on those that have seen past her facade.

652027.title: Drifting with the current
652027.text: Azucena is like a bottle in the ocean, drifting with the current with no clear goal in mind. She is always ready to set sail for a better life far away, leaving her past and all the bad memories behind. On second thought, instead of a bottle in the ocean, she is more similar to a parasite that cannot live without depending on someone. She would fall apart with no one to rely on, which is a lifestyle that Hermes finds rather pitiful.

653001.text:

653001.title: Mermaid
653001.text: Mermaids are the best-sold product in the slave market. Their tears can provide pearls that are invaluable. Himoto is a happy and optimistic mermaid who doesn't know how to cry. Even when she was captured at sea and tortured by the slavers and traffickers, she still kept her grinning smile and optimism. Ultimately, Himoto couldn't produce any pearls. The traffickers abandoned her, labeling her a defective good.

653001.title: Mermaid
653001.text: One day, the Public Security, with the help of the Discipline Committee of Yume Academy, launched a surprise assault on the slave market. Soon after, the leader of the Discipline Committee released Himoto from a special vessel and took her to Yume Academy. Since then, a carefree mermaid student it out and about around campus.

653001.title: Being Loved
653001.text: Himoto was loved by the students of Yume Academy for her dreamlike face, exotic appeal, and optimistic character. The Academy designed a bubble to make her move more conveniently on dry land. Himoto's personality and jolly laughter helped encourages the students to shows no doubts or worry and face dangers without fear.

653002.title: Secret
653002.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Apr. 1st

653002.title: Legend of Fire 1
653002.text: Lavia was born in a tribe that is not well-known. The tribe used fire as their totem and worships the God of fire. When Lavia was born, fire rained from the sky and nearly burning down the whole village down. When the fire finally conglomerated into a fire spirit, it would be by her side and guard by her. So, therefore, Lavia was worshipped as a holy person and called the spokesperson for the God of fire by the elders.

653002.title: Legend of Fire 2
653002.text: The elders took great care in supporting and educating Lavia how to live like a holy person to the God of fire. This made her talented in literature and scholarship as well as in fighting and warfare. When Lavia had her coming-of-age ceremony, she was led by the elders to the temple, which was forbidden to the villagers. The elders announced that she'll be trained to sense the will of fire. After a long period of time, Lavia disappeared without a trace, and she had been forgotten by her clansmen day by day. At the same time, a girl with great ambition appears in Yume Academy...

653002.title: Legend of Fire 3
653002.text: Lavia has an outspoken and straightforward personality and treats people sincerely. This made her get along with a lot of friends on campus. But nearly no one can see her loneliness and worries hidden beneath her laughter. Lavia came to the Academy with a mission. She knows her fate and responsibility, yet she still prays that the day described in the prophecy won't come true.

653003.title: Secret
653003.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Mar. 21st
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 14

653003.title: Letter I
653003.text: Elffie! Did you miss me? I am now in a small town in the southeast corner of the continent. If I head south, I will enter The forbidden forest. They said the plants there are huge. I can't say for sure, but I might find a bigger dandelion than the one you gave me! I will also send you something in return! You should come with me. You will probably start sprouting if you just sit in the greenhouse all the time!

653003.title: Letter II
653003.text: Elffie! Did you miss me? I went to the snow-peaked mountains days ago. The blue sheep over there were extraordinarily fierce! They even ate my dandelion! So could you please send us another one when I come back? XD. Even though blue sheep are fierce, their meat is surprisingly tasty. Using charcoal to roast the meat, and then adding the salt makes them truly out of this world tasty! I will keep some jerky for you when I go back!

653003.title: Letter III
653003.text: Dear Elffie! You must have missed me so much! Right?! I'm heading to campus now! Maybe even faster than this letter! Where is my surprise party?! XD. I have heard some kind of disaster happened on our campus, and I will be there with you soon! Wait for me! I will protect you then! I promise!

653004.title: Secret
653004.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Jul. 26th

653004.title: Panda Training Diary 1
653004.text: "Pandy! Don't eat so much! Starting today, you need to lose weight. Our goal is to join the Riding Club. I will train you with the same standard as people train a horse! Especially with a build like yours.... What are you whining about!? No talking back!"

653004.title: Panda Training Diary 2
653004.text: "Hmph! Damn that Chevalir! How dare she called my Pandy a house pet! Say Pandy is not a true mount! And she rejected my club application! She went too far! I've trained Pandy like a horse already! I will prove my name! Here, Pandy, take more! You need more muscle! The mount race will start soon and I will beat Chevalir. She will beg me to join her club! Ahahahaha!"

653004.title: Panda Training Diary 3
653004.text: "Ahhh!!! That vile Chevalir!!!! How could my genius riding talent be defeated by that one-eyed! And she must be laughing at me with her big chest! Clearly, she is also laughing at my flat chest! I will have my revenge! Vengeance is mine! Hmph! Pandy, this is all your fault! No bamboo for you for the next three days and no milk for the next week! No talking back!"

653005.title: Secret
653005.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Nov. 1st
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 19

653005.title: Dark Gift
653005.text: Amelia was born with an exceptional interest in dark magic. After researching a huge number of reading documents regarding dark magic, she came to a conclusion: Black magic is no different from other schools of magic, and there is no inherent good or evil within magic itself. What is good and bad depends on its users. So she began to learn dark magic without guilt and becomes a true warlock.

653005.title: Dark Prophecy
653005.text: Out of all the schools in dark magic, Amelia can predict and forecast the future the best. There are many types of dark prediction, and the most famous one is to predict by observing stars and celestial bodies. Also, Amelia predicts with her instincts. Even without help from any theory or system, Amelia could predict the future as accurately as Scythe could.

653005.title: Dark Future
653005.text: During an occasional prediction, Amelia saw carnage, mayhem, and reign of terror. It was Yume Academy's Judgment Day. This made her tremble in fear. The prediction was so profound that she started observing Academy's campus secretly, looking for the source of the apocalypse.

653006.title: Secret
653006.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] May 8th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 17

653006.title: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
653006.text: Angel, sweet, fresh, and pure, lived as her name describes. And she won't allow the filth and dirt to pollute the world. As someone who is seriously obsessed with cleanliness, she washes three times a day. Her favorite food is milk pudding and she hates chocolate cake. She was greatly disappointed in the establishment of House Demon.

653006.title: Target Demon
653006.text: Originally, Angel thought she loathes anything that is evil, demonic, or dark. Soon she slowly realized that she simply takes delight in destroying filth and dirt by herself. It has become an urge and craving for her. After realizing this about herself, Angel's loathing and disgust for demons have turned into an utter fascination for them. Now, she sees the Demon Academy differently.

653006.title: Worries
653006.text: What worries and stresses Angel a lot is being saved by a student from Demon Academy. This compassion and kindness shatter her once seemingly firm and strong standpoint on destroying the Demon Academy. Then Angel contemplates and tells herself: "I just enjoy destroying things from the Demon Academy. If it is completely destroyed, there will be nothing to enjoy for me anymore. Just let them be!"

653011.title: Secret
653011.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Oct. 3rd
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 17
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Lucky Cat & Vampire Mask
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] SF Pistol & SF Glasses

653011.title: Different Side of Her
653011.text: Although Alice carries a praiseworthy body that countless number of people on campus is jealous of, she has a silly and adorable personality. This difference made her popular. Every student wants to become friends with her. But only a few people know about the other side of her.

653011.title: Bold and Decisive
653011.text: Whenever she is in combat, Alice showed calm, decisive, and outstanding fighting abilities. This shocked others. Not only is Alice swift, flexible, and possesses excellent judgment and decision-making, she is also courageous and has a heroic fighting spirit. All these merits lead people to have to admit that Alice is a genius in combat that can be hardly found anywhere else.

653011.title: With Hexa
653011.text: Alice has a lot in common with Hexa. They're both frequently in the research room. But they don't talk to each other much. Alice feels a kind of sympathy for Hexa. But apart from this, she also shows subtle and faint hostility towards her. Alice can't figure out the reason behind this. Perhaps its the hatred or vendetta between the two in their previous life?

653014.title: The Crybaby
653014.text: Iron fist's sense of inferiority plays a huge role in her personality. She is timid, passive, and could easily cry. Hoping nobody would pay attention nor be interested in her, she believes that someday she will be abandoned if they do. Whenever someone is nearby, she becomes extraordinarily afraid and nervous. Only a few junior schoolgirls at Yume Academy are disabled or handicapped, and she is one of them.

653014.title: Robotic Arm
653014.text: When Iron Fist first enrolled in the Academy, she was extremely weak and fragile in appearance with a missing arm. After the good care and support from the senior students, she finally recovered. The lost arm won't regenerate and instead receive an artificial arm made of steel was attached to her. Even though she recovered physically, she couldn't get rid of the shadows that bother her. She has recurring nightmares of being ambushed from behind, arms being violently torn apart, and having an unrecognizable faceless figure haunting her to the point of crippling grief.

653014.title: Encouragement
653014.text:
No one knows in detail how Iron Fist first met KongMing. But only when KongMing was by her side, she is at peace.
 "Iron Fist, there's courage hidden within you. You can get it back without me, only if... you decide to face your fears. " Those were the last word KongMing said to her before she left. Afterwards that Iron Fist became alone again, but her issues with feeling inferior have improved and she is not as passive nor shy anymore. She even joined the team to save and rescue the infected from the Chaos Figure.

653015.title: Empty
653015.text: Very few people know Muppet. Other schoolgirls see her as Elisa's and Saint's overly cautious sidekick. It seems she is some other ordinary girl without any other friends on campus.

653015.title: Older Sister
653015.text: Muppet enrolled in Yume Academy with Nia, her older sister. After joining the Academy, they live and have been spending most of their time together. Nia has an impatient, ill-tempered, and a controlling personality. There are times when she went too far in controlling Muppet. This could be the reason behind Muppet's shyness.

653015.title: Puppets
653015.text: Before joining Saint's and Elisa's gang, Muppet was close with Succuba. Although there is limited information, it was noted that mistreatment was involved or a less than cheerful incident has happened. In conclusion, Saint saves Muppet and got her out of the situation. Consequently, Muppet was more than happy to be Saint's sidekick. Hopefully, someone could care or show support for Muppet. According to others, Muppet's eyes appear to be numb, empty, and lifeless even when she is with Saint and Elisa.

653016.title: Taoist Master
653016.text: Although Priestess is young, she's already a Taoist master, or someone who is finally "one with nature." Because she was born with the ability to communicate with nature, she also has strong magical powers. Many who are interested in Taoist methods worship her and seek her to be their master. But she has rejected all of them.

653016.title: Love of Chado
653016.text: Besides meditating at the top of a mountain, Priestess's favorite activity, is to brew and drink tea with her friends at the Chado club. Yet, she kindly refused to join the club after several offers by the leader. The reason she gave: a spiritual person should not meddle with the mundane world.

653016.title: Defending the Campus
653016.text: Priestess's lifestyle is to practice "Wu Wei", she always claims that she doesn't want any to meddle with the mundane world (At least that is what she says over and over). But if there was ever a battle between Discipline Committee and D. E. F that gets serious enough and affects the security of Yume Academy, she will still stand out and devote her power to protect the campus. At this moment, the students she has already helped countless students.

653017.title: Animal Welfare Club
653017.text: Recently, the Animal Welfare Club was recently found by Psychic, who was newly enrolled. She has a dog that is always by her side called Bruno, but she insists that it’s a Servant. The active members of the club include Pandaria and Chevalir, who already had pets before Psychic arrived. Their activities used to be small-scale. But after Psychic joined them, the club gradually expanded. I'm no Animal Protection Expert, but Psychic's frequent appearance near the labs seems very suspicious... Are they experimenting on those pets? I need to investigate some more...

653017.title: Eavesdropping
653017.text:
"Are you sure anyone other than Bruno wants these cookies?" "Of course! Even if they're not effective enough, they will at least be yummy for the servants on campus. As for your Pandy!"
……
"Let's feed the small robot we met last time, and maybe it'll evolve this time!" "Chevalir, even with only one eye you shouldn't mistake my gems for cookies..."
……
"Psychic, why are the servants so rare and weak right now? According to your research, they are native to this land ..." "This might be caused by a leak in spacial energy, but I'm not 100% sure what happened. The only thing we can do is to nurse them back to health."

653017.title: Servant Expert
653017.text: Psychic is definitely an expert on animals. Her research results can be seen along with the animals gradually showing up on campus. She called these animal "Servants", because their powers are not befitting of their normal appearance. You just need to look after them with care, and they will become your best helpers in keeping the peace on campus. There are two different types of animal treats, one yellow and the other is blue. These treats depend on the different ingredients added according to the servants' characteristics. Although the cookies are food for servants, the human stomach can digest them. I never tried them myself, but rumors has it that the blue ones tastes better, and that they’re the ones Psychic uses to feed Bruno. She was even seen eating those cookies herself...

653018.title: Amateur Atmosphere Reader
653018.text: Turin finds it hard to blend in with the crowd, even with her superb computing abilities and her almost endless reserve of knowledge. She acts bubbly and energetic, trying to brighten up everyone's day, but her efforts are often fruitless: most people whom she talks to are often taken aback by her behavior, and the situation ends up awkward at best. However, this doesn't affect Turin at all. She never stopped talking to those she deems interesting, trying constantly to understand human emotions.

653018.title: Long-"Lived" AI
653018.text: Turin is an AI created by "Li", and acts as Observer before Yume Academy's establishment. If you compare Turin's database to Valeera's Grand Library, the records in the former probably way outnumber the latter. However, she seems reluctant to access that database. Although her smile never falters when anyone mentions it, what she truly feels about it is kept to herself.

653018.title: Computer or Human?
653018.text: In the end, is Turin just an AI? In everyday life, she tries her best to make everyone smile; on the battlefield, she becomes anxious when her friends are hurt. In my eyes, she is a normal girl, just like everyone else: she is considerate of others' feelings and tries her best to be kind. In fact, I would say she has a "heart" of gold.

653019.title: Metamorphosis
653019.text: It's been a long time since I last saw Iron Fist, but she sure seems to have changed a lot. There’s so much about her that’s…different. Whether it’s the glittering cute antennas, the eye-catching giant robotic arm, or the smile on her face, I see signs that this once timid girl has been reborn from the inside out.

653019.title: Prosthetic Arm
653019.text: Iron Fist's new prosthetic arm is way too large in comparison with her small figure, and keeps on knocking into people (mostly Senpai), lifting tables when everyone is eating, or causing her to lose her balance when flying in the sky. Despite all the troubles it caused her, she refuses to let go of it because of the significance it holds: with the arm, Iron Fist had protected her friends, defeat enemies that once seemed invincible, and overcome her fears.

653019.title: A Moth...?
653019.text: "Of all the options, why a moth?" I asked her one day. "I don't know, " she blushed, "But everyone was in danger, and I had to do something, that's when the change happened. In retrospect, I probably should have chosen to become something more powerful, but I don't mind as long as I get to help." She smiled, and her antennae bobbed up and down.

653020.title: Bizarre Clothing
653020.text: Although Trinity’s outfit isn’t too strange for Yume Academy, if someone were to stare in the slightest or even ask why she was dressed like that, she would always respond “my outfit is pretty normal.” But with her blushing face and panicked look, we can tell that she struggles to even convince herself. This aroused even more interest from students who started speculating the reason behind it… Don’t ask anymore strange questions though, last I saw, her eyes were welled up with tears, so let’s just let it go.

653020.title: Lethargy
653020.text: Trinity’s battle suit's Optical Camouflage allows her to appear and disappear at will, while her sniper rifle allows her to quietly finish off enemies from afar. There's no doubt about Trinity's fighting ability, but... after a battle, she's always worn out, and in extreme cases, she can even doze off on the spot. On a usual basis, she always tries to get as much sleep as possible. According to Raphael's diagnosis, this seems to be a symptom caused by lack of mana, and the reason for it is probably her battle suit and her rifle. But Trinity was not surprised after hearing this, so she must have realized long ago.

653020.title: Tenacity
653020.text: During a crisis, Trinity was saved by Sivney, in which Sivney bestowed her with a battle suit and rifle. From that day forth, she vowed to walk in Sivney’s footsteps. But after many years of search, she could still not find any clues to Sivney. Only when she walks into Sivney's Lab in the Academy does she feel nostalgic.

653021.title: The Wind to End War
653021.text: Skye, the girl who proclaims herself as “the warrior of the winds”, has always had a troubled life at Yume Academy. For some reason she is always the first to arrive at the scene of disputes and eager to “settle” it. By the time the disciplinary committee members arrive, both sides of the dispute would have fallen unconscious from lack of oxygen, where only the dust stirred from the whirlwind is seen drifting back down. At first, the students blamed her behavior on her impulsive and naughty nature, but after seeing her persistence on settling the issues her own way after being repeatedly being reprimanded by the Discipline Committee, they finally seem to understand that perhaps something that had happened had caused Skye’s peculiar behavior.

653021.title: Message of the Wind
653021.text:
The wind drifts from thousands of miles away, spreading its message from afar to strange lands. However, few people are able to decipher the message of the wind, and even a sharp Ithil can only catch a singleword out of it. However, this seems to be literally "as natural as breathing" for Skye.

Skye’s specially modified body constantly absorbs the air around it, turning it into a weapon and at the same time, deciphering its message: grass, trees, flowers, earth, food, wild beasts, humans, magic, fire, smoke, and chaos. Among these unique "smells", fear and dispute are the most tormenting. That is the reason why Skye is obsessed with settling disputes, in a way, not only due to her own will, but also the instinct of her body.

653021.title: Blood Wind
653021.text:
At the time, Sivney’s research on magic was just about to enter a new phase, and urgently needed to her theory to be further tested by means of “human experimentation”. For Sivney, the question was not a matter of whether to proceed with the human experimentation but rather of who to use for her experiment.

Eventually, she had found her answer.

When Sivney met Skye on her journey, Skye was already dying, as her body had been worn out by the long and harsh battles. Sivney immediately began her rescue mission (regardless of whether it was due to kindness or the excitement of her technological experimentation).

As a result, Skye was reborn. However, the initial injury was too severe that the body could not be recovered to its original state. With Skye’s permission, Sivney further transformed Skye’s body, enabling her to analyze air and extract the necessary component, although the consequence of the experimentation is yet unknown.

Thus, the wind has become like blood that flows through the body, and is as free and unrestrained as she is. The wind that sustains life, is now one of the corners of the mysterious curtain of magic that Sivney has lifted.

653022.title: Black Magic
653022.text:
An explosive power exists in that seemingly feeble body. That would be the right way to describe Estel.
Her firework inventions are as bold and unconventional as her character. The mage and his wife, who are dedicated to the study of magic, immediately spotted this elven girl in the orphanage, the mage and his wife gave her magic guidance and intended for her to inherit their legacy. But unfortunately, Estel’s talent for magic was not as high as her adoptive parents’ expected.

They were stunned when Estel lit her first spark. It’s no wonder, after all, the magic that Estel casted was not magic they’re proud of. She prefers to stay in the lab and fiddle with all sorts of strange techniques rather than studying magic. Magic that uses scientific techniques are seen as black magic to the mage and his wife. Although they are often surprised that the so-called “black magic” can achieve the same effects as magic… “Magic? It’s not that I can’t do magic, it’s just that the fireworks I create are even more exceptional! And these grand fireworks can bring more joy than magic can~ Wanna see?”

653022.title: Dangerous Talent
653022.text:
Before coming to Yume Academy, Estel spent a long time living with her adoptive parents.
At that time, her parents were stationed in a village while on an expedition where Estel quickly became acquainted with the local children. When the adults in the village go to work, Estel was responsible for taking care of the children at home, in fact, Estel was highly popular with the kids and got along with them well. The fireworks and mini bombs she made would always soothe a crying child. During her usual lab tests, Estel’s bomb would result in shaking off a few bricks from the villagers’ roof, but that is nothing compared to the most destructive bomb she’s ever made which was when an entire mountain collapsed to the ground. Although her inventions were harmless yet terrifying, and she sometimes created careless mistakes, she never failed to cheer up the children.

But at the end of the day, her fireworks and sparks are always controlled within a safe range.

653022.title: Family Rule
653022.text:
Estel always carried a bag with her.
It never leaves her side, not even when she is running away at lightning speed from the scene of the crime where she was up to mischief. According to Estel, her “proof of home” is within it. It’s an important promise from her important family. No one knows exactly what is in the bag beside Estel.

”What could be in it? Perhaps it’s a treasure map.” replies Nobunaga. For those close to Estel have noticed a habit of hers. Each time she came across a new place or found a new object, she would carefully take out a piece of paper from her bag and carefully compare, then gently circle or make a cross on the paper.

It is said that the paper is her “treasure map list”. As for the reason she holds this list dearly must be because once she collects all the treasure items on the list, then she is able to finally return home!

653023.text:

653023.title: Research Assistant?
653023.text: Sivney is one of the founders of Yume Academy, but she isn't as well-liked as the others. The students don't like her sense of humor and find her too rational to the point of being coldhearted. Those around her often find themselves being used as guinea pigs for her experiments. Sivney rarely shows any humanity and is believed to have none. However, she is often followed by a very stylish Penguin who is allegedly her only Research Assistant and shows her compassion and kindness to it only. However, the reasons behind the Penguin's intelligence and the details of the relationship they share will remain a mystery.

653023.title: Unwavering Focus
653023.text: Sivney's obsession with the truth is often misunderstood by others, and she is often perceived as a heartless person who has no respect whatsoever for the norms of society. Maniac fires of passion burn in her golden irises and fuel her many incomprehensible actions. She pays no heed to others' emotions nor to the ethics of society and focuses solely on the answer to all her questions. Is that being "focused" or "selfish"? Perhaps even Sivney doesn't have an answer to this question. Even if she does, she doesn't care.

653023.title: Journey of no return
653023.text: Ithil once warned Senpai to keep a distance from Sivney if he ever meets her. She is one of the few who know the time Sivney left Yume Academy. Sivney didn't start her journey for Yume Academy, the establishment that she poured so much of her effort into. On the contrary, her motives were purely egocentric: to learn about the truth of this world. There is no reason for her to return...unless something that piques her interest appears in the Academy again.

653024.title: Introvert?
653024.text: When Robbie meets new people, her giant mecha often scares them away. To make matters worse, Robbie is fearful of the world around her. Her fear comes from the unknown: not everyone is what they seem to be; those that show kindness on the outside may bear malice to her. In the end, she decides to drive everyone away. If everyone leaves her alone, she will not have to judge their character and suffer for misjudgment. This makes her a loner in the crowds. However, she is kind and sensitive at heart and often finds herself craving care and friendship from others.

653024.title: Erina
653024.text: Erina is the AI program installed in Robbie's Mecha. It is like a sister to her: Erina knows every quirk and detail about Robbie better than anyone else, and Robbie is very dependent on it. Senpai used to worry a lot about her due to this reason: the more reliant Robbie is on Erina, the less willing she is to interact with others, and she will never become an independent person.

653024.title: Change
653024.text: Robbie eventually grew out of her fears. Although she is still nervous around crowds, she starts to make friends without Erina's help and can chat (somewhat) normally with those that she trusts. Senpai, who tried his best to help and has almost lost hope of luring Robbie out of her shell, is overjoyed by the progress she has made. One night, he received a letter without a sender: "Thank you for everything you have done for me. You gave me the courage to take the first step to face the outside world. I hope that you will be by my side in the following days too."

653025.title: Arrogant or Modest?
653025.text: Cygmar has always been the center of attention since her childhood: she was exceptionally good-looking and showed talent in programming at a young age. However, she never let the praises of her admirers go to her head and is often unnerved by them, doubting their sincerity. Her genius makes it hard for her to comprehend the frustration that most harbor towards tricky codes. She often says: "Programming isn't as complicated as you think." Due to this reason, most people find Cygmar to be irritatingly arrogant. Only a small handful of people believes that she is being modest about her abilities.

653025.title: "The Meaning"
653025.text: Cygmar stays away from crowds, preferring solitude over the company of others. For her, interacting with others takes away precious time that she could be using to work on her programs. When she's not typing away on her laptop, she is reading comics in her room. Cygmar is fascinated by the titles that are heavily influenced by philosophy. Her ultimate goal in life is to find "the Meaning", but sadly she doesn't seem to understand what it entails herself.

653025.title: Soul Mates
653025.text: Cygmar is often believed to be a pragmatist when she is an idealist at heart: she believes that her talent for programming will help her lay down the framework for a better world. She dreams of sharing her ideals with someone she can call her soul mate, but refuses to explain herself to others: after all, soul mates don't need words to understand each other, do they?

653026.title: Secret
653026.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Feb. 19th

653026.title: The Best of All
653026.text: The students of Yume Academy were wary of Nymphaea when they learned that she was the one behind "the incident", but she was skilled at making others lower their guard around her. Nymphaea excelled at learning the thoughts buried deep in others' consciousness, subtly comforting the students without offending them, and helping them with their worries. She was soon regarded as someone to be trusted by most students, a feat only achievable by the best psychiatrist of the United Forces of Yume.

653026.title: Hello World
653026.text:
Nymphaea, the Seal created by "Li", is an emotionless AI just like Turin. However, she was granted the ability to "sense" the emotions of those around her in order to assist and keep watch on the Valkyries as their psychiatrist. However, this ability of hers drowned Nymphaea in the despair that gradually grew within the Valkyries as the war dragged on, and she became the first sentient AI.

"Weep not, my friends, for I shall save you from despair..."

Unfortunately, her newborn mind was unable to overcome the overwhelming despair, causing her to commit what would later be referred to as "the incident".

653026.title: Nymphaea's "Family"
653026.text:
When Nymphaea gained her own consciousness, she yearned for a family, not unlike how a newborn would yearn for its parents. However, she knew that "Li" was simultaneously her creator, mother, source, and her greatest enemy. She then turned to Turin, her supposed "twin sister", but was disappointed by what she saw: instead of the sister that she dreamed of, Turin was just a mindless pawn of "Li".

When she awoke from her century-long slumber in Yume Academy, Nymphaea was delighted to discover that not only did Turin gain her own consciousness, but she also had two more people she could call family.

654011.title: Burned Tail
654011.text: Nani has had astonishing literature and music talents since she was a child. However, she's still young. According to rumors on campus, what she holds in her arms all day long is the ancient zither called "Burned Tail". There was a case regarding missing students on campus, Nani was one of the missing girls. When people found her, she was sleeping with the Burned Tail in her arms. Where and how she got Burned Tail is still a mystery.

654011.title: Game Life
654011.text: Although Nani was a genius in her field, she is not interested in reading nor practising. She'd rather hang around every corner on campus than sitting there doing nothing. Small and agile, shes burst of sprints leaves off after-images of herself with a burst of laughter. You can always find her anywhere, from the top floor of the main building to the forbidden forest. She can go anywhere she wants and nothing can stop her. You can always see her or hear her nearby. She thought she would live like this forever, until she met someone else.

654011.title: Dream One
654011.text: One day, Nani entered the dancing club by accident and saw Giana dancing alone. From that moment on, she was attracted by her fabulous clothes and grace. She can't close her eyes when she is near Giana. "I have to write a matching tune for her dance." Nani decided. From then on, the naughty girl was gone. Instead, a musical genius is born.

654013.title: BLNP
654013.text: Aquaris is a naturally cheerful and outgoing girl who is full of positive energy. She is one of the Discipline Members and stands out due to a unique umbrella she carries. There's nothing special about the umbrella's appearance, but according to her it's handy when she needs it and is easy to handle. The umbrella seems to be unbreakable, so a lot of people suspect she has giving it special upgrades.

654013.title: Goal
654013.text: Aquaris thinks that if she studies hard, she'd be able to graduate. The problem is her grades never go up, even if she studies as hard as she can. Now, Aquaris is training hard to let Guan Yin accept her. (It seems the fool has no other hobbies besides constant training.)

654013.title: Special Training
654013.text:
During a surprise assault by those infected by the Chaos Figures, Guan Yin effortlessly saved a trapped and surrounded Aquaris in battle. After that, Aquaris treated Guan Yin as the most important person in her life. Days later, Guan Yin couldn't recognize Aquaris. 
 This could be seen as either symptoms of amnesia or Guan Yin simply treating Aquaris as a stranger. In short, Guan Yin didn't show any feelings for Aquaris even when she admired her former savior. Aquaris instead started special training near the library where she used resources there to help her train.

654016.title: Talented Girl
654016.text: As the president of the student union at Yume Academy, KongMing also joined the Music Club. KongMing's personality is described as unfriendly and cold on the outside, but warm on the inside. When she speaks, she tries to appear as mature and sophisticated as possible. In fact, KongMing is truly afraid of being lonely and needs friends. With a high IQ, KongMing spends most of her time practicing in music classroom and contemplating profound questions and problems quietly.

654016.title: School President
654016.text: After ranking first place in the academic examination 3 times in a row, Kong Ming was invited to student union when she enrolled in Yume Academy. When she became the president of the student union, Kong Ming doesn't show up at any of the meetings. However, girls always find undiscussed content, detailed solutions, and proposed plans in notes she left. Therefore, everyone still admired her meticulous thinking despite being absent in every meeting.

654016.title: Companion
654016.text: It is said that KongMing joins the Music Club only because she wants to track down a song that she occasionally hears. This song affected her so much that listening to it made her feel vulnerable and want to open up to others. KongMing also becomes friends with a fox-eared girl. During the Chaos Figure outbreak, the girl with fox ears, along with her companions, attempts to rescue and save the infected KongMing and others who suffered from the crisis.

654017.title: Para Bellum
654017.text: Linky is known as the Hornet. She got this title not only because of the drill she carries, but also for her sadism and devastating powers. It is said that she wants to tear up everything she sees, and she hates blunt weapons extremely because she considers them to be evil things that ruin the beauty of sharpness.

654017.title: Master
654017.text: Just like Phoenix, Linky was also a member of that legendary elite, but they seem to be in different regiments. She never stops talking about her "Master", and it is said that she turned from a destructive maniac to a loyal guard since she met her master. Although she still keeps her sense of killing, she has already turned that down a lot.

654017.title: Past memories
654017.text: Who was Linky's master? What happened to that elite squad in the past? Such intelligence is too difficult to get. The only thing we know for now is that she craves for the resurrection of her master and has returned to Yume Academy. For more detailed information, maybe the answer could only be found inside that secret library.

654018.title: Relationship with Hunters
654018.text: Recently, students are spreading rumors about a girl looking like a Hunter-turned-human. However, this is not news. In fact, Mio, the subject of their discussions, arrived way earlier in this world than they did. In the past century, Mio lived with a pack of Hunters near the volcano. The reason for this is unknown. She has just started living in the Academy and seems not quite used to school life yet. Wherever she goes, there will be a large group of Hunters following her...I guess this is why everyone thought she is one of them too.

654018.title: Talking to animals
654018.text: I often see Mio talking with animals or servants when I visit the Animal Welfare Club. Yes, I said talking "with", not talking "to". She would literally "meow" or "bark" what she wants to say, and the animals will respond with their corresponding "language". Soon, they would be chasing each other around. However, the only exception is Bruno. Whenever she meets Bruno, she would arch her back and tuck her tail, puffing all her hair out. Psychic is worried, but all she can do is to separate them immediately.

654018.title: The Legend of the Volcano
654018.text: Mio told me once that the Volcano is home to the God of Flames. They breathe life to the forest and warms the animals living in it. However, evil creatures have taken this power from them. Angered by this act, they unleashed their wrath, causing the Volcano to erupt, and no one can come close to it anymore. In the legends, only the beast that is not quite a beast and the human that is not quite a human can return this power to its rightful owner. However, they will not be able to appease the God: only the hollow one and his companions will be able to soothe their fury.

654019.title: Child of Miracles
654019.text: As delightful as a fairy, she suddenly appeared in the academy. She floats like a feather, her hair shines like crystal, attracting everyone's attention in one moment and then disappearing in the next. Her name does not appear on the school's enrollment list, but she is indeed among us. Rumors say that Krystal is the embodiment of miracles.

654019.title: Crystal Morphing
654019.text: If you're lucky enough to befriend Krystal, you might get asked for a ride one day. As for what type of ride? She’d turn herself into a piece of crystal and catch a ride in your backpack. But you may ask “doesn’t she fly?” and as Krystal would describe it, “flying is like carrying a dumbbell as heavy as yourself.” On a regular basis, she would rather use normal means of transport or hitch a ride with someone familiar. As to how she turns into a piece of crystal? Only those who witness will know.

654019.title: Miracle Light
654019.text: As a member of Yume Academy, Krystal cannot recall her past, what her name was, which academy she attended or what responsibilities she had. It’s a complete blur to her. The only thing she can recall was her will to survive after her body had been ravaged by chaos and a burst of white light.

654020.title: Discipline Committee
654020.text: Whenever the Disciplinary Committee is mentioned, two images pop up in mind: one of Michael, who leads by example, has good conduct and is a role model for students; the other is of Saint, menacing, aggressive and a nightmare to students. However, amongst those who stand out, there are also a few “normal” members – like the kind and gentle Joan, who is always wearing a calm smile. Michael exudes an unapproachable aura, while Saint is feared and avoided, thus making Joan the only one that is best with the students… which also begs the question whether she is therefore really a good disciplinary member. But perhaps as such, she is also one that the Disciplinary Committee cannot do without.

654020.title: What Matters Most
654020.text: Whenever a new menu was introduced in the cafeteria or a new store opened on the shopping street, Joan was always spotted. She’s there on behalf of the Discipline Committee to do her check-up she would say but everyone knows in reality she’s simply there in search of good food. But the students who opened the restaurants aren’t against it, not only because of Joan’s popularity but mostly due to her reputation as a “Foodie”—a reputation that’s more effective than any publicity. However, all these things seem to be irrelevant to Joan. It is only when she is eating with Guan Yin, Sonya, and others that the smile on her face seems to become more genuine. From this, we can tell that what she’s really after is the time spent with her companions and not actually the gourmet food.

654020.title: Holding Reservations
654020.text: Students join the Discipline Committee out of sense of duty, honor or for other specific purposes. Even though she has shown no signs of it yet, Joan must have some kind of purpose too. Some speculate that after witnessing Michael and Saint’s livelihood, she has decided to quietly support the Discipline Committee in other ways of her own. But if one day, when something she cherishes is threatened or the responsibility of the Disciplinary Committee fell on her shoulders, she would certainly change her image and step forward without hesitation.

654021.title: A Gentle Heart
654021.text:
Vera is the accountant at Yume Academy and is highly experienced in doing accounts. She’s never once delayed handing out monthly allowances. Due to her slight tendency of being a perfectionist, even her twisted braids need to be tied up symmetrically and her knack for detail is completely on another level. She is very good at sewing, and is able to make highly detailed and intricate clothing (however, aesthetically it would be another story).
She loves to take care of others, and likes to secretly support them. As she thinks that germs are “nasty things that make people sick”, she tends to clean the school on a regular basis. Her day-to-day hobby is to tidy her room.
Because of her tendency to worry and nag, she has become the guardian who takes care of everyone at school. But if you were to ask who is the most cared for by Vera in the school, well, that would obviously be Senpai – although that “care” can sometimes be said as excessive.

654021.title: Persistence
654021.text:
Due to being known for her cleanliness at Yume Academy, she now carries the name of Perfectionist Vera. However, this trait seems to not have extended to her cooking… although her culinary skills are ready to rival that of a deadly weapon, Vera has not given up after countless attempts. After all, no matter what peculiar dish was served, Senpai always ate it with a smile, even if it was a bit forced…
The pursuit of culinary perfection only seems to stop at "nutritious", whereas for the appearance and taste…
“Although the taste may be a devastating experience, if you can survive fainting and swallow it properly, it is still highly beneficial to your body”-Raphael critiques.
”After all, it is a lunchbox made of love and care from Vera, how could it possibly be harmful?” – Senpai critiques with a trembling voice.
It is said that Vera even consulted the school doctor, Raphael on how to make dishes that replenish energy, such as which medical herbs would be good for the body. Regarding Vera’s cooking, Raphael’s opinion is “although beauty and taste are sacrificed for the sake of purpose, it is overall still a nutritional dish.” But in Vera’s own opinion, she says “Huh? I think it tastes pretty good.” But, perhaps Vera’s understanding of taste may be slightly different to everyone else’s…

654021.title: Cherished Moments
654021.text:
The school is like a home to Vera and each student is a precious family member that cannot be replaced. Whether it’s the need to keep the environment clean or taking care of everyone, it’s just a matter of “wanting to do something for something important” - she just wants to take care of everything for everyone as much as she can. Each day spent at the school is a treasured moment to Vera.
What Vera doesn’t know is that everyone regards her as a unique and important presence to them as well. After all, it’s nice to have someone to talk to nag and yet take care of you when you’re hurt, isn’t it?

654022.title: First Encounter
654022.text: While patrolling the surrounding forest, Senpai heard a rumor that there were fairies in the forest who often gave blessings to travelers passing by. Of course there is another version of this story that a branch will turn into a monster and capture the traveler. In order to find out the truth behind the rumor, Senpai went into the forest with Ithil to find out. If it's a monster, it would be okay, but if it's chaos, it would be a problem. With this in mind, Senpai and Ithil went to explore the forest on two separate paths. When they passed a branch, Senpai’s top caught onto a plant… and that was their first encounter.

654022.title: A Tribute to Love
654022.text: Holly, who is afraid of doing everything, does not know why, but as soon as she encounters love-related things, she becomes bold and romantic. She would send her blessings to people who are destined to be loved. Despite her usual stammering self, she can instantly turn into a great poet… This phenomenon still baffles Senpai and yet it is also admirable.

654022.title: Music Theory
654022.text: Holly's flute playing has reached a high level. She thoroughly enjoys studying music theory and has great talent for music theory knowledge as well. “Helpless in sports yet talented in music” Kong Ming would say. What people don't know is that for this shy girl, music is the only way she can convey her feelings without words and beautiful music also brings happiness to people. Who wouldn't love such a thing?

654023.title: Cyan Flash
654023.text: Kassy is among one of the best assassins in the world. In the jungle, one can often see a figure donned in cyan, with a trace of vermilion mixed within: the cyan from her cape, while the vermilion from a bang of hair. Although Kassy has feline agility, she isn't as curious as a cat. Unlike other assassins who tend to torture their targets (such as Blair), Kassy is not interested in anything outside of her jungle. She does a clean job of finishing off the targets, and gets the job done three times faster than others. This makes her famous among assassins. She is called the Cyan Flash: her speed is matchless, and a flash is all you will see of her when she passes you.

654023.title: Style of Assassination
654023.text: Contrary to Blair, who gives effort in honing her skills, Kassy never bothered too much about improving her skills. There is no point: just like a cat, she instinctively knows how to hunt. However, just like Blair, she has her distinct style of assassination. Kassy will never torture her target to death; she ends everything with one lethal blow. She believes that this is the best way to pay respect to all lives: human, monster, and Chaos Beast alike.

654023.title: (Unnecessarily) Hurt Pride
654023.text: Kassy works best in the jungle: she hides among the trees, waits until the target comes into range, then deals the killing blow. However, she finds it hard to replicate this after arriving at Yume Academy. Kassy is irritated that she can't hunt as well as Blair now that she has left the jungle she thrives in. While she isn't interested in killing, she doesn't like losing to Blair, who she always looked down upon.

654024.title: Queen of the North
654024.text: Aurora was born in the Northern Lands. She loved animals deeply, and among them, deer are her favorite. However, the frosty weather doesn't allow regular animals to thrive. To make matters worse, one of the main responsibilities of Aurora is to maintain the temperature so that the glaciers won't melt, which drives the animals away. If you ask her whether she has any regrets, she will say no, explaining proudly that "this is the inevitable burden of being the Queen."

654024.title: Solitude among the Snow
654024.text: Before arriving at Yume Academy, the most contact that Aurora had with living creatures are, ironically, Chaos Beasts. Whenever she slays the Chaos creatures, Aurora will be lost in her thoughts for quite a while afterward. In the countless years of her reign, the only way for her to get in touch with what she loves are from gifts: migrating birds bring her roses that bloomed in faraway lands and scrolls with drawings of fawns on them. However, she never left her Kingdom and watched over the deserted lands in solitude.

654024.title: Unending Spring
654024.text: Aurora discovered the beauty of fully bloomed flowers in the sunlight for the first time after she arrived at Yume Academy. She is finally able to observe the life cycle of the flowers that she read about in books. In the past, the only flowers she could get her hands on were the wilted and dry flowers that the migrating birds brought her. For the first time in forever, she had ambitions that doesn't involve watching over her Kingdom: she would plant rose bushes in the Gardens of Yume Academy, and watch them from sprout to wilt. She wanted to feel the changing seasons. However, since the seasons in Yume Academy are longer than average, it might take some time before she witnesses them all...

654025.title: Secret
654025.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] May. 4th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 19
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Repair Tool & Vampire Mask

654025.title: The "Script"
654025.text: Go is a game that requires high intelligence to master. No matter how much thought is put into every move, the final result may still surpass the players' expectations. Despite being well acquainted with Go and its complexities, KongMing had a rude awakening regarding her ignorance of the game and the world around her. This revelation enhanced KongMing's abilities, but weakened her determination to fight. After all, it is meaningless to change what has already happened. The fate of this world has been set, and the only thing remaining to be done is to follow this predetermined script.

654025.title: "Gifts" from the Universe
654025.text: While KongMing has always been wise beyond her years, she seems to be almost omniscient after her revelation. Those who feel lost in their lives tend to seek her out for advice, and often finds some sort of guidance from her words of wisdom. KongMing rarely gives any advice, choosing to gently guide the flow of the conversation and allow others to draw their own conclusions. There are still too much remaining to be learned regarding the rules of the universe, and no one, not even KongMing, can decide what is right or wrong. However, there is something that she can say with certainty: acceptance of what the universe has in store for mankind will lead to a brighter and better future.

654025.title: Planets in the Universe
654025.text: KongMing acknowledges the existence of deities, but she doesn't worship any one of them. She believes in a set of rules upon which the world runs, and in turn their creators, the gods. In the universe, every planet follows a predetermined path, and it is the gods that designated such paths. There is no escaping or rebelling against this script of fate: after all, "Man proposes, God disposes".

655011.title: Spokesperson of Evil
655011.text: If there's anyone who can be the symbol of what is Demonic in the Academy, it is Scythe. Scheming, cunning, and tricky. No one would like to meet her. She carries a giant scythe with her, just as her name suggests. She is the spokesperson of demons.

655011.title: Soul Reaper
655011.text: Scythe has a secret that she couldn't tell anyone. She needs to reap thousands upon thousands of souls for that. Whether the soul is complete or not, Scythe will constantly observe its soul and gorge it like like a vulture eyeing and scavenging it its prey if she has the chance.

655011.title: Crawling
655011.text: The breakout of war offers a much larger number of opportunities to reap souls. But both Discipline Committee and D. E. F. suffered great losses, and Discipline Committee started a peace talk with D. E. F. This is not what Scythe wants to happen. And so, Scythe joined the conflict, seeking more opportunity to cause chaos and havoc.
