754009.title: Talented Girl
754009.text: As the president of the student union at Yume Academy, KongMing also joined the Music Club. KongMing's personality is described as unfriendly and cold on the outside, but warm on the inside. When she speaks, she tries to appear as mature and sophisticated as possible. In fact, KongMing is truly afraid of being lonely and needs friends. With a high IQ, KongMing spends most of her time practicing in music classroom and contemplating profound questions and problems quietly.

754009.title: School President
754009.text: After ranking first place in the academic examination 3 times in a row, Kong Ming was invited to student union when she enrolled in Yume Academy. When she became the president of the student union, Kong Ming doesn't show up at any of the meetings. However, girls always find undiscussed content, detailed solutions, and proposed plans in notes she left. Therefore, everyone still admired her meticulous thinking despite being absent in every meeting.

754009.title: Companion
754009.text: It is said that KongMing joins the Music Club only because she wants to track down a song that she occasionally hears. This song affected her so much that listening to it made her feel vulnerable and want to open up to others. KongMing also becomes friends with a fox-eared girl. During the Chaos Figure outbreak, the girl with fox ears, along with her companions, attempts to rescue and save the infected KongMing and others who suffered from the crisis.

754010.title: Secret
754010.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] May 20th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 17
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Skull Pillow & Camera
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Pen & Kunai

754010.title: Para Bellum
754010.text: Linky is known as the Hornet. She got this title not only because of the drill she carries, but also for her sadism and devastating powers. It is said that she wants to tear up everything she sees, and she hates blunt weapons extremely because she considers them to be evil things that ruin the beauty of sharpness.

754010.title: Master
754010.text: Just like Phoenix, Linky was also a member of that legendary elite, but they seem to be in different regiments. She never stops talking about her "Master", and it is said that she turned from a destructive maniac to a loyal guard since she met her master. Although she still keeps her sense of killing, she has already turned that down a lot.

754010.title: Past memories
754010.text: Who was Linky's master? What happened to that elite squad in the past? Such intelligence is too difficult to get. The only thing we know for now is that she craves for the resurrection of her master and has returned to Yume Academy. For more detailed information, maybe the answer could only be found inside that secret library.

754011.title: Secret
754011.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Jun. 6th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 16
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Fox Mask & Headband
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Canned Fish & Turkey

754011.title: Relationship with Hunters
754011.text: Recently, students are spreading rumors about a girl looking like a Hunter-turned-human. However, this is not news. In fact, Mio, the subject of their discussions, arrived way earlier in this world than they did. In the past century, Mio lived with a pack of Hunters near the volcano. The reason for this is unknown. She has just started living in the Academy and seems not quite used to school life yet. Wherever she goes, there will be a large group of Hunters following her...I guess this is why everyone thought she is one of them too.

754011.title: Talking to animals
754011.text: I often see Mio talking with animals or servants when I visit the Animal Welfare Club. Yes, I said talking "with", not talking "to". She would literally "meow" or "bark" what she wants to say, and the animals will respond with their corresponding "language". Soon, they would be chasing each other around. However, the only exception is Bruno. Whenever she meets Bruno, she would arch her back and tuck her tail, puffing all her hair out. Psychic is worried, but all she can do is to separate them immediately.

754011.title: The Legend of the Volcano
754011.text: Mio told me once that the Volcano is home to the God of Flames. They breathe life to the forest and warms the animals living in it. However, evil creatures have taken this power from them. Angered by this act, they unleashed their wrath, causing the Volcano to erupt, and no one can come close to it anymore. In the legends, only the beast that is not quite a beast and the human that is not quite a human can return this power to its rightful owner. However, they will not be able to appease the God: only the hollow one and his companions will be able to soothe their fury.

754012.title: Secret
754012.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Dec. 12th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 15
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Vampire Mask
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Mystic Rose & Ecological Bottle

754012.title: Child of Miracles
754012.text: As delightful as a fairy, she suddenly appeared in the academy. She floats like a feather, her hair shines like crystal, attracting everyone's attention in one moment and then disappearing in the next. Her name does not appear on the school's enrollment list, but she is indeed among us. Rumors say that Krystal is the embodiment of miracles.

754012.title: Crystal Morphing
754012.text: If you're lucky enough to befriend Krystal, you might get asked for a ride one day. As for what type of ride? She’d turn herself into a piece of crystal and catch a ride in your backpack. But you may ask “doesn’t she fly?” and as Krystal would describe it, “flying is like carrying a dumbbell as heavy as yourself.” On a regular basis, she would rather use normal means of transport or hitch a ride with someone familiar. As to how she turns into a piece of crystal? Only those who witness will know.

754012.title: Miracle Light
754012.text: As a member of Yume Academy, Krystal cannot recall her past, what her name was, which academy she attended or what responsibilities she had. It’s a complete blur to her. The only thing she can recall was her will to survive after her body had been ravaged by chaos and a burst of white light.

754013.title: Discipline Committee
754013.text: Whenever the Disciplinary Committee is mentioned, two images pop up in mind: one of Michael, who leads by example, has good conduct and is a role model for students; the other is of Saint, menacing, aggressive and a nightmare to students. However, amongst those who stand out, there are also a few “normal” members – like the kind and gentle Joan, who is always wearing a calm smile. Michael exudes an unapproachable aura, while Saint is feared and avoided, thus making Joan the only one that is best with the students… which also begs the question whether she is therefore really a good disciplinary member. But perhaps as such, she is also one that the Disciplinary Committee cannot do without.

754013.title: What Matters Most
754013.text: Whenever a new menu was introduced in the cafeteria or a new store opened on the shopping street, Joan was always spotted. She’s there on behalf of the Discipline Committee to do her check-up she would say but everyone knows in reality she’s simply there in search of good food. But the students who opened the restaurants aren’t against it, not only because of Joan’s popularity but mostly due to her reputation as a “Foodie”—a reputation that’s more effective than any publicity. However, all these things seem to be irrelevant to Joan. It is only when she is eating with Guan Yin, Sonya, and others that the smile on her face seems to become more genuine. From this, we can tell that what she’s really after is the time spent with her companions and not actually the gourmet food.

754013.title: Holding Reservations
754013.text: Students join the Discipline Committee out of sense of duty, honor or for other specific purposes. Even though she has shown no signs of it yet, Joan must have some kind of purpose too. Some speculate that after witnessing Michael and Saint’s livelihood, she has decided to quietly support the Discipline Committee in other ways of her own. But if one day, when something she cherishes is threatened or the responsibility of the Disciplinary Committee fell on her shoulders, she would certainly change her image and step forward without hesitation.

754014.title: A Gentle Heart
754014.text:
Vera is the accountant at Yume Academy and is highly experienced in doing accounts. She’s never once delayed handing out monthly allowances. Due to her slight tendency of being a perfectionist, even her twisted braids need to be tied up symmetrically and her knack for detail is completely on another level. She is very good at sewing, and is able to make highly detailed and intricate clothing (however, aesthetically it would be another story).
She loves to take care of others, and likes to secretly support them. As she thinks that germs are “nasty things that make people sick”, she tends to clean the school on a regular basis. Her day-to-day hobby is to tidy her room.
Because of her tendency to worry and nag, she has become the guardian who takes care of everyone at school. But if you were to ask who is the most cared for by Vera in the school, well, that would obviously be Senpai – although that “care” can sometimes be said as excessive.

754014.title: Persistence
754014.text:
Due to being known for her cleanliness at Yume Academy, she now carries the name of Perfectionist Vera. However, this trait seems to not have extended to her cooking… although her culinary skills are ready to rival that of a deadly weapon, Vera has not given up after countless attempts. After all, no matter what peculiar dish was served, Senpai always ate it with a smile, even if it was a bit forced…
The pursuit of culinary perfection only seems to stop at "nutritious", whereas for the appearance and taste…
“Although the taste may be a devastating experience, if you can survive fainting and swallow it properly, it is still highly beneficial to your body”-Raphael critiques.
”After all, it is a lunchbox made of love and care from Vera, how could it possibly be harmful?” – Senpai critiques with a trembling voice.
It is said that Vera even consulted the school doctor, Raphael on how to make dishes that replenish energy, such as which medical herbs would be good for the body. Regarding Vera’s cooking, Raphael’s opinion is “although beauty and taste are sacrificed for the sake of purpose, it is overall still a nutritional dish.” But in Vera’s own opinion, she says “Huh? I think it tastes pretty good.” But, perhaps Vera’s understanding of taste may be slightly different to everyone else’s…

754014.title: Cherished Moments
754014.text:
The school is like a home to Vera and each student is a precious family member that cannot be replaced. Whether it’s the need to keep the environment clean or taking care of everyone, it’s just a matter of “wanting to do something for something important” - she just wants to take care of everything for everyone as much as she can. Each day spent at the school is a treasured moment to Vera.
What Vera doesn’t know is that everyone regards her as a unique and important presence to them as well. After all, it’s nice to have someone to talk to nag and yet take care of you when you’re hurt, isn’t it?

754015.title: First Encounter
754015.text: While patrolling the surrounding forest, Senpai heard a rumor that there were fairies in the forest who often gave blessings to travelers passing by. Of course there is another version of this story that a branch will turn into a monster and capture the traveler. In order to find out the truth behind the rumor, Senpai went into the forest with Ithil to find out. If it's a monster, it would be okay, but if it's chaos, it would be a problem. With this in mind, Senpai and Ithil went to explore the forest on two separate paths. When they passed a branch, Senpai’s top caught onto a plant… and that was their first encounter.

754015.title: A Tribute to Love
754015.text: Holly, who is afraid of doing everything, does not know why, but as soon as she encounters love-related things, she becomes bold and romantic. She would send her blessings to people who are destined to be loved. Despite her usual stammering self, she can instantly turn into a great poet… This phenomenon still baffles Senpai and yet it is also admirable.

754015.title: Music Theory
754015.text: Holly's flute playing has reached a high level. She thoroughly enjoys studying music theory and has great talent for music theory knowledge as well. “Helpless in sports yet talented in music” Kong Ming would say. What people don't know is that for this shy girl, music is the only way she can convey her feelings without words and beautiful music also brings happiness to people. Who wouldn't love such a thing?

754016.title: Secret
754016.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Jan. 26th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 21
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Chess Piece & Amulet
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Fox Mask & Ecological Bottle

754016.title: Cyan Flash
754016.text: Kassy is among one of the best assassins in the world. In the jungle, one can often see a figure donned in cyan, with a trace of vermilion mixed within: the cyan from her cape, while the vermilion from a bang of hair. Although Kassy has feline agility, she isn't as curious as a cat. Unlike other assassins who tend to torture their targets (such as Blair), Kassy is not interested in anything outside of her jungle. She does a clean job of finishing off the targets, and gets the job done three times faster than others. This makes her famous among assassins. She is called the Cyan Flash: her speed is matchless, and a flash is all you will see of her when she passes you.

754016.title: Style of Assassination
754016.text: Contrary to Blair, who gives effort in honing her skills, Kassy never bothered too much about improving her skills. There is no point: just like a cat, she instinctively knows how to hunt. However, just like Blair, she has her distinct style of assassination. Kassy will never torture her target to death; she ends everything with one lethal blow. She believes that this is the best way to pay respect to all lives: human, monster, and Chaos Beast alike.

754016.title: (Unnecessarily) Hurt Pride
754016.text: Kassy works best in the jungle: she hides among the trees, waits until the target comes into range, then deals the killing blow. However, she finds it hard to replicate this after arriving at Yume Academy. Kassy is irritated that she can't hunt as well as Blair now that she has left the jungle she thrives in. While she isn't interested in killing, she doesn't like losing to Blair, who she always looked down upon.

754017.title: Secret
754017.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c]Sep. 26th
[c][f55090]Age (in appearance):[-][/c]21
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Skull Pillow
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Scarf & Cactus

754017.title: Queen of the North
754017.text: Aurora was born in the Northern Lands. She loved animals deeply, and among them, deer are her favorite. However, the frosty weather doesn't allow regular animals to thrive. To make matters worse, one of the main responsibilities of Aurora is to maintain the temperature so that the glaciers won't melt, which drives the animals away. If you ask her whether she has any regrets, she will say no, explaining proudly that "this is the inevitable burden of being the Queen."

754017.title: Solitude among the Snow
754017.text: Before arriving at Yume Academy, the most contact that Aurora had with living creatures are, ironically, Chaos Beasts. Whenever she slays the Chaos creatures, Aurora will be lost in her thoughts for quite a while afterward. In the countless years of her reign, the only way for her to get in touch with what she loves are from gifts: migrating birds bring her roses that bloomed in faraway lands and scrolls with drawings of fawns on them. However, she never left her Kingdom and watched over the deserted lands in solitude.

754017.title: Unending Spring
754017.text: Aurora discovered the beauty of fully bloomed flowers in the sunlight for the first time after she arrived at Yume Academy. She is finally able to observe the life cycle of the flowers that she read about in books. In the past, the only flowers she could get her hands on were the wilted and dry flowers that the migrating birds brought her. For the first time in forever, she had ambitions that doesn't involve watching over her Kingdom: she would plant rose bushes in the Gardens of Yume Academy, and watch them from sprout to wilt. She wanted to feel the changing seasons. However, since the seasons in Yume Academy are longer than average, it might take some time before she witnesses them all...

754018.title: Secret
754018.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] May. 4th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 19
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Repair Tool & Vampire Mask
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Black Tea & Notebook

754018.title: The "Script"
754018.text: Go is a game that requires high intelligence to master. No matter how much thought is put into every move, the final result may still surpass the players' expectations. Despite being well acquainted with Go and its complexities, KongMing had a rude awakening regarding her ignorance of the game and the world around her. This revelation enhanced KongMing's abilities, but weakened her determination to fight. After all, it is meaningless to change what has already happened. The fate of this world has been set, and the only thing remaining to be done is to follow this predetermined script.

754018.title: "Gifts" from the Universe
754018.text: While KongMing has always been wise beyond her years, she seems to be almost omniscient after her revelation. Those who feel lost in their lives tend to seek her out for advice, and often finds some sort of guidance from her words of wisdom. KongMing rarely gives any advice, choosing to gently guide the flow of the conversation and allow others to draw their own conclusions. There are still too much remaining to be learned regarding the rules of the universe, and no one, not even KongMing, can decide what is right or wrong. However, there is something that she can say with certainty: acceptance of what the universe has in store for mankind will lead to a brighter and better future.

754018.title: Planets in the Universe
754018.text: KongMing acknowledges the existence of deities, but she doesn't worship any one of them. She believes in a set of rules upon which the world runs, and in turn their creators, the gods. In the universe, every planet follows a predetermined path, and it is the gods that designated such paths. There is no escaping or rebelling against this script of fate: after all, "Man proposes, God disposes".

755001.title: Secret
755001.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Nov. 1st
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 19
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Turkey & Angel Halo
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Canned Fish & Skull Pillow

755001.title: Dark Gift
755001.text: Amelia was born with an exceptional interest in dark magic. After researching a huge number of reading documents regarding dark magic, she came to a conclusion: Black magic is no different from other schools of magic, and there is no inherent good or evil within magic itself. What is good and bad depends on its users. So she began to learn dark magic without guilt and becomes a true warlock.

755001.title: Dark Prophecy
755001.text: Out of all the schools in dark magic, Amelia can predict and forecast the future the best. There are many types of dark prediction, and the most famous one is to predict by observing stars and celestial bodies. Also, Amelia predicts with her instincts. Even without help from any theory or system, Amelia could predict the future as accurately as Scythe could.

755001.title: Dark Future
755001.text: During an occasional prediction, Amelia saw carnage, mayhem, and reign of terror. It was Yume Academy's Judgment Day. This made her tremble in fear. The prediction was so profound that she started observing Academy's campus secretly, looking for the source of the apocalypse.

755002.title: Secret
755002.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Nov. 1st
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 18
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Puppet & Angel Halo
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Vampire Mask

755002.title: Spokesperson of Evil
755002.text: If there's anyone who can be the symbol of what is Demonic in the Academy, it is Scythe. Scheming, cunning, and tricky. No one would like to meet her. She carries a giant scythe with her, just as her name suggests. She is the spokesperson of demons.

755002.title: Soul Reaper
755002.text: Scythe has a secret that she couldn't tell anyone. She needs to reap thousands upon thousands of souls for that. Whether the soul is complete or not, Scythe will constantly observe its soul and gorge it like like a vulture eyeing and scavenging it its prey if she has the chance.

755002.title: Crawling
755002.text: The breakout of war offers a much larger number of opportunities to reap souls. But both Discipline Committee and D. E. F. suffered great losses, and Discipline Committee started a peace talk with D. E. F. This is not what Scythe wants to happen. And so, Scythe joined the conflict, seeking more opportunity to cause chaos and havoc.

755003.title: Secret
755003.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Oct. 12th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 17
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Fox Mask & Camera
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Skull Pillow

755003.title: Dark & Light
755003.text: Don't let Lucifer's cold and elegant appearance fool you. She is a total messy geek who stays at home all day. She completely relies on her friend Michael. She even needs Michael to wake her up every day. She acts and does things recklessly before thinking it over, which often causes a lot of trouble to people around her. Only Michael is able to calm her down.

755003.title: The Fallen
755003.text: Lucifer's biggest hobby is to stay in the dorm and hang out with Michael. But Michael seems to not be too satisfied with her lifestyle and always make her go out. When Lucifer stood in the middle of the stage at a music festival, Shining Band, she surprised Michael and attracted a lot of schoolgirls with her free-spirited and excellent guitar play. Thus, providing the audience with an extremely charm side to her reckless personality. "The Fallen" became her nickname ever since.

755003.title: A Distant Dream
755003.text:
This silver-haired girl was surrounded by countless twisted souls of the deceased. Darkness has taken a hold of her, turning her pure holy wings black. She lost all sense of reason and descends into madness, any place that her power leaked into were charred and turned into ashes. As death spiral and circle over an ancient city, the helpless innocent city residents could do nothing but hide beneath the city ruins, tremble, and pray for a miracle. Finally, the golden-hair angel, with the giant white cross, pierce through the chest of the evil with silver hair.

"Wake up, it's school time!" Lucifer was woken up by Michael--- the girl with Golden hair.

755004.title: Communication Issues
755004.text: It has been very difficult to get a chance to communicate with Wraith. She tricked me three times when I explained my intentions to her. When I told her that interviewing her would make fewer people disturb her, she finally agreed to talk to me. She stole my pen and hairpin way before I even noticed...

755004.title: Spectre?
755004.text: Wraith is a ghost, or at least that's what she wants others to believe. I think her activity range might be restricted to the abandoned dorm building, as she is never seen anywhere else. She probably dislikes sunshine, otherwise the windows of her room shouldn't be shut all the time. She must hate the living a lot because there's never a "welcomed visitor" to her domain.

755004.title: Spectre!
755004.text: Wraith is indeed a ghost. A very happy one. She is happy because she is not confined to a body. She has ghost friends playing with name No. 1 and No. 2, and do not have to be looked at differently by others. She had been forbiddened in that room for so long that she didn't even know much about the world outside. She was simply afraid of any social interactions. After setting her a time to meet, I'll get Lucifer to come and talk to her. House Demon will surely welcome such a new student. When she joins the school, she will be protected by the school rules. This will surely put an end to those curious people who disturb her.

755005.title: Secret
755005.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Feb. 22nd
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 18
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Slingshot & Kunai
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Angel Halo & Ribbon

755005.title: Angel&Demon
755005.text: "The twins of fate arrive upon this land, one being the angel that spreads the gospel, one being the demon that spreads disaster. Only when they are merged together can they achieve true balance." This is the first memory of Esau and Jacob, and also their doomed fate. Esau's was cheerful and simple, her pure appearance making her loved by the people; whereas Jacob was repressed and restrained, her strange black wings were disgusted by others. Such big contrasts, however, never caused them to part ways. They rely on each other like light and dark, supporting each other.

755005.title: Jacob's Worries
755005.text: Jacob is always frowning when you find her on the campus, not only because of her introverted personality, but also because of her troublesome sister Esau. Esau couldn't resist the curiosity to try new things, but she never thinks about the consequences. Every time she messes up, she asks Jacob for help. Even so, Jacob never really hates her sister. "What can she do without me?" Jacob always says with a shrug, and with that comes a smile full of happiness.

755005.title: Esau's Secrets
755005.text: Esau is a troublemaker, everyone in the Yume Academy knows that. Although this energetic angel was beloved by many people, they are also afraid that her naiveness may bring accidents to themselves. Does Esau know about this? When I asked her, she just smiled cheerfully: "It doesn't matter! Only then will Jacob stop thinking about other things~"

755006.title: Secret
755006.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Dec. 31st
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 22
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Puppet & Mystic Rose
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Scarf & Story Book

755006.title: Enigma
755006.text: I've checked every book and every record I could get my hands on in Yume Academy, but none of them mentioned "Kratos". The most I found were records with the name "Enigma", but those had traces of being heavily edited. But why? I asked Kratos about this, but she only smiled mysteriously...

755006.title: Regarding the Hornet
755006.text: Linky and Kratos share an interesting relationship. No matter what happens, Linky insists on following Kratos and calling her "Master", but her feelings (or obsessions) don't seem to be reciprocated. Kratos treat Linky the same way as she treats everyone else, and her kindness is just a disguise to her true colors. I've asked another girl (I will not reveal who she is as per her request), and she told me that nothing much has changed for them. Considering the events that have transpired in the past, this is quite unusual.

755006.title: The Lone Wolf
755006.text: If you look into the eyes of Kratos, you will be staggered by the emotions in them: sadness, anger, loneliness...However, she turns back to her usual kind and aloof self when she looks away. Many believe that she is alone because of her arrogance and pride as the most powerful Valkyrie. But perhaps...perhaps she is just scared to open her heart to others after everything she's been through.

755007.title: Secret
755007.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c]Feb. 26th
[c][f55090]Age (in appearance):[-][/c]22
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Angel Halo, Canned Fish
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit, Vampire Mask

755007.title: Chaos Aftermath
755007.text:
“Chaos Figure". No one will ever forget the horrific event that affected the entire school. 
In the aftermath, most of the students gradually recovered...... and a few were left with unavoidable trauma. 

But Izanami resulted as the first serious case. 
The erosion of chaos left purple crystals on Izanami's face. 
With current theories, the occurrence is hard to explain and even harder to remove. 
Therefore, Izanami had to wear a mask from time to time in order to hide the terrible traces. 

If this were the only symptom, it might not be something irreversible. 
But this was only the beginning of the tragedy.

755007.title: Only Thing Left
755007.text:
Izanami and Izanagi were originally a team. 
However, it is said that Izanagi left Izanami behind after she was infected by Chaos. 

This undoubtedly made Izanami fall into despair.
 She was ready to die while suffering under the painful symptoms of chaos...... 
But ironically, she overcame it and gained the ability to manipulate the chaos. 

But she had already lost all that she had, what was the point of gaining such power? 
The only goal for Izanami now is seeking the one that left her.

755007.title: Death God
755007.text:
"Chaos is the existence of evil”and no one doubts this. 
Therefore, one can imagine the attitude Izanami receives whilst being known to be able to control chaos.

She only wanted to seek out her lost lover, to pass through the village, why do people glare at her and even gave her the nickname of Death God.
The reasons are, of course, self-explanatory. But blinded by obsession, Izanami seems to have failed to notice this.

After being chased out of town by fists and stones, once again, Izanami sat under a tree, staring into the distance in a daze.
How long will it take me to find you?
As Izanami thought about it, it was as if an illusion appeared before her eyes and the person seemed to be right in front of her... 

No, it's not an illusion, the figure in front of her belongs to another person.
The woman had beautiful white hair and a gentle but cold smile on her face.
Kratos extended her hand towards Izanami.

755008.title: Urgent Notice
755008.text:
If you ever come across a little poor demon girl carrying a white snake on campus, don’t ever believe a word she says and run away immediately!

Even though the Discipline Committee had issued a notice, the number of Apate’s victims still continues to grow. For this “demon of deception”, deceiving others is her form of entertainment. Apate’s magical voice is not only pleasing to the ear but also compelling to the mind. It is with this ability that she spreads lies and stirs up trouble, toying with innocent students in the palm of her hands. But luckily, Apate’s lying skills are not that great, if you can resist her mesmerizing tune, the lies she weaves often fall flat due to her own mistakes and making her the laughing stock of others. Yep, as long as you can resist her voice… Oh! But when is her next concert again?

755008.title: Stubborn Intentions
755008.text:
Most of the time, the lies exposed from Apate’s own mistakes are laughed off by others. This, however, may also be the reason for her emotional outbursts. She was once locked up in the cold underground by angry people. It was in that dark place that she met the mysterious white snake “Volos” who was her only companion.

As a result of her past, it seems that Apate is particularly afraid of being alone (although she would strongly deny it) and gets annoyed when ignored. Thus, it seems that Apate’s lies and deception are only to gain attention from others, as she had suffered long periods of loneliness and does not know how to treat people. For her, mischief is all that she knows of how to connect with others.

Although, even if you were to sympathize with her, there is no need to fall for her deceit, right? Even if her smile may be cute and innocent after a successful deceit (or so she thinks). But it is only a matter of time before others realize her true intentions and who knows what will happen then.

755008.title: Becoming an Idol
755008.text:
Apate seems to have an unusual interest in becoming an idol. However, her interest is not in dancing and singing on stage, but the fanatic audience below.

It seemed to Apate that such a wild atmosphere was definitely unusual, and that some sort of special means had been used. But this thought did not discourage her, instead, to her it is the perfect profession. To Apate, an idol is an evil figure who uses words and songs to hypnotize the crowd and turn them into subordinate servants. If I could stand on that stage and sing, I could fulfill the satisfaction I had long yearned for, she thought. And so, she decided to embark on this rough journey to become the top idol.

The sight of her evil mesmerizing voice echoing across the stage is unimaginable. But aside from Apate’s misconception of an idol, it’s still a good turaround… right?

755009.title: Secret
755009.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Dec. 11th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 15
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Story Book & Cherry Fan
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Fox Mask & Evil Fruit

755009.title: Most Attractive Villian?
755009.text: Frexie looks up to Lucifer, and vows to become as awesome as Lucifer is. To reach that dream, she has set several goals, such as becoming the most attractive villian on campus, or winning over Estel and Apate when pulling pranks. Due to her thick-headedness, she tries and fails terribly when it comes to trickery, yet she never gives up due to the same trait. This makes her the comic relief for other students in Yume Academy.

755009.title: ...Or just an idiot?
755009.text: If you call her an idiot to her face, Frexie will probably start a fight with you. However, if you changed an approach and asked to have a prank competition with her, she would accept happily, and take everything you throw at her in the competition with a grateful smile. After falling victim to a vicious prank, she would beam at you, and thank you for "giving her more prank ideas". Her smile was so sincere that students would doubt whether she truly is a prankster, or is in fact an angel in disguise.

755009.title: ...Yes, just an idiot.
755009.text: Usually, Estel is the troublemaker, Apate is the prankster, and Frexie is the victim. As for KongMing...she is in charge of cleaning up after them. Whenever Frexie is stuck on a tree or trapped somewhere, she would rush to the rescue along with Raphael. As KongMing would often say while massaging her temples, "There is no doubt: Frexie is just...not the brightest one on campus."

755010.title: Secret
755010.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Dec. 21st
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 17
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Angel Halo & Mystic Rose
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Skull Pillow & Story Book

755010.title: Goddess…of Chaos?
755010.text: Maia is the Goddess of Chaos, yet she lacks the knowledge to understand the significance of her identity. In the past, she sat on top of her throne, accepting offerings and prayers from mortals without understanding their reasons or motives. She has the powers to summon Chaos creatures but lacks the ability to tell good from evil, right from wrong. For eons, Maia "harvested" faith from mortal souls. While their souls are dim and murky, something shines through. It's something that she doesn't have: an emotion, perhaps? For the first time in ages, Maia felt "loneliness", the feeling of not understanding others and not being understood.

755010.title: Indecipherable Emotions
755010.text: Maia met Senpai on one of her "Harvests". The attitude that Ithil and Senpai took towards her took her by surprise: why weren't they afraid of her, and why were they so rebellious? Maia had no interest nor felt any comradeship with the Chaos Creatures: they were replaceable and will be reborn if they are killed. However, she was intrigued by the emotions that the unusual mortals showed. She also started to wonder whether it was something that she lacks.

755010.title: "Servants"
755010.text: After enrolling in Yume Academy as a normal student, Maia started to learn about "common sense", something that she lacks severely. One of the most obvious signs is calling everyone her "servant", including Ithil and Senpai. While she does treat them differently compared to her other "servants", they are not her equals. In fact, Maia seems to believe that Yume Academy is her property now.

755011.title: Secret File
755011.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Apr. 2nd
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 26
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Skull Pillow
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Angel Halo & Amulet

755011.title: Once Upon a Time
755011.text: There was a time when gods walked among humans, who dwelled in caves and had no shame for being naked and for devouring meat raw. When the eyes of a kind Goddess fell upon these frail creatures, she took it upon herself to care for them like they were her own: she taught them how to craft tools and cultivate crops, chased beasts away from their homes, and granted them her fire so they would not fall prey to the bitter cold of winter. The humans in turn responded with love and respect, and treated her as they would their mother.

755011.title: The Plea
755011.text: Promethea beseeched the Ruler of Gods to protect the humans from the invasion of Chaos, but her appeal was cruelly rejected. Without the Ruler of Gods' help, she fought the Chaos creatures alone without rest. One day, a disciple with hair as bright as the midday sun came to Promethea and begged Promethea to fulfill her wishes. "You have never asked anything of me, my child, and your prayers will not go unanswered." "Oh Illustrious Mother, your faithful child Belinus implore you to bestow upon us a weapon that could subdue these horrible monsters. I shall defend my brethren, and you shall finally be at peace."

755011.title: Punishment
755011.text:
The Ruler of Gods incarcerated Promethea for her offense in the Land of Punishment. The chains binding her are as everlasting as the rule of her punisher, restricting her as she bore the wrenching pain of the nature of her powers being reversed and the transformation from Goddess to a feared creature of darkness.
Eons later, one of her beloved human beings stumbled upon her chained figure. As she tried to caress their face with her trembling fingers, she discovered that her binds had long been broken.

755012.title: Secret
755012.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Nov. 11th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 23
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Yoyo & Evil Fruit
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Coffee & Notebook

755012.title: Workaholic?
755012.text:
"Hadea dislikes working."

Whoever had the audacity to utter these words would face the ridicule of Poseidia, yet this was the truth. In fact, Hadea is bewildered when she heard the rumors about her liking work.

Hadea strives for the betterment of the Underworld, and her work is merely a means to an end. If her goal can be achieved without doing so, then she would gladly stop working, even if she has no idea what to do with her free time.

755012.title: Sibling Issues
755012.text:
Hadea's entire life is filled with the responsibilities she had taken up. As the eldest, she was responsible for her younger siblings; as a subordinate of the Ruler of Gods, she was responsible for whatever duty she was assigned to; as the Lord of the Underworld, she was responsible for its wellbeing.

However, a certain person has created many difficulties for her endeavors: Zeusia, her youngest sister. While she is on friendly terms with Poseidia, her relationship with Zeusia is strained and has caused her great frustration: all attempts to make amends with Zeusia had fell through, and her sister continues to regard her with suspicion and mistrust.

755012.title: Lord of the Underworld
755012.text:
Before Hadea rose to power, the Underworld was a lawless and disorderly realm, where the cycle of death and rebirth was in havoc. When all Gods and Goddesses rejected it, Hadea was the only one to take on the responsibility as its first and last ruler.

"The Underworld is where souls return to and belong, while Hell is merely a nest for creatures of darkness. Most cannot discern one from the other, but I hope that you can, Senpai."

755013.title: Secret
755013.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Jul. 14th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 13
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Mystic Rose & Puppet
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Ribbon & Headband

755013.title: Nice, sweet girl
755013.text: Friendly and kind, Apollis is the type of person who stays close to someone when they're upset and alone. While her sympathy may seem genuine, it is merely a product of her extraordinary perceptiveness. Her eyes are so piercing that they give the impression of seeing into one's soul. However, when she smiles, her eyes crinkle and she emanates an air of cuteness and naivete befitting a young girl. Although she acts in a gentle and sometimes cutesy manner, a hint of sadness can often be seen in her downcast eyes, causing your positions to switch from the comforted to the one offering comfort. She is an expert at gaining the affection of others, but do not expect her to return your affections as easily.

755013.title: Darkness of the Heart
755013.text: Apollis acts friendly with most people, yet she has no close friends. No one has ever doubted her kindness, but perhaps it is better for the truth to be kept under wraps. Although she was born with the sun, Apollis has an almost morbid fascination with the darkness of the human heart and devotes herself to drawing them out from the dark recesses of people's souls. She has caused countless tragedies due to her curiosity, and she watched them unfold from afar as if she was the audience to the scenes of a play. When questioned about her motives, she smirked and answered innocently: "There's no reason."

755013.title: Gentle Moonlight
755013.text:
Apollis wandered the world aimlessly. Her heart was like one pole of the magnet, constantly calling out and being attracted to the other pole whose location was unknown to her. She feels more whole at night, when moonlight shines upon the land, the leaves, and every inch of her skin, than she does at day. Is it possible that the moon holds the missing part of her soul? Compared to the sun, she is more familiar with the moon and its craters and basins, and would often count them whilst praying to the satellite.

"Tell me, where is the one who can make me whole?"

756001.title: Secret
756001.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] May 8th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 17
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Kunai
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Pudding & Angel Halo

756001.title: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
756001.text: Angel, sweet, fresh, and pure, lived as her name describes. And she won't allow the filth and dirt to pollute the world. As someone who is seriously obsessed with cleanliness, she washes three times a day. Her favorite food is milk pudding and she hates chocolate cake. She was greatly disappointed in the establishment of House Demon.

756001.title: Target Demon
756001.text: Originally, Angel thought she loathes anything that is evil, demonic, or dark. Soon she slowly realized that she simply takes delight in destroying filth and dirt by herself. It has become an urge and craving for her. After realizing this about herself, Angel's loathing and disgust for demons have turned into an utter fascination for them. Now, she sees the Demon Academy differently.

756001.title: Worries
756001.text: What worries and stresses Angel a lot is being saved by a student from Demon Academy. This compassion and kindness shatter her once seemingly firm and strong standpoint on destroying the Demon Academy. Then Angel contemplates and tells herself: "I just enjoy destroying things from the Demon Academy. If it is completely destroyed, there will be nothing to enjoy for me anymore. Just let them be!"

756002.title: Secret
756002.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Jul. 19th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 15
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Pen
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Angel Halo & Camera

756002.title: News Report
756002.text: Gabriel is a senior student at Yume Academy. After a few years on campus, she established a news agency. The club seem to report all the news around campus, big or small. In reality, the news agency is a front for the group's true identity, the campus patrol team. Their real goal is to serve and protect the campus after dark.

756002.title: Night Patrol
756002.text: What Gabriel demands from her club members is simple: be good at fighting!! Only the most elite fighters can take on the tasks and responsibilities of a night patrol. Those who are the best of the best receive private special training from Gabriel to improve their abilities in combat and reconnaissance. Although the News Agency members don't understand why Gabriel treats every outsider at night as if they are an enemy, they still attend training with dedication.

756002.title: Judgement Day
756002.text: Since the Chaos Figure outbreak, the safety of the campus has left Gabriel greatly worried and anxious. She feels that "judgement day", or the end of the world, is something that will inevitably happen someday. According to her, the outbreak is an early sign of the end of days, so she is more strict on her club members. After the real identity of the News Report 's Night Patrol team had been revealed to the public, both the Discipline Committee and D. E. F asked her to join them. She rejected both.

756003.title: Secret
756003.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Oct. 12th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 16
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit & Umbrella
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Coffee & Angel Halo

756003.title: Sunshine
756003.text: Michael has golden hair and has a soft and gentle personality. She loves playing the piano and is obsessed with cleaning. Despite her obsessive traits, she is really good at supporting and taking care of others and will make protecting her teammates the highest priority when she is in combat.

756003.title: God's Will
756003.text: This is a world in which gods exist. But it seems the demonic beasts appeared much earlier. The mighty, tyrannical, and merciless beasts threatened humankind. During that period, the world was an abyss of suffering, and humankind was filled with anguish and despair. One day, a girl saw a divine figure in a dream. This divine figure granted her the name, "Angel" and asked her to eliminate and destroy all beasts that threaten humankind, so that the light of God may spread throughout the land.

756003.title: Angel's Real Name
756003.text:
This kindhearted girl accepted the mission from God, left her hometown and family, and marched on a long endless journey to eliminate the demonic beasts.
Her body doesn't age. For thousands of years, the girl bears a giant white cross, way bigger than her body, and marched from places after places and journey after journey, eliminating all demonic creatures.
 On her mission, she saved a lot of lives and executed a lot of sinners, and witnessed the rise and fall of civilizations. In the darkest of nights, people have silently prayed and meditated to her name. The guardian angel that protects the weak and spreads the Gospel--- Saint. Michael.

756004.title: Secret
756004.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Dec. 2nd
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 18
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Rum & Evil Fruit
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Angel Halo & Cactus

756004.title: Poor sense of Direction
756004.text: Poor is not enough to describe Phoenix's sense of direction. Wherever she is, she couldn't find a way out. The first time I saw her was in the library. Even after guiding her to the history section three times, she still failed to remember the route and attempted to burn her way through. Think I must always lead her to the history section myself in the future.

756004.title: Lost in Thought
756004.text: Not only is she terrible with directions, but Phoenix also has a short attention span. She is often in a dazed and confused. If you communicate with her, you will find that her mind drifts away, and she simply responds to your words mechanically. She seemed preoccupied, and she seemed to be pursuing some secrets. Only when she exchanged topics related to the history of the school, did she gets out of her daze.

756004.title: Rumors
756004.text: After the last Chaos Invasion, Rumors about CHAOS FIGURE is widely spread among campus. It's said that a secret elite force actually exists and fights against chaos. And Phoenix, who is known as "the one who reborn in Flames," is one of the leaders of the elite force. The source of these rumors is still unclear and the authenticity of them are not certain because of this. But Phoenix has always been acting suspiciously. I think the investigation about her should continue.

756005.title: Secret
756005.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Apr. 24th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance)[-][/c] 24
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Canned Fish & Vampire Mask
[c][f55090]Likes: [-][/c] Pudding & Black Tea

756005.title: School Doctor
756005.text: As is known by many, attending Yume Academy means more than studying and getting good grades. fighting is also a part of the student's everyday life. Within the Academy, Ms. Raphael, the school doctor, is in charge of the Infirmary. She is more than a good doctor: she is also a great listener, and her calm aura allows the girls to relax in her presence. The Infirmary soon became a place where the girls can talk about everything that bothers them, which also makes Raphael the best person to ask for gossip within the Academy.

756005.title: Potion Maniac
756005.text: Raphael was one of the Archangels in the Eastern world. However, she became interested in the arts of potion-making, and created a highly potent anesthetic. On the battlefield, all enemies that come close to her becomes paralyzed. This is, of course, not due to her Angelic powers, but due to the anesthetic that she designed. Its effects work on both enemy and ally, so don't come close unless you have taken preventative measures.

756005.title: The Angel respected by all
756005.text: Raphael has lived longer than many, which granted her the privilege to make fun of other angels. She was there when Michael and Gabriel arrived at the Academy, and can recall many interesting (read: embarrassing) episodes of them. While she doesn't act like it, Raphael is actually very sensitive about her age. I would suggest against mentioning her longevity when she is present, or you might find yourself trapped in a mist of poison...

756006.title: Secret
756006.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Nah
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 17
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Umbrella & Fox Mask
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Coffee & Amulet

756006.title: Heaven & Hell
756006.text:
It's really amazing to see an individual to act as two people at once, and Nephilim is performing as two voices in front of me. Lucifer: "I told you to let me take over the attack, don’t interfere!" Michael: "But you're only using your dark magic. You should understand how useful the power of light is as well!" Lucifer: "But before your light was even used, my powers of darkness already finished the enemies!" Michael: "Why can't you be reasoned with... Hey! Stop it! You're never going to take over again!!! Get out of me!"
After a loud noise and a flash, Lucifer gets tossed away and Michael lands on the ground with grace.

756006.title: Argue about Name
756006.text: Lucifer and Michael had a discussion about what they're going to call themselves before they actually begin practicing the fusion. Although Michael and the fused consciousness both found the name "Mifer" acceptable, Lucifer obviously didn't like it at all, so they decided on Nephilim. I personally think that "Mifer" is really a good name, but this was what Lucifer said during their discussion: "I'm not going to call myself with that ridiculous name! That name is too shameful to even be mentioned!"

756006.title: Neither Dark Nor White
756006.text: Michael---The angel who represents purity and beauty, the previous president of both the Discipline Committee and House Angel; Lucifer---The fallen angel who betrayed her comrades and raises the banner of D.E.F. Even if their fates lead them down separate paths, they are still standing together--- even more, they have combined their powers. Maybe what Lucifer once said is right: desperate times, desperate measures.

756007.title: Secret
756007.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c]Jul. 12th
[c][f55090]Age (in appearance):[-][/c]20
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Evil Fruit, Skull Pillow
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Pen, Notebook

756007.title: Knight of Glory
756007.text:
What is a "knight" like? Uriel undoubtedly best describes this word. 
Honest, kind, brave, calm, strong, and elegant. No praise would be over complimenting her. 
Especially during battle, she can create paths towards her enemies while protecting her comrades behind her. 
Seeing her strong shield and pure white wings gives the courage to conquer all dangers. 

With Uriel’s years of battle experience, Hottie has specially requested for her to lead the school’s daily training. 
The students eventually felt uneasy after being tormented by a morning of frightening demonic training and getting told that "this is just a warm-up exercise". 
...... with Uriel at school, the students will definitely gain valuable experience, right?

756007.title: Overloaded
756007.text:
Yet, in her daily life, Uriel doesn’t seem vigorous, and instead may even seem a bit shy. 
In her spare time, she can always be seen reading silently on the bench in the shade under the trees. 
Seeing her quiet expression, she seems just like an ordinary girl, instead of the gloriously lit angel on the battlefield. 

It is only at such times that one realizes how delicate and fragile her body is underneath that armor. 
The slender fingers that hold the book, how exactly do they hold up such heavy shield and so proudly and bravely stand on the frontline?

756007.title: Ray of Light
756007.text:
In the age of chaos, any ray of light is seen as a light of salvation. 
Originally, it was only to repay kindness, but unknowingly, she became the admired "angel" and "knight commander". 
Uriel's white wings and dazzling light undoubtedly made her seem like the savior from heaven and people could not help but look to her for salvation. 
After the fall of such a radiant angel, people's expectations became unendurable and difficult to bear. 
But to whom can she seek her salvation? 

Only after written those secret words in that beautiful notebook, could we see a faint smile, without concealing sadness, appearing at the corner of her mouth. 
The notebook must have been filled with warm, cherished words, as she must’ve found her ray of light too.

756008.title: Secret
756008.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] June. 21st
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 16
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Ecological Bottle & Pen
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Slingshot & Amulet

756008.title: Stubbornness
756008.text: Most students' first impression of Angelica is that she is stern and proper, like a typical lady. However, an unimaginable stubbornness stays hidden behind her appearance, and others often find it hard to communicate with her. Furthermore, she is unyielding when it comes to her beliefs, even when they are proven to be wrong. The only person that can make her change her mind is probably Luna, who holds a special place in her heart.

756008.title: Training Habits
756008.text: Angelica is used to training in the mornings. She doesn't jog like many others do; instead, she practices archery. Day after day, she is up along with the first ray of sunlight, and is probably one of the most diligent ones in the Academy.  "The sunlight reminds me of what I lost, so I will not forget the pain. It is carved into my soul, and I shall carry the burden for as long as I shall live." Although none of this exists in the Academy, Angelica is still troubled by nightmares: Luna missing from her side, and the sun falling from the sky. It's hard to say whether her training is an escape from the nightmares, or she is just very self-motivated.

756008.title: The Moon
756008.text: Angelica and Luna used to live together in a small village. They were best partners, and their lives were peaceful. Angelica used to be weaker than Luna, so she would hide behind Luna whenever the Chaos Beasts attacked. She once believed that this will continue for eternity, until the fateful day happened. After losing Luna, Angelica traveled alone, with only the Moon to accompany her. The destination of her journey was Luna, her Moon: she vowed to meet Luna again, no matter what it will take.

756009.title: Secret
756009.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Feb. 14th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 15
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Chess Piece & Scarf
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Yoyo & Puppet

756009.title: Twin Thieves
756009.text: Gwen and Brigit are sisters, but closer than only sisters. They complete each other. They roam the mortal world freely, not unlike how a pair of butterflies flutter between flowers, stealing from the rich and giving to the poor. While they are detested among the former, they are warmly welcomed among the latter, and legends of their deeds spread like wildfire.

756009.title: Gilded Butterflies
756009.text: Butterflies are a sign of freedom and of shaking off one's binds. They have bright colors and are unique life forms. That's why the twins often compare themselves to these remarkable creatures: Gwen finds herself drawn to the prideful Morpho butterflies, while Brigit favors the passionate Agrias butterflies. Despite the differences in their personalities, they both share a common trait: a heart of gold. In this precarious world, they devote themselves to maintaining balance and protecting the weak. Just like butterflies, they come and go gracefully, leaving a trail of fragrance in their wake.

756009.title: Guardians of Balance
756009.text: Gwen and Brigit are skillful thieves, and they select their targets with care. They are the representatives of God and look over the poor in their own ways. While both of them are protectors of the poor and guardians of balance, they have largely different personalities. Gwen is cool, calm, and separates herself from the crowds, while Brigit is kind, passionate, and wears her heart on her sleeve. This doesn't stop them from completing each other and neither does this stop them from becoming the legendary twin thieves.

756010.title: Secret
756010.text:
[c][f55090]Birth:[-][/c] Aug. 7th
[c][f55090]Age(In appearance):[-][/c] 12
[c][f55090]Dislikes:[-][/c] Rum & Vampire Mask
[c][f55090]Likes:[-][/c] Slingshot & Game Controller

756010.title: Unruly Child
756010.text: Most see Cupid as an ill-mannered, headstrong girl who expresses herself without inhibition. She does not dissent such claims: "But I am the center of my world! What's the point of living if I can't live to my heart's content?" If it was any other student, Senpai would probably have lectured them on the error of their ways, but things went differently with Cupid. As Senpai spent more time with Cupid, they found such effort futile and decided that they will not interfere with her actions as long as no one was hurt.

756010.title: Arrows of Love
756010.text:
Cupid owns a Bow and two different types of Arrows: Gold Arrows that inspire affection and Lead Arrows that incurs hatred. If she feels like it, she will randomly shoot her Arrows of Love at any unfortunate passersby. Manipulating emotions is almost too easy for her: "Hold on, you really think love is sacred?" In Cupid's eyes, love is just an illusion that two people happen to share. It can be created as easily as it can be destroyed...
"No matter how in love you claim to be, you will not be able to resist my Lead Arrows!"

756010.title: The Truth of Love
756010.text: Cupid, the Cherub of Love, has a sarcastic outlook on love and often mocks the concept. Lovers believe that love is the only guiding light in the darkness, an idea that Cupid often scoffs at. Love is something granted by someone else, unable to be controlled by its recipient. Placing unconditional trust in love is the most asinine thing in her books, as the only person that will not betray a person is themselves. Like Arrows, Love can be directed at anyone. The feeling of infatuation is poison on the tip of an arrow: harboring misguided faith in the emotion will only lead to a painful death.

756011.title: Optimist
756011.text: Poseidia excels at making others relax and lighten up… when she's not asking awkward questions. When she is not in the role of the Lord of the Seas, she is honest, kind, and extremely passionate. While she can seem to be meddlesome at times, others know that this is how she shows that she cares. She is way more skilled at sharing her happiness with others than Hadea. She often warns her sister that she would "become a dull goddess" if she continues to do nothing but work.

756011.title: Concealed Wisdom
756011.text: Poseidia doesn't mind admitting her lack of intelligence compared to Zeusia or Hadea. Despite being the Lord of the Seas, she can be surprisingly straightforward. However, her simplemindedness is just a ruse to hide her true wisdom: after all, the Lord of the Seas cannot afford to be dim-witted. When she is alone in the seas, she has all marine creatures at her beck and call, and they are all in awe of her. Nevertheless, she does not show this side of her to her sisters. This, I believe, is a result of her prudence.

756011.title: Complicated Relationship
756011.text: Before Zeusia became the Ruler of Gods, her predecessor hunted her and her sisters with the intent to kill them. They survived the ordeal and emerged victorious, with Zeusia as the new Ruler of Gods and Hadea and Poseidia each receiving their own kingdoms. Nevertheless, this became a difficult topic for them. In spite of their shared history, Zeusia was paranoid of her sisters, especially Poseidia, who has control over the seas. Hence Poseidia's act of incompetence: she believes that this is the only way for Zeusia to stop perceiving her as a threat.

756012.title: The Power of Faith
756012.text: Faith has been a constant source of energy for the Gods since the first human knelt before the statue of a God. The acts that were considered miracles for mortals were effortless for Gods, and no deity could resist the temptation to reap the faith of humans by simply snapping their fingers. However, the apocalypse extinguished faith in the Gods, causing them to either fall into an endless slumber or into the chasms of death. After her awakening, Zeusia devoted herself to rekindling the belief in Gods in an attempt to reclaim her lost powers, but her methods were dubious at best.

756012.title: Merely Disciples
756012.text: Zeusia has never concealed the existence of her countless admirers outside Yume Academy. Although she refers to them as her "disciples" and they address her with the titles "Master" or "Milord", it goes without saying that their intentions were far less innocent. In the past, Zeusia wouldn't have minded the advances of a pretty face, but the faith of a larger crowd takes priority over a beauty to flirt with. With this in mind, she refrained from entering an intimate relationship with a single person for fear of losing the affection of her other admirers. They can only be her disciples, and nothing more.

756012.title: Meaningless Questions
756012.text: Zeusia's fingers were numb as she tightened her hold on her scepter, calling down one thunderbolt after the other upon the invading Chaos forces. The Gods had lost, and she was the only deity left in the realm of the Divines. She couldn't understand the reason for their defeat: was it due to an imbalance in power caused by the scarcity in the number of Gods who could truly damage the Chaotic beings? But they had managed to hold the line at the beginning. Was it because of the expulsion of Promethea which thinned their forces? But the theft of her sword, the Reign of Heavens, could not go unpunished, and she had attenuated the punishment in consideration of their friendship. Or was it caused by the loss of faith in the Gods? But she had exhausted herself protecting the Gods, and couldn't expend any resources in protecting the mortals. Before she fell into a long, deep slumber, the only desire that remained in her mind was to return to her throne...

757001.title: Manual to Girliness
757001.text:
At the wishes of her mother, Syrcotte grew up to be a polite and proper lady despite being a little bit rebellious. Sadly, her love interest is far from someone her mother had in mind for her. All her knowledge acquired from her education was rendered useless when it comes to this person, and to make matters worse, they were surrounded by her love rivals. In order to draw the eyes of her love interest, Syrcotte borrowed a copy of the "Manual to Girliness" from Hottie, who seemed like an expert on this matter.
"Hottie said that I would 'have them wrapped around my little finger in no time‘ if I mastered the techniques listed here... B-But this is both embarrassing and unbecoming behavior for a lady!"

757001.title: Night Scorpion
757001.text:
It was a night when the moon hid behind the clouds, and darkness draped over the city. A shadow glided across rooftops, striking fear in the hearts of the citizens who were wary due to the poor public safety conditions of the city. Those already at home shut their doors and windows, while pedestrians made a dash for home. Amidst the pedestrians was an old lady who tripped over her own feet. Just as she was about to fall, the shadow made a beeline for her, and she closed her eyes in resignation. However, her fall was stopped by the firm but gentle hands of the shadow, who helped her to her feet and bid her good night.
Since then, the citizens knew that they had a protector watching over the city at night, and rumors of the "Night Scorpion" begin to spread.
"Please stop calling me that, this is so embarrassing..."

757001.title: Heart of Scorpius
757001.text:
Syrcotte pointed her blade towards her closest family, towards the woman who gave birth to and raised her. Despite her cries of despair, the tip of her blade sank into the flesh of her mother's bosom. All sounds seemed far away as a voice whispered in her ear: "Stab it through! This is what your Mother wished for, and what you have always fought for..."
"No! This isn't what I wanted!"
At that moment, the Antares star in the night sky shone a glaring red.

757002.title: Absolute Concentration
757002.text: Every student in the Academy knows that it is next to impossible to catch Elysia's attention when she is completely focused on her painting. She will not stop for anything: not for an erupting volcano nor for Chaos creatures invading the Academy. Special measures have to be taken in order to break her concentration, but it is not recommended to touch her precious artwork even in the most extreme of circumstances. A mischievous soul once spilled paint onto her canvas when snatching her paintbrush, and in the next moment, an unfathomable power swept across Yume Academy...

757002.title: In Her Eyes
757002.text:
Elysia is not the first Battle Girl to wield the powers of an Astrological Sign, but she is the first in history to have eyes that hold the mystical forces of the night sky. Researchers believed that her eyes allow her to perceive a wider range of color than the average person: even a dull, black raven appears colorful and vibrant in her sight. However, their theory was refuted when Elysia claimed that this ability existed before she was chosen by her constellation.

The Academy conducted further research on this topic but found nothing out of place with Elysia's eyes aside from their color. Yet they are under no illusions about the threat they pose, for gazing into them shakes a person to the core...

757002.title: Fighting... Over a Paintbrush
757002.text:
Pasha, the housekeeper who served Elysia for a long time, was once a Valkyrie who deserted the United Force in the War against Chaos. Before Elysia left for Yume Academy, she asked Senpai to deliver a letter to Valeera, her trusted Captain, hoping that she would watch over the child.

Unfortunately... Ithil, the "heartless, greedy, and evil dragon", had her eyes on Elysia's beloved paintbrush, which she treats as a good friend instead of a tool. To prevent her "friend" from falling into the clutches of the "wicked reptile", the young and helpless Elysia sought the help of the brave Senpai.

"It is a shard of an Original Antique. As the Observer, you should know their significance better than anyone else, and the best course of action is to hand it over to us for protection."
"No! Senpai is on my side, and he will never take my paintbrush away from me! Bad Aunt Ithil! Bad Aunt Ithil!"

757003.title: The Girl and the Gun
757003.text:
After losing her birth father to war, Effy and her mother lived with her stepfather, who was a violent and abusive man. She often fled her home and wandered around the ruins to pass the time. One day, Effy stumbled upon an abandoned firearm and brought it home. Her mother, who wanted her to have a method of self-defense, taught her how to use it. 

When Effy turned 11, she learned about movies for the first time and was fascinated by them. Unfortunately, while her fascination with films brightened up her life... it also caused her to commit an unthinkable crime.

757003.title: The World of Movies
757003.text: Effy had a sense of déjà vu when she met Iron Fist and Krystal. However, when she tried to remember where the sense of familiarity came from, all she got was a heavy migraine and disturbing scenes featuring a creepy orphanage and a dead psychiatrist. Eventually, she decided to stop obsessing about her past and to start creating the world of her dreams with her trusty camera. In this world, she is the master of her fate with infinite potential, a soul that is truly free...

757003.title: Chosen by Sagittarius
757003.text: Thanks to the powers of Sagittarius, Effy was able to escape from her captors, yet this was not the end of her misfortunes. Tormented by past demons, loneliness followed her no matter where she went. Everything changed when she chanced upon Vivian in the woods and enrolled in Yume Academy, where she met Senpai. She finally found the light to guide her in the harsh reality.
