If you want to practice then just practice with me. There are no better ways to practice than actual fighting!
You're too weak~ Did you eat well?
Your fragile body will break from my hammer~ Let me train you.
There is nothing that can't be solved with a punch. If not punching it again will do the job.
Come! Time to fight!
Ah~ How boring. There is no place for me to fight as much as I want. Have you found any?
Look out!
Oh! It must be the drink that can boost our power!
Come and check what I've learned!
With this armor on me I can do everything!
This must be the best gear!
Are you planning to hunt with me?
No one can stop my hammer strike!
They blocked my hit… But how?
I finally slew the evil dragon yesterday! Here take this as a token of our love: it's the claws on its wings!
Hey welcome!
Can I place my trophies here?
Maybe you want to meet my secret base? I've got a nice hammock there~
Don't forget to complete your internship! It's impolite to be late!
Don't forget to collect what you deserve!
A riot is happening? Maybe some new creatures are spawned!
If you're looking for a fight I'll be glad to beat you up right now!
Thanks. So... Are we going to fight?
You're the best Senpai. I will keep it as a charm and store it well!
Hey let's go on a hunt together!

21003.text: Want to taste the pain of being in prison? I guarantee it is something you won't forget~ Hehehe
Hee Hee Hee.... You know what happens if you touch me again~
Are you going to leave? Do you have a class? Why follow such boring rules?
Wanna flee to the other end of the world with me? How could this life with too many restrictions be any fun?
People outside are limited by countless rules... It's no different from being in jail.
Hee Hee... More beast to the slaughter?
Does the world have those boring rules? Hee hee hee... Let me help you destroy all of those shackles!
Hee hee hee hee hee~
What's the drink for? Am I supposed to fight for you with these chains on me?
I'll make them pay for this once I'm set free!
I kind of miss my prison suit...
You're sure to give this to an infamous trouble maker?
I can only find my own position in the place where Chaos emerges!
Just another evidence of the vulnerability of order!
Maybe it's time to run away?
I hate being bound with rules and oaths but I don't mind that much if I'm with you.
? Don't disturb me!
This will become my new hideout!
You know what? Relieving all the students from school with some explosives must be a great idea!
Work time!
I'll remind my associate about the rewards.
It's getting busy! But the riot planner still needs more experience!
Hee hee...  Sending such things to me. Do you want to be wrecked along with this boring world?
What do I think about the gift? Well I won't answer any questions after this gift!
Hee hee... Do you finally get it? Let's leave this boring world that is filled with rules~
Oh you're here again.

21004.text: Boys are scoundrels! All of them! No exceptions!
How could one trust a boy to protect me? You can as well rely on a pervert alarm system.
Are you a stalker? Do you follow me all the time? Haha... My warning signals must not be working.
What I hate the most is~ You creepy people who keep staring at me~
Gotta change my batteries~ Without them~ How could we humiliate those perverts?
How do I deal with this punk?
Be my master? HAHA but you're a man. Ok~ There's no harm in trying. If you do anything weird or perverted you're dead.
Shock~
Just hand me that Exp Juice before I hit you with an electric shock club!
You turned out to be something more than a loser~
What do you mean by giving these to me? Are you trying to buy me off?
Leave the clothes here and get out! I won't let you see anything!
Are you a perv?! I'll never--- ever wear something like this!
Now you should have understood how powerful my taser gun is!
Tch I think the weapon needs more modification...
Who do you think you are? I'm not going to...hey where are you going?? Fine I promise you...
Ahhh! Don't suddenly appear in my back! I might have hit you with an electric shock club!
Why you bring me here? Just a forewarning I brought my stun gun!
Well at least you don't look that annoying when sleeping… Mr. Perv~
Go complete your internship and keep far away from me!
Leave after claiming these rewards! GET! OUT!
What? School news? Do I look like a piece of newspaper? Go and find out yourself!
What is this? So gross!
Hmph. Fine I'll take it~
Looks pretty good thanks~
Oh it's the pervert again.

22001.text: I'll create a world... One brushstroke at a time.
Look at this painting. It's a place from my dream. How stunning~
Painting tools ran out. Master can you go with me to buy it? I'll introduce you to a good art shop
Paintbrushes help create whatever you're thinking about. Doesn't it feel divine?
Don't move. Let me paint a portrait for you~
Let me paint something for you.
Um... Can you be my personal model? I will draw your best moment!
Let's paint!
With each stroke I get closer to the truth~
The improvement in drawing skills is actually the improvement in perception~
Weight drawing is a big challenge for me!
Do you want me to equip that or draw that?
It's time for a sketch outside~
This is another epic fight I should record on my drawing board!
I knew it is a bad idea...
I painted my dreams: it's me in a wedding dress and you waiting at the edge of the aisle...now can you make this reality?
Please wait a minute just a few finish touches to go~
It can be a proper location for me to draw without interuption~
After you start to learn drawing you will be able to notice the little things that are easy to be ignored in normal life. I strongly suggest you try to draw Senpai~
It's time for your internship Senpai~
Senpai I've collected your rewards please do remember to take them back when you leave!
Something is changed in the Academy maybe an incident will take place any time soon~
Don't interrupt me with that when I'm painting~
Thank you I want to draw it in my next painting.
Thank you for your gift~ I will be a good painter!
Welcome back~

22002.text: Too many distractions make people confused so I am abandoning all relationships good or bad.
Both my eyes are closed. The meaning of my existence lies in the darkness.
There is no future going on this path. After all what the future has in store has nothing to do with me.
Can't get anything without power.
Your light is too bright. That is the light that I don't possess... Dazzling light.
Accept the task. Then execute.
The meaning of life is to accomplish my tasks. Whoever the enemy is I won't lose.
This is my power!
Drop by drop I drink my power up!
Now I'm ready for bigger challenges!
You‘re correct to use the best material at the key point~
It's necessary to scrounge everything I can for my missions!
Hynel moving out!
EZ~
That was so close…
Am I worthy of your light? ...I see. I will not escape from the light anymore; on the contrary I will learn to embrace it!
The provision for the next mission is prepared just say the word.
It is your kind of room~
The rest is necessary it's not a good option to become too exhausted~
It's time for work let's go!
Remember to collect your rewards. It's a bad habit to waste your resources~
We'll need more detailed information for now what's happening~
These are useless to me...
Is accepting the gift part of the mission? Okay I see.
Obviously it shouldn't be like this but I can feel the warmth of your heart coming from this gift... Thank you~
You're back Senpai~

22003.text: Master please love me. Give me your love~!
Master I am a very good girl. Give me a reward~
Ah what a splendid scream.
Whenever I feel pain... I... I feel most alive!
I love pain! More! Give me more!!
Whip me hard with that whip!
Ah! Master I like you! Like you so very much...! Ahah~ It's going to get weird...!
Love me dearly~
Master~ Give me more~
Oh! I love this feeling! Harder!
Do you have anything else available?
Ah this is my type of gear~
I'll go wherever you want me to be~
Fight harder! You're moving like someone who didn't have their breakfast!
That's too... Too much for me…
Fleur is honored to be with Master~Please take good care of me in the future!
Master you finally have returned~
I'll be waiting for you here!
Is this what they called tacit violence?
Are you going out for work?
Master I've collected your rewards somewhere remember to take them back when you leave~
Wish there could be something exciting awaiting~
Unfortunately you just picked something I hate most… Really Master?
You really didn't have to~
Wow is this really for me??
Master what took you so long? I've been waiting for you~

22004.text: Stealing is a daily task~ It's also a hobby for thieves!
Master~ If you don't spend your pocket money~ I'll be happy to take some.
Excuse me~ Let me take down my living expenses for the week~ I'll rely on you~
Ah Master's cabinet? It's in the way if you leave it at home. I'll sell it for you.
Here I come~! Let me steal your heart! Ah no? Even if you say that it won't matter to me~
Let me steal something important!
WOW! Are you trying to catch me? Great! But I don't get caught so easily.
Uh huh~ You can't see me.
You've lost your Exp Juice? Guess I stole from the right person then~
As long as there's something I want my body will go out of control and get it for me~
I wouldn't mind what kind of gears you're going to offer~ Afterall I can get all what I want in my own way.
It might seem weird to have a pair of pants of other girls on my head but it's my hobby~
Maybe I can find some collectibles here~
Got you!
Getting caught is still a part of my plan…
I "borrowed" this bouquet from a Flower Shop on the way here I think it'd go well with my dress...hey stop looking at me like that I'll return it after the ceremony!
Oh! Why are you back so early?… Okay fine I'll return what I stole right away…
Let's see what we got here~
Wake up or I will steal you back to my house~
Don't forget about your internship~ Working is important when you cannot steal!
Senpai please take the rewards away immediately otherwise I cannot hold it any longer~
I saw something special when I was footprinting looks like something's happening maybe you would want to check it out?
This thing? I really don't appreciate this~
Gift for me? What a surprise! Thank you so much~
This thing I can't say no to that~ You really want to steal my heart~
Welcome back...why are you looking at me like that? I didn't steal anything yet!

23001.text: Hey Hey Master. Help me try out this yo-yo I invented!
My winning pose! So Cool! Ah haha! I'm the best!
Ouch~ The cut... It hurts...
It broke again! In that case let's make a stand-alone yo-yo!
My sisters may have good weapons. But if I was them mine would transform into cooler ones.
Let the competition begins!
Can my yoyo be discharged? Cool!
Free Style！
Now I'm able to play my yoyo better~
Isn't the best option for me to think of a better move when I got limited by the performance of my yoyo?
This string can perfectly fit on my yoyo!
I will try the moves that require to play yoyo with both of my hands when necessary.
Let me practice for a few minutes.
Told you that you'll be surprised!
Guess I won't get a second chance for this…
Of course I will accept! But you have to promise to teach me that cool trick after the ceremony!
Please wait a minute I haven't completed making up my hair style yet!
I don't think this ceiling is high enough. I might even get my yoyo damaged because of that!
Well since you are already asleep I will practice yoyo right now~ You will be surprised about what I have achieved once you wake up!
Are you going for your internship? Remember to return once you're finished and teach me the last move!
I'd claim the rewards on my way back if I were you.
My yoyo is not only prepared for performances it can also help if we go and find the intruders.
No need! No need! Don't interrupt me when I practice!
Oh thank you.
Thank you for giving us this gift you're so nice~
Welcome back~ You promised to teach me that new trick remember?

23002.text: Hey buddy~ Would you like some Thunder Ice? What why Thunder? Don't worry about the details.
Those bad guys... I have a shocking plan in store for them!
Like this rub it slowly... Then SHOCK!
Ah~ A sunny day like this ruins my mood. Thunderstorms are better.
Ahh~ Boring~! Let's build a weather controller.
Thunder is the strongest!
Come~! Genius student reporting in~! It's really hot in here. Can you help me buy a popsicle?
The earth will tremble!
Drinks will taste better if they are iced~
All those who look down on me will soon know the might of the lightning!
Weather Controller online!
Protective suit? I thought it would lower my control of lightning.
Let's light up some bad guys today!
Done and done~ Now let's return before the soft-drink bar is closed!
It's non-conductive?

The items that I craft are like my children. Now that I think about it you've contributed a lot in creating them so you're their creator too! So...would you like to help me create more chil-I mean items?
Come quickly let me show you my new experiment device~
Don't worry my device is not TNT.
What kind of metal should I use to forge this part? Maybe I can ask Senpai when he wakes up.
Is it the day you mentioned your work day?
Since you've helped me that much in the past I've collected your rewards for you please take them~
My weather controller is still incomplete but we can have more field test today starting with the enemies over there~
Oh I really don't like those stuff...
Thank you for your gift~
This... I really like it~
Welcome back! Hey don't touch that!

23003.text: Koga-style Ninjutsu is the strongest! This is a fact!
Don't even think about giving me orders. Unless you don't wish to live any longer.
Hmph! Why save people who don't even believe in themselves?
There is no escape in ninja's dictionary. We only fight until the very end.
If you don't want to die then get out of my sight.
Show me my target.
Get out of the way. Don't hinder my mission! Unless......
Behold! My secret technique!
For promoting my rank!
With all the new skills learned I'm just a dummy short to practice them.
You call these gears?
Gears will help but they won't do everything for you!
They've picked a wrong enemy!
Weak!
Retreat is a wise tactic for this type of situation.
I will only use my Ninjutsu for you in the future...if you are okay with that of course!
Maybe I can test how this stealth skill work out by hiding from Senpai~
End your training and go home Rome was not built in a day.
I know you trust me but sleep right here and now will lead you to a tactical disadvantage.
Maybe you should try to purchase all your stuff by yourself again then you'll know how important intern means to you!
Do I have to remind you about everything? Including claiming your own rewards?
Something's wrong near the Classroom there must be some enemies out there! Maybe I can try my new-learned tricks on them!
A true ninja doesn't need decorations.
Who do you want me to kill?
True ninja... I can't resist your gift thank you~
Great you're back!

23004.text: Don't... Don't... Talk to me.
The curse that took me has turned into my powers. Incredible.
The shadow is pestering me.... Please save me....
If you don't train the shadows will take over sooner or later.
I'm an assassin from the desert! Aren't you afraid of talking to me!?
Being alone is enough...
Hah someone found me. Looks like I'm not used to my shadow powers yet.
Shadows!
The shadow turns darker.
Now the shadows are full under my control!
The enemies will scatter when they see me carrying this!
Shadows cannot do everything for me so I will need this.
Without sunlight here is my turf now~
You will all be drowned in your own shadows!
This is not the best weather for my power…
You are the sun that brings hope and happiness to my life and I will love you forever.
Come and play the shadow game with me.
I hope you can add a swing in this room.
I wasn't afraid of any loneliness… Until you showed up.
It should be time for the internship. The alarm clock you set for that is also ringing~
As a killer first things first after completing a mission is to collect my prize.
It's dangerous out there you'd better stand down until more information is collected!
Assassin don't need this!
Gift for me. You truly thought clearly of it?
Something I can't resist... Just be with you for couple days~
You've found me again~

24001.text: I hope I'll spread my wings and soar like a bird one day!
That crow has been my companion ever since I was little. Do you want to see it?
The sky is a symbol of freedom. I long for the sky too. I thirst for true freedom.
Do you want to soar too? In the boundless blue sky without any care nor worry?
I can't fly myself but I'm training birds on how to fly. How strange.
You can't escape!
The birds told me you can help me as I go on my path to freedom. Can you come with me?
Harass them birds!
Hope my birds can also grow quicker with this~
I cannot change the fact of me not being able to fly so I tamed all these birds to fly for me.
My birds can also use some of these.
After putting this on there will be nothing to worry about.
My birds will take good care of the enemies~
This is done with the help of everyone!
It's going to rain I shall get my birds back and get away~
I took the path none traveled by; the destination is unknown but I have no fear with you by my side.
I think my birds like you~
Maybe we can expand the windows in this room. The current size is not good for my birds.
Stop there's no insect on Senpai's head! Besides he's still sleeping.
If my birds can grow stronger they would be able to carry you to your workplace.
My birds cannot carry rewards to you.
My birds found enemies in the forest we'd better drive them back at once!
The next time you send me this... I won't talk to you!
Thank you for your gift~
Thank you for being so considerate~ I'm so happy~
The birds sang you a welcoming tune can you hear it?

24002.text: Ah! Stupid Sisha! Spilling my meal all over the place again!
I don't talk to that shark-loving idiot. All those two do is eat eat and eat! Hmph!
The sea is the best~ Anything is here~ Even that idiot.
If possible I don't want to talk to that idiot... But occasionally... It doesn't feel that wrong.
I am the most lovely princess in the sea~ Don't let me touch the sand~
You pay attention to me!
Oh? Surrendered by my beauty? Ah I'm not a mermaid princess~ I'm cuter than one!
Go drown~!
I've become cuter haven't I?
I'll protect everyone!
You can count on me!
Let's get the show on the road~
No one can beat me under water!
Finally I did it myself!
*Sobbing*... Don't bully me anymore!
You're giving this shiny thing to me? And want to play with me every day? Of course~
I'm going out for fun are you with me?
I hope Shisa lives nearby. So I can hang out with her more regularly.
Senpai… Stop sleeping in the water! Not everyone can breathe underwater as I do!
Are you still going to work for the swimming pool today? Can I come and visit you during your internship?
It's not good for development if you always forget to claim your rewards.
If you're going to defeat the bad guys please bring me with you~
I'm angry!
You must be obsessed with me~
Oh~ I really like this gift~
You're finally back~

24003.text: Don't make me angry! My toothbrush is strong!
My toothbrush is more comfortable than an electric toothbrush!
No matter how dirty it is brushing carefully will make it bright and white.
What are you doing? Let go of my toothbrush! Give me back my toothbrush!!
Those stupid people with poor hygiene. I'll throw them in the washing machine and give them a spin!
The cleaning begins!
Hold still Master! It's so dirty! Let me clean it up. Make it clean and white!
Let's whiten it~
Cleaning complete.
Please don't run away! Staying clean is good for you!
A new brush with harder bristles? That's a good idea~
Bigger brushes solve bigger problems~
Leave the "dirty work" to me.
Do you know you look a lot cuter after you stop bothering others?
Why the floor gets dirty again?
Your personal hygiene has improved quite a lot lately but I don't think I'll stop supervising you anytime soon. Nope you're not getting rid of me that easily~
Please take this mop and help me with the floor.
How long has it been since the last time you clean this room?… We'd better start a house-cleaning right now!
I won't interrupt your sleep today... Consider this a reward for helping me clean up all these rooms.
Are you looking for an internship to complete? Maybe I can help you with that as you know the students that help the cleaning will get paid…
Since you've helped me this much in cleaning today. I think it's necessary to remind you of claiming the rewards today. Consider it a professional courtesy.
Awwww... I have to clean up the mess they've made all over again! But first wiping out the pollution source is the primary objective.
Stupid master! Don't pull pranks on me!
Behave master. Leave gift aside and keep clean~
Thank you so much Master~
Ah just the person I wanted to see! Master can you please hand me the broom over there? I can't reach it...

24004.text: With one stroke from my brush I could create a world out of ink.
Soul born by ink. Follow me.
Every painting in my works represents my heart. They are my most important memories.
Ha... Where are those who can understand my paintings?
The soul of life exists everywhere. Even in my paintings.
The souls living in my ink.
Shh! Quiet. I am painting. It would be wasteful to screw up such a beautiful painting.
Paint it black~
The ink just got thicker.
Maybe we're also one piece of a picture for the characters in a picture?
To complete an artwork we'll need a full set of painting tools.
This is not wash-off~
Sorry the spirits in the ink just give me a bit more time...
If you don't mind I want to draw down how embarrassed you're right now.
Sorry there's a flaw in this painting.
I painted the time we spent together. I hope our relationship will never end just like the ink on my painting.
Please be careful with the new piece of painting.
A blank room awaiting to be painted is already enough for me.
I just started to paint in the last hour how can you fall into sleep this easily? Is that too dull for you?
Sorry maybe I behaved too pushy when asking you to try painting... Don't forget to complete the internship today!
Stop staring at my painting anymore and claim your reward for today!
The spirits in the ink are restless we'd better check out what's going on.
Senpai this won't cater my like~
Thanks~
Thanks Senpai~ I really like this gift. Just let me add it to my painting~
Welcome back Senpai~

31001.text: There is no safer place than darkness.
The rules of the guild are not to be violated. Offenders must die.
There are many ways to deal with traitors. I believe you wouldn't want to know any of them.
I'm not particularly patient. If you stir up trouble again be careful.
You won't find me in the dark. Nobody can.
See the might of the guild.
Then I will protect you in the shadows.
Bury you in shadows...
One will need more power if she lives in darkness!
Very well~
Do you have gears in black? The color makes me feel better~
I'm always able to hide myself no matter what I'm wearing~
Target acquired let's move out~
Mission complete let's head back to the HQ.
This mission is failed because of the lack of operators.
It's better for both of us if we weren't so close...but if you insist I'm not going to reject your proposal.
Looks like you didn't hide anything in this room~ What a pity~
Is this your room? Hope you're not hiding anything from me~
The night makes me feel like home~
Go and complete your internship it's not good for your health to stay in darkness all the time~
Collect your rewards! Make it quick!
Everything has a sign when happening and now it shows something's wrong with the Academy let's check it out~
I never thought you're this kind of person!
Thank you~
For me? Thank you~ I really like this gift~
Welcome back Senpai~

31002.text: Carrots... Are... Tasty... Senpai! Give me some more!
Sweet... Crispy... Fragrant... The best!
Did you lose this golden carrot? Silver carrot...? Or this regular one?
Do you want my carrot? No~ I don't have that much left~
My favorite... Carrot... (Chewing Chewing)... Ah! It's Luna!
Let the Carrot Party BEGIN!
So you are Senpai? I am so hungry. Give me some carrots!
Don't stand in the way!
It will taste better if they can develop a carrot flavor~
Can I get more carrots now?
I want an armor made by carrots~
Will this make eating carrot harder for me?
I need a carrot as my salary!
Let's bounce around~
Stop bullying me!
What do you mean? I don't understand...do you mean you'll share all your carrots with me from now on?
This is a really big room~
Do you mean all the carrots inside this room belong to me now?
Carrots♪~ Carrots♪~ Give me all your carrots♪~
It's time for you to earn some carrots Senpai~
Have you claimed all your rewards?
The large noise just chocked me! What has happened?
It's so nasty...
It may not taste delicious but I shall accept it~
It tastes way more delicious than carrots.
Welcome back~

31003.text: Let's go to the next shopping mall. Don't forget your wallet everyone.
Everybody~ line up. Don't wander off!
This trip is guided by me. Whatever you don't understand just ask.
This building was designed by a famous architect 300 years ago... Well let's check it out.
Next is the water bus.... Uh huh? If you're hungry then head to the restaurant!
The itinerary is confirmed~
Hello! I'm your guide Ursula. As a first step towards friendship let's eat.
Please follow me~
It's so kind of you to prepare this for me after I finish a tour guide! What? I can get leveled up by drinking this?
Want me to show you the next spot? Just give me some time to prepare~
It will take time and effort to prepare for a journey.
GPS and maps are more in need!
Where's your destination? I can show you the way!
Told you this is the right way!
Guess we took a wrong way better run~
Although I get lost sometimes and can't remember every detail of the tourist spots I'm 100% sure that I want to be with you!
Welcome back~
Nice room! You must be one of those with taste~
Stop if you cannot continue~ I don't have an exact idea about where we are but I believe we can make it back home before it gets dark!
Time to go to work!... Wait where to go to work?
Claiming rewards is something even I can remember!
Maybe you can pay more attention to the school news~ There's always something interesting happening on campus!
D..Do.. Do you want me to help you to get rid of this?
Although I can help you more. I will still happily accept the gift from you~
Re...really? This is for me?
Welcome back! Senpai I came straight to you today~

31004.text: Cats cannot be tamed by humans. Cats are noble creatures.
(Meow Meow) Ball of wool is fun! (Meow)
A bath!? How can there be such a thing!? You traitor!
Stupid human. Pet me gently! How comfortable...
There is no one more graceful than me. Ah wild cat! Why are you touching there? Don't ignore me~
Hehe! Meow Meow Meow~!
Clang (Meow)! Who called me? Do you have lunch? Don't want to move. Get it for me.
Meow!
Meow~ This brand of soft-drink tastes nice!
Power up~! Meow~
Stop playing with my ears they're not your toys!
Meow! A fluffy ball on a fluffy suit~
Another butterfly~ Won't miss you this time!
This is what you get for messing my hair!
I'm just a nobody passing by! Don't hit me!
Meow are you ready to worship I mean take care of me as long as you are alive? I won't take no as an answer~
I'm hungry! Tribute me today's dried fish!
Meow needs a paper box for a rest~
It feels so warm~ Time to take a nap~
Complete the Internships to buy me more dried fish!
Meow~ You haven't claimed your quest rewards today. You must have forgotten that!
Meow... The noise made me unable to sleep… Go and stop the noise~
Hum~
Meow~
Meow! This is heaven...
Meow it's you!

31005.text: My blade symbolizes honor & glory!
Hesitation will lead to failure.
My blade shows no mercy to my enemies. Neither do I.
Only the living can feel terror. The instant you meet me you already lose that right.
On the battlefield only those who seek death can survive.
Any last words?
If there is something wrong with your heart you can't wield this blade. If you do not delve into it and strengthen your heart you cannot become strong.
The power of my blade!
Push forward! Don't stop!
The focused mind can pierce through stone!
Polish my armor! I'll need it for the next battle!
Just hand me my gears I won't let you down!
I vowed to protect the weak are you with me?
No one can stand against the justice!
I failed…
There is no need to be embarrassed I knew about your feelings all along~ I was just waiting for you to ask me first~
Welcome back~
Hello~
I cannot stop for all those who need me!
Time for work!
Remember to claim your rewards~
Something's happening~ We need to get there in case there's anyone in need of help!
If you give me this we are so over!
Thank you~
It's proof of friendship? Thanks~ I know you spend a lot of time on it.
Welcome back Senpai!

32001.text: My music has healing powers. Wanna listen to it?
When the music is felt deep within the soul the body will act naturally.
Famous musicians consider playing music as their life. I want to be that kind of person.
Well there's not much chance hearing me play on the spot huh?
No noise allowed at the concert. If you forget to switch your phone to vibration mode you'll be punished severely?
Enjoy the music~
Are you attracted to my melody? I'm Tula. I'll heal this world using my melody.
Taste my secret skill~
Let the music begin!
Volume up!
I wonder how these gears can help me with music performance?
Bring me my dress~
Motivate our force with music!
This is a successful performance!
Something is wrong with this sheet music…
We will write a piece of magnificent music together...it's name is love.
You come right on time. The most fascinating part is about to begin~
Can you share me your dorm for the practice?
Listen carefully nature has its own music~
I think it's time to complete your internships~
Collect your rewards before others do so~
There's something breaking the harmony of sounds on campus go and check it out~
Don't understand the art of being human. Please don't insult me with this thing!
I never thought you would give me a gift... Thank you~
Please allow me to play you a song to show my gratitude~
Did you like the music I played?

32002.text: Will that person pass by today? Even if it's just a glance it wouldn't matter. I'd like to see him~
Rabbit or sheep? What is her favorite animal shape?
All I want is to be like any ordinary person... To love and be loved.
What kind of flower does that person like?
Today is splendid. I redecorated my courtyard.
Here~ Turn into a Rabbit!
Don't... Don't stare at me like that... I'm sorry... If the courtyard needs to be renovated then leave it to me.
Trim it~ Cut it~ Now it's pretty!
Oh~ Thank… Thank you~
Thanks to you I've become stronger~
I think my scissors are enough for all kinds of situations~
I will cherish this gear!
I'll do my best~
I did my best!
Sorry this is all my fault…
I am so happy...I can't believe this is not a dream~
Senpai! Welcome back!
I suggest adding a few pot plants in this room.
Senpai… If you are really sleepy you can lean on me… Oh~ I'm not ready yet…
It's time to finish your internship Senpai~
Are you leaving your rewards there for some special purposes?
According to other students they found something special on campus. Please be extremely cautious if you are trying to get into it!
Why... Why would you give me this...?
Thank you~
Is... this for me? I'll cherish it~
Welcome back Master!

32003.text: Aye sire... Sorry master.
Master please call me anytime. I'm here whenever you want. I'll be right by Master's side.
Oh Master. Don't wander off to strange places… It will make things complicated.
Master you seem absent-minded. Are you tired? It's important to have a rest. Don't worry. I'll look after you.
Afternoon tea? Okay let me prepare it.
Let me handle all of them.
The first guard of the kingdom reporting for duty. As long as Master commands it I will obey.
Punishment fit for a king!
As you wish~
As your bodyguard I'll keep improving myself!
Thank you milord~
I'll not fail you~
Please allow me to stand by your side~
No one can get closer to my master!
Get to the safe area now I'll cover you!
You wish for my company instead of my fealty? I see...I will start treating myself better so I can fulfill your wishes~
The tea is ready please enjoy a good time~
Let me clean up the room for you!
Milord do you feel tired? If you want you can sleep on my lap~ I will not move until you wake up!
Milord please remember it's about time for the internship~
Milord please claim your rewards!
I'll stand with you no matter what is happening on campus right now but please still remember to watch your back!
Even though you're my master I will still be upset if you give me this.
Thank you Master it's a wonderful gift~
This gift represents Master's recognition I will keep it in my heart~
Welcome back Master~

32004.text: If you trade with me you'll receive overwhelming power. Not bad huh? Would you think about it?
I'll show you the way forward. You just look ahead!
Take it easy. If you join me we can't lose~
Every gain comes at a cost. There are no handouts~
I only trade with people I like~ I can't just trade with anybody~
I'll go easy on you~
No matter how powerful you are you don't want to carry everything over your shoulder. Trust me.  You're not that strong. You definitely need my powers.
New power!
Thanks~ I'll send you a return present for this!
I didn't expect that I'm the one who got help first~
Are you expecting me to become very grateful for receiving all these from you?
Well you must have become someone to provide gears of such high quality~
What kind of issue are we going to encounter today~?
I've foreseen this victory
Did I misunderstand the prophecy?
Everything I have including myself is now yours...Oooh you're blushing! How adorable!
Oh you've finally returned~
Just show me the interesting spots in your room~
Hey! Although… We've got familiar with each other but the relationship is not that close~
It's time for your internship~
One cannot only live on his luck that's why you should collect your rewards.
With every new incident there will be new opportunities maybe there will be something interesting awaiting wanna check it out?
Hmph...it seems like we're not meant for each other after all.
A gift that doesn't need anything in return. I will greatly accept it~
Wow~I like this gift very much!
Welcome back! Did anything interesting happen today?

32005.text: Oni-chan? Slashing and beating things is rather outdated.
The musket is a terrific invention! It's good for shooting idiots just like Oni-chan.
Go away! What I hate most are people annoying me when I'm eating!
Great! It's time to hunt! Which idiot will be my prey today~?!
Where did my dumb brother run off to...? Why on earth did he leave me here?
Everyone follow me!
Are you my master? I hate idiots like you the most!! Do your best for me!
I hate you! Go away!
I barely accept this as a gift from you~
You are finally onto something~
I'll never use any of these craps!
You will never win my favor by giving me this!
What? Why I must waste my time on this with you?!
One shot one kill!
It's a dud…
You can be slow at times but it seems like you're smart when you need to be~
Why don't you commit suicide for keeping me waiting so long!
Why do I have to come to your room~
Senpai… I did am some kind of mean to you but actually… !!!! Why do you wake up all in a sudden?! Go to sleep and don't wake up ever again!
Go and complete your internship! You've got nothing to do but annoyed me a lot right here~
Rewards! You've forgotten your rewards! How many more times do I have to remind you about this?!
Listen carefully something goes wrong in the Academy you'd better take a look yourself~
Dummy! Who told you to send me this!
You're mistaken it's not like I care if you give me what I want or not...you're so stupid!
Oooh a gift! Hmph I'll take it but I don't owe you anything got it?
Welcome back Oni-chan!

33001.text: I must become stronger. Even if it means selling my soul to the devil.
Selling your soul to the devil is no big deal.
Is that hope waiting at the door? Or is it despair?
Ah haha! I want to become stronger! Power is everything!
I can't give my keys to anyone. I only trust myself!
Behold my prophecy!
Now that I sold my soul. This prophetic book is devouring my individuality It's too late to look back!
Settle this contract!
As I expected my power got boosted.
Haha now I can wield the full strength of my prophecy!
For self-improving tools I'd say "The more the better".
You cannot judge the one who tries to make everything perfect!
I don't think you will need my help in solving this kind of situation.
These nobodies are not qualified to make me stop!
No! This is impossible!
I don't want anything to distract me but if it's you...I will accept your proposal. I hope you won't regret this.
Welcome Senpai.
That's the kind of location I'm looking for to have a rest.
That mission was really tiring~ And now I believe you agree on me… Have a good rest before you restart the work~ Good luck.
You've got an internship to complete? Just go then don't worry about me.
Hey you're losing an opportunity to become stronger by not claiming your rewards!
Enemies? Threats? Let's go and find them I can use some new dummies!
I can't harness true power through this...
Thanks for your gift. It can help~
Such tremendous power...Thank you I really like it~
Welcome back Senpai!

33002.text: Wire walking~ Juggling~ I could do all of those things~
With a red nose and a big smile I'm that clown that brings happiness to others~
Please don't show your sad face! Smiling is the best.
There is always a way to do small things. You see even if I fall I can stand up immediately~
I am a clown who wants to laugh but can't laugh from the bottom of my heart?
Show Time!
I hear someone looking for me~ Please don't show your sad face! Everyone can be happy with me. That's my specialty.
Come~ Laugh a little~
Thanks for your encouragement I'll try my best~
No money no honey.
A new set of performance tools~
It's a mask for us clowns. Maybe you want to try it on?
Cannot perform my show without audience~
I'll take this honor for granted~
Well... It happens~
I promise I will at least try to be Harley and not a clown when I'm with you...
Welcome to my restroom.
This restroom is perfect for me~
Rest is important when facing challenges keep that in mind!
Intern is not an easy job but remember to keep the smile on your face this will help you get over the toughest moments~
How can a person ignore the joy when claiming his rewards?
Accidents? Let's go and check it out Senpai!
I may be a clown please show some respect.
Gift for me?
Can I laugh from the bottom of my heart? Thank you~ You're truly a nice guy~
Welcome back Senpai!

33003.text: Someday I'll become a great Archmage!
Hey hey I scored the highest on the test today! Master have you seen it?
Uh-huh? Why did I fail when I did exactly what was written in the book?
Ah? It's already nighttime? Practicing time-freeze makes me forget the time.
What is an amusement park? Can magic be practiced in that place? No?… So why go to that place?
Using magic to settle this!
Look~ This magic is amazing. Right? Although I am still an apprentice I'll be an Archmage and protect my master someday!
Contract settled!
I'll perform better in the next exam~
Now I can cast my spells with greater magic power!
Mana booster? Never heard of such kind of item before.
Recorder? I thought mages would use scrolls to contain their spells.
Which spell do you suggest me to use against the enemies here?
See? That's how my magic works!
Seriously? I've been casting this spell so long and it missed the target?
Thank you for your neverending trust in me~When I become Archmage I will allow you to stand by my side~
Can you be my dummy this time to practice the new spell I've learned?
For safety sake no spell is allowed to be cast in dorm. This rule is ridiculous!
How dare you ignore me for this long! You're going to pay for this after I master the next new spell!
You're free to go finish your internship now. I'm going to prepare for the next magic test~
Magics are not free. They'll only work when there's fuel in the tank. And by fuel I mean the rewards you can get.
Let's engage the enemies! I can try my new spells on them! You will protect me right?
This... Is nothing...
Gift for a girl like me?
Thank you this is truly helpful when I study magic~
Welcome back~ I created a new spell would you like to see it?

33004.text: Ah? Where is this place? It's strange that you can learn new skills in one step. Where... Is... The monster?
How great would it be if we have a "save" button in real-life~
What's so annoying about stages? Everyone has to go through the super-difficult stages!
How can you be so sure that your world is not a game?
If you fail a mission you will go back to start. It's great to have skills that make you move faster.
Next stage is...
What's the new mission? Protecting the main character? Piece of cake!
Attack~!
Upgraded. Just like in the game.
Self-improvement by eating? Is that a kind of joke?
Better gears can improve my power more!
Is there any better gear you can offer?
Wait here and enemies will spawn automatically that's how the rulebook suggests.
There's no doubt the MVP of this game is me!
We can win this next time!
This is not a matter to be taken lightly even when in a game! ...Looks like you're completely serious. Well I guess I can't let you down then can I?
Should I pretend to be honored to have such a busy person's visit?
Increase my intimacy by moving me into the dorm? You know this is not gonna happen right?
I believe this is also part of a character's duty to repeat her quotes for a million times and awaiting her AFK player to return.
According to the rulebook you still can finish the internship and acquire more resources today.
No professional gamer will ever forget to claim his prize.
Let's go a new stage must have been unlocked.
Are you sure? You might lose Intimacy with me if you insist~
Intimacy... Rising~
Intimacy... Maximized...
Welcome back Senpai!

33005.text: Hmph. Nobody can escape from my net.
Nobunaga....? I hope I can fight you one day.
What is needed is the planning and the flexibility to respond to the unexpected. I'm not a fool who only uses force.
We will unite like a fortress. Shinobis must coordinate. It is impossible to win if we don't cooperate.
It doesn't matter if we are brutal. No need to sympathize with the enemy.
I'll fight with my life to protect everyone!
You're already in my trap. Take another step forward and look out for your neck~
Got em!
My web becomes stronger after this adjustment.
This is the honor of my family!
Tool crafting is a potential skill for a ninja.
I will examine the gears for a second time for I must be meticulous!
I will lure our enemies into my trap.
Don't expect you'll receive any mercy from me
We need to get through the hard time.
I will no longer be confused nor will I be lead by someone else. With you by my side I can start being myself.
Senpai~ I'm standing right here~ It's been a long time~
It's already too luxurious for me to live in such a nice room.
Well since you've been training with me for a whole day it's about time for you to take a break.
You're not going to train with me today? Oh it's because you've got internship to complete? Work hard then~
Don't feel embarrassed to claim the rewards you deserve.
My trap is triggered but nothing is there! Follow me and search around the enemy must be somewhere out there!
I don't need anything like this!
Thank you we will make good use of it.
Is this for me? Much obliged~
You're back~

34001.text: Found your weak spot. Sorry!
Hey calm down a bit.
The worst mistake you ever made is being exposed in my sights.
Just be quiet and pay attention. Listen there are deer footsteps.
I won't miss it~ Even at night.
The hunt begins...
Hi. I am a hunter from the north. The night doesn't affect me. What can I do for you? Please let me know!
Aim...
No one can hide!
Aim... And fire!
All I would need is a bow.
The hearing will also help you when you're tracking your prey.
These arrows should be enough to take out all my enemies~
I've marked your vitals!
I cannot penetrate their armor with my arrows!
I usually don't think too much about anything other than hunting but I can't ignore my feelings for you...
Shall we play apple shooting?
The hunt is over.
Now I can place the apple here and then slowly… Yay! Bullseye! I knew it would be a success~
If you want to skip from work then practice shooting with me~
Do you have apples in the reward list? Let's check that out!
New enemies on campus? I can take care of them with my bow and arrows~ Come on the enemies are not going to wait for you.
Excuse me we barely know each other?
Is this for me? Truly unexpected~
Looks like you know me well Master~
Welcome back~ Did you bring any apples for me?

34002.text: Oh! The sea is so relaxing today. It's the best day to swim. Isn't that right sharks?
Aha shark! You let the bad guys run away with their tails. Sharks are so strong!
Ah! Shark! This isn't something to eat! If you eat the bad guys you'll get diarrhea.
Shark aren't you a bit too fat? After all the food we have been eating are all high in fat.
I've always lived at sea. Wasn't the last time I was on land was about half a year ago?
Tsunami!
WOW! Master looks delicious! Should I let sharks taste you? This child seems to like Master very much. Aha ha joking! Master come swim with me!
Sharks... Defend!
Shark did you steal my Exp Juice?
Looks like my shark has sharpened his teeth~
After mastering trident I don't feel like I need any other type of weapon.
I will protect my friends.
Even fighting on the ground is not what I'm good at the enemy will still be defeated.
My shark is already enough to take care of all of them!
Don't hesitate to retreat now!
I never believed them when they said you are kind and now even Sharky has accepted you...what about me? Of course I will accept your proposal~
Please be quiet Senpai my shark is sleeping.
I'll prevent my shark from messing everything in this room up!
Does my shark feels that good? It's just too exaggerated for you to sleep in water because of him…
Even I agree to let my sharks carry you to the workplace you might still be late for the internship now.
These are the rewards they promised just take them for granted.
My sharks are always been training hard to defeat all bad guys I think now is a proper time to put all they've learned into practice.
Master… Do you wanna become shark food...?
Thanks~
Haha thanks for the present~ Even sharky likes it very much~
Welcome back Master~

34003.text: Starting today you'll keep running into people who will be dealing with you in the future. How do I know that? I'll tell you later.
Sage... That's a nice name. Huh? Are you talking about me?
I'll be here everyday~ This is my home. These books are all my teachers.
(Yawn~)... Sleepy. It's been a while since I last slept...
What's up? I'm reading a book. Can't you wait?
Strange I can't see your future.
Ah? Human? I don't see them often... As long as you want to know your future I can show you. In exchange can you leave me alone?
I'm not lost in thought!
Reading will also cost me energy.
I might be enjoying reading but I'm no sage.
My magic wand? It's just used for page-turning.
I won't need these but I can use a few more books.
Where's the problem? I'll solve them asap because I still got books to read.
That's not something you need to be surprised about.
I was just not paying attention to the fight.
I think we need to communicate more so please form this Oath with me~
(Reading) Hello.
Can I close that window? The wind will disturb my reading.
Don't sleep with your face in a book! Your drool will dirty the book! Wake up!
Just go now you've got work to do. I think I can find the book myself.
Here is the reward please take it. It's normal to get paid for the jobs done there's nothing you need to worry about.
There's something happening on campus watch you back when you're walking alone.
Uhh... This is very troublesome to explain. Simply put I don't like you very much.
Morning~ Gift for me? Thank you~
This gift makes me look like sage~ Good job~
You're back~Which book should we read today?

34004.text: Everything... Everything for Kratos...
This is the verdict... You are not allowed to resist...
I'm just following the verdict... Kratos's judgment is infallible.
Whether you're guilty or not is decided by Kratos. I am just enforcing orders.
This isn't fair? Nonsense...
Time to Execute.
By the orders of Lord Kratos I am your escort. Whoever you are I'm just executing orders. Of course until Lord Kratos changes her mind.
Attack!
Power up!
Don't be afraid the pain won't last long.
I don't want to be your burden.
All I need to do is focus on the mission.
Are you the ones who got reported disobeying the rules?
This is what you get for disobedience!
Was I on the wrong side all along?
I didn't receive any orders about this...but I don't see why I shouldn't accept your proposal.
What do you want?
I will obey the arrangement.
I won't judge you all I will concern is about my mission.
You promised to complete your internship today you should keep your promise!
Please remember to claim your reward just in case you've forgot that.
Invaders? Leave them to me it's my duty to clear them out.
If it wasn't for Lord Kratos' orders I would leave you here to fend for yourself!
Thank you but it won't change much!
I have to admit that I really want this gift. You are not so bad after all...
You're back~

34005.text: Spare me the details. This world is filled with resentment and worries. Let's drink and forget about it!
Can you play Hanafuda? I'm gonna win.
How many people are in this world? How can you possibly make every last one of them happy~ Huh? I'm just doing what I please.
Nobody knows what tomorrow has in store. So let's drink it up.
If you see that jerk remember to give him this message for me. "I'm gonna knock you out!"
Don't mind if I do~
Looks like you can drink too! Let's have a drink!
Drunk... Hehe
I still think liquor tastes better.
I can still go for another round! I ain't drunk yet!
We'll need different cups for different liquors~
Do you have any antialcoholismic drug for me?
Uh are you trying to sober me up by taking me out for a walk?
Drunk already? That's pretty lame~
Just a little mistake don't worry~
I only believe in living in the moment not fate and destiny. That's why I'm not going to let go of your hand once it has grasped mine.
Did you find me by following the wonderful smell of this bottle of liquor?
I hope there is a cellar to store my liquor.
I thought you could still go for another several rounds but… Maybe this is a good chance to draw something on your face when you lost your mind~
Are you going for an internship? Well maybe it's a bad time for a drink before work.
Hey I believe claiming your rewards is the first priority.
Those disturbing enemies won't even let a good girl enjoy her liquor it's time to teach them a lesson!
Don't argue it with me you're so naughty!
Oh gift! Thank you~
I'm a little embarrassed~ Thank you for your gift. I won't forget your generosity~
You're back would you like a drink?

35001.text: Although I like the beauty of withering I don't hate waiting until the next blossom.
Who said witches have to have wands? This rose? This rose is for decoration. It's lovely to look at. My magic doesn't need an instrument.
I'm a skilled poisoner. Needless to say poison could do the job but sometimes clean water can also become lethal.
A witch should live in a castle high up away from the mundane life. This would suit me but also in line with my dark desires.
Yup I use black magic and I can only feel alive when others' lives are taken by me. What's so wrong with that?
It's up to me to do this direct.
The world sees me as a proud witch. You're the first to know my eminence. What rewards you want for satisfying me~
Binding of Roses!
Do you think I'm not strong enough?
Growing is a feeling that never gets old~
A true witch won't rely too much on her gears~
I can sense the power flowing through this~
Where to?
Don't mess with me!
They will taste the vengeance of a witch next time!
Both of us will wilt away eventually...but before that please allow me to stay with you and be the light for each other~
Here we meet again~
It's a nice room~
The fad-away of lives doesn't make me feel sad~ Maybe I just enjoy to watch them fading~
You haven't completed your internship today have you? It's about time~
Don't forget your rewards~
I have nothing to do with the chaos on Campus but maybe you wanna check it out? Don't worry I'll always be waiting for you right here~
Don't push your luck even if you've got my recognition!
Thanks for the present.
Seems you've spent some time on the present. Thanks for that. Now let me consider paying it back~
Welcome back Senpai!

36001.text: Am I still alone for this Mid Autumn Festival? Little rabbit do you want some biscuits?
Moon-watching dumplings sweet potatoes and chestnuts! Which one to eat today? Ah! This dumpling looks like a rabbit's face!
I like vibrant-busy places. If I'm alone I sometimes forget I exist.
The sound of the tree being chopped... It's the beginning of a new day...
All I have is loneliness and regret... Thousands of years have passed. I'm becoming weary of it.
Let me help you.
You are my master. If possible can we chat?
Moonlight! Guide me!
It's going to got busy~
Can't celebrate festivals without friends!
Thanks I'll make good use of it.
Bunnies like this~
Although I was prospecting something else it's still a popular place~
Are you thanking me for this?
Sorry it's been a long time since my last battle…
You have become a constant in my life just as how the sound of wood-chopping has...don't break the streak okay?
Thank you for visiting me as promised Senpai~
Can I have a roommate? I can no longer stand the loneliness…
Senpai surely had a busy day so I won't interupt his sleep.
Please don't worry about me you've got work to do.
I really enjoy the time when serving the people who come to claim their rewards so we can at least have a conversation.
Even I like it to become busy it's is totally overdoing now and I won't allow that!
I'm sorry I don't really like this~
Much obliged~
Thanks for the present~ Bunnies must also like it~
Welcome back~ If it doesn't tire you too much can we chat?

41001.text: Being a zombie you don't need to eat sleep or dream about anything. Don't you find that more comforting?
Don't look at me! I'm not worth looking at...
No! Don't come near me! Misfortune will befall you.
From the moment I was born I decided to die alone.
Don't you dare trick me ever again! I don't trust anybody anymore!
Disappear!
Do you really want to be friends with me? Even if it's unfortunate? You might die... You're just another liar…
Don't touch me!
Thank... you...
Stronger… Just a little bit…
Maybe I can have a friend this time?
Only in this way can I become a reliable person~
You're so kind to me~
Is that for me? Thank you~
Don't bother asking my personal opinion~
Oh we won~
Just leave me alone…
I'm so lucky to hold the affections of someone like you...
Are you here to see me?
Leave me alone~
It's not easy to find you alone~ Keep quite let me enjoy the peace with you~
Are you going out for work? Remember to return early~
Uh… You still forgot to collect your rewards…
Something happened on campus… I'm not the criminal.
Even you lie to me?
Thanks~ So are we friends now?
Truly appreciate your gift for me~
Are you...here for me?

41002.text: Ah~ It's a place I've never been to before! Mark it on my map!
Relax! Don't worry! As long as I'm here Master will not get lost! You can count on me!
Navigation? You don't need that kind of thing! Trust your intuition!
This is the right way right? Anyway the Earth is round we‘ll arrive sooner or later!
Master the world is exciting!
Do you want to fight with me?
Flash joining in! I've been to every corner of the world. I'll take you anywhere you want to go to!
I'll knock you~
I feel full of power after drinking this Exp Juice!
Hi-ho~ Silver!
Maybe I can meet students who can run faster than me!
Catch me if you can! Haha!
Gears that won't slow me down! That's my type of gear!
As the saying goes: strong horse with strong saddle~
Would you like to go jogging with me? It's the most relaxing thing to do in the world!
Yay!
Ugh… My head hurts…
No matter where I want to go I'll reach it as long as I keep traveling...so never let anything stop you Master!
Senpai! You remembered to bring some carrots with you right?
Is this your room?
Senpai's fallen asleep… I should also take a nap~ zzzzzz~
It's time to complete your internship!
Senpai! Don't let your rewards get away! Claim them quickly!
An accident? Let me go check what happened I'll be right back~
...You must be kidding me.
It may not help a lot but thanks~
This is the best gift I have ever received!
Welcome back Master!

41003.text: Go with the clan and become stronger. That's what my instincts tell me.
We can't grow stronger without facing danger and terror.
No one can resist the forces of nature! Nature is the strongest thing in the world!
It is man who destroys themselves.
If we can't coexist with nature we will destroy ourselves.
Concentrate.
Human I come to help you in the name of nature. If you want to be stronger you must be one with it.
*Howl*
It's not something I can find on a grassland… It tastes good though.
Weak meat and Strong food.
In my homeland all the knowledges are told from the elders so I'm actually not very used to learn them from books… But I'll try my best.
Try your best to survive.
Strange costumes… Maybe I shall try something new.
I feel power from these gears~
Return to nature~ It's good for you.
Nature will rise against you!
I concede to you…
All of us are born from nature and will eventually return to it when our lives come to an end. However the time we have before that belongs to ourselves and not to nature.
Ah you've returned. Welcome~
I smell Senpai in this room…
It's quiet out there.
In order to survive you need to go and earn your daily bread!
Senpai the rewards~
It's the sound of chaos… Don't you understand? Something must be happening!
I just cannot understand why something like this would exist.
Wow is that for me? Thank you~
The true force of nature! Glad to work with you human~
Welcome back Senpai!

41004.text: It's all under control!
From a mental standpoint nobody can surpass me.
I don't have time for these trivial matters. Otherwise it will affect my IQ!
The way chess pieces move is too fixed! I don't move like that! I can do whatever I want! I don't follow the rules!
Let's say the gap between my IQ and yours... Wait. Bad example. The gap is too huge.
Hmph! Let's see the difference in IQ~
What's the strongest piece in chess? Queen. She does whatever she wants. I want to be the queen. And those troublesome chores are yours to deal with.
Checkmate!
That's not enough. Don't you understand how important I am?
I've become more superior than the mortals~ He he~
That's just a piece of pie~
All in my prediction very well~
Are you trying to make me look bad?
The best gear for the best ME!
I won't hang out with those idiots~
I've lost interest in you~
Only barbarians would get what they want only by force…
Do I have what it takes to accept your vows? Do you think I will fall for your tricks that easily? ...Don't worry I was just playing with you. I will accept your vows~
Right on time I'm getting boring!
Get out I'm going to take a nap~
You should be more energetic... Sorry I asked too much for a mortal~
You're still not powerful enough to live without intern.
If you're not taking the reward I'm gonna keep it.
It's so boring--- Wait. Something interesting is happening!
Hey~ Are you teasing me?
You should be grateful that I even accept it~
Oh this is a gift from the King to the Queen? It's not bad thank you~
Welcome back mortal~

41005.text: I know the pain of betrayal. So far I don't know how many times I've been betrayed. But it has also made me strong.
To escape I must live with a mask. To survive we must wipe out our existence. For our family for my sister.
Where there is light there must be shadow. I am that shadow.
I'm strong because I have the most important people around me.
Even if I lose everything I will protect my sister to the end.
Mission... Understood..
Assassin was ordered to attend. If Master has any inconvenient task please do not hesitate to give it to me.
Confirming Target!
Thanks so much~
More power! This will help my master to win more she needs!
I have served I'll be of service.
For my master I will not stop!
My sister needs better protection than I do~
Thanks for your investment you won't regret that!
Orders received!
Let's end this quick!
Sorry master I've failed you…
I can't believe Master will propose to someone like me...I will devote myself to you for the rest of my life for your kindness!
Please have a good rest here~
Is this your room? May I come in?
If I could be more capable you won't be bothering this much…
Are you going out for work? Please take care of yourself out there~
Master please remember to claim your prize
Master something happened on campus I'm ready when you're!
Master...Do I really have to take this with me?
Thank you~ I just do my part.
Thank you for your trust in me it's my honor to have earned it~
Master welcome back~

41006.text: The half-breed human is my special friend. No matter what happens I won't let her get hurt.
No amount of words can express my thanks to the monsters who raised me.
What's the difference between humans and beast? I don't know at all...
Blood in my body is heated.
I want to know the warmth and love of human beings.
I'll show you my powers.
Not fully a beast yet not totally human. What do I do now? Can you tell me?
Blood...... Rise....
Thank you senpai~
Maybe it's because of the blood of the monster I grow a bit quicker than normal people…
I have to admit you human is more intelligent than other creatures.
I'm slightly stronger than others~
I don't feel its weight…
After all I'm still mortal so I can use the armor as protection
Let me check out the place you're not able to reach~
Quite easy actually.
I lost…
I always thought this only happens to ordinary humans and not to someone like me...Please take good care of me okay?
Welcome~
Is this your room?
Go to sleep~
I've got an internship to finish are you with me?
Remember to claim your reward~
Something's happening I can smell it!
Why you force me to accept something I hate? Is that what humans do?
Thanks for your gift human~ Why would you give a gift to someone like me?
Thank you I like this a lot. If you don't mind me asking why did you give me a present? ...Because we are friends? ...I never imagined being friends with anyone other than her...
Welcome back~

41007.text: Elder sister only belongs to me!
Even Master is not allowed to steal my sister from me!
Sister~ Sister~ Sister... Let's go together!
Who cares about you? I just want my sister! It's impossible to do anything without my sister!
Sister is the strongest in the family! The mission will not fail!
Get away from older sister!
Ta Da~ Ninja is here! I'm here for my elder sister not for you! Uh? Where is she anyway?
Get away from my sister!
Get another one for my sister!
Make it quick! I need to become stronger!
I'll soon reach my sister's grade it's so exciting!
I'll become stronger for my sister!
With this armor I will soon be able to help my sister more!
Wow! I like its design!… You must have remembered to buy another one for my sister right?
I'm following my sister and she's just happened to be with you!
I'm good!
I want my sister…
Who me?! I thought you liked my sister more?!
Let me play some more~
Wow! This room is huge!
Oh you're already asleep? Then I can sneak out and play~
Oh you've got an internship to finish too? Hard life isn't it?
Hey! You've forgotten your reward!
Huh? What is that? Why everyone is screaming?
I have no use for this!
What do you want? I will tell my sister if you come any closer!
This is really good~ Can I give it to my sister?
Welcome back~Did you see my sister on your way back?

41008.text: Oh no` Can't help but raise my children~
Uh ~no ~OK ~This kind of thing has to be done at a place where nobody is there.~
Relax~ I'm here. Love you~
Butterflies can take me to any place I want~
Shush! Quiet down~ Look someone will notice us~
Butterflies take me to victory.
Ah~ It's you're the one recruiting butterflies? Hmm~ OK~ So let's do happy things together!
Be my bait!
I want more~
Hehe~ Can you hold on to me?
Please take good care of me in the next year Senpai~
Don't you want to feel my change up close? Hehe
Clothes are meant to be taken off.
Is that all that you want?
Let's find a place no one else can reach~
Useless punks~
Hey~ Chill out! You're being too rude~
A butterfly fluttering around in the air eventually landed in the arms of someone she could trust...
You've kept me waiting long enough~
I hope the bed could be bigger~
I was prospecting something else besides sleeping~
Return once you've completed your job. I'll be waiting for you in bed~
Don't forget your rewards~
I hope you're thinking of me not the news.
What's this? You don't like me anymore?
Oh? What a nice surprise. A gift for me thank you~
I like it very much~ Let me think about a gift for you...
Welcome back~

42001.text: If I operate correctly it will only hurt a little. If I operate... correctly... Uh.
Let me see your health insurance card. Ah sorry that disease is not covered.
If you feel pain let me know… But I'm afraid you'll pass out because of the pain before that…
Oh no! Master fainted! Quickly! Do CPR....! Or does he need an injection?
Sapphire and Boxer often come here to see a doctor but they never pay their treatment fee.
Hold on. It's gonna hurt.
This isn't a cosplay. I'm a real nurse. I have a nurse certificate but I'm not very good at injecting...
Helping you with the treatment!
Drinks for me? You're so kind~
I won't be missing the needle of a syringe inside you next time~
Please take good care of yourself even with all these homeworks~
I'm already an experienced nurse now! Don't worry this time!
Hey don't dress me like this!
I'm still a nurse even in the wrong dress!
Is there anyone who needs help? The profession is here!
All of you need emergent medical treatment~
Hey! Attacking medical personnel is against international law!
I will be together with you forever~
Shhh~ I'm taking care of another patient!
Remember to clean up your dorm Senpai. Bacteria might cause some kind of infection!
Just close your eyes~ And enjoy this precious rest time~

Remember to take your own reward I won't be helping you this time since I've got other things to do~
Huh? Was there anything happened? I've got tons of patients to deal with today!
You don't ask people what they like before you start sending gifts?
It may not be very useful but thank you~
Well...Thanks for your gift I like it very much~
Welcome Senpai~

42002.text: It's time to practice with Amazon.
I don't like wasting time and I don't think you'll make me happy.
Only strength makes me enthusiastic...
The strong may not get everything. But the weak get nothing.
What is the reason to get stronger? Do we even need a reason?
10 years of grinding! Let's see what I got!
You have what I don't have... Show me your power. Then I could follow you.
Destroy everything!
It tastes like power! Thanks a lot!
Amazon's also improving herself every day I cannot lose her!
I should work hard in training and studying!
Now who dares to stand against me!
Just entrust me with your gears! You won't regret this!
Wow! This is a suit all warriors would want!
Where's Amazon? I'm here to challenge her!
Train harder and you will be just like me!
It's unacceptable to let others see me like this…
Let's be strong together so nothing will come between us!

Get up! You shouldn't be sleeping during your spare time!
Time for the internship! It's also a part of training to gain social experience!
You should claim your rewards~
New accident on campus! It's a nice chance our training can finally pay off!
What is this? Why are you giving it to me?
Thanks I accepted it~
I never seen anything like this it seems good. Wish me to be stronger? Thanks I will do my best~
Welcome back Senpai!

42003.text: Power and speed! Is everything! I ain't gonna lose to anyone!
Hey! Meet me at the rooftop after class! Do you have the guts?
I only do what is right. Quit babbling and get to the point!
If you can take my punches I'll listen to you just this once!
Ah! Sapphire... How did you get here?
I'll bet my boxer title on this.
I'll team up with you in the following days! There's nothing I can't do with my fists! Let me fight more!
Storm Punch!
Gulp... Gulp... Gulp... (Snores)
Hi~Ya! Don't you think my punches can penetrate everything?
Graduated? Me? I didn't even have my exams…
I believe myself being strong enough to impress Sapphire!
No armor can survive from my punches!
With this there'll be nothing stopping me!
Looks like we've got a new challenger today!
I said you'd pay for that!

Yo Senpai!
This room is too big for me!
Hey! Wake up now! Sapphire is getting close! I need your counsel! NOW!
Oh! It's work time Senpai. Maybe you should join us to the workplace?
Oh I almost forgot my daily reward. Check yourself Senpai. Just in case.
Some told me that something new is happening! Are you going and check it out?
What are you trying to say by giving me this? You don't respect me?
Thanks for the present.
I love your gift. I never thought you knew me so well~
Yo Senpai! You're back~

42004.text: Where did I come from and where should I go?
I've been alone for a long time... Too long...
Do you like lilies too?
What is true happiness? Can I know that by staying here?
How about some tea in my garden?
Lilies sing.
Are you willing to accept a boring person like me? Thank you! In return please take these lilies. It's best that you like it.
Freeze!

More lilies~
I'll still be waiting for you in this garden next year Senpai~

Did you prepare all this for me?
Thanks for your time~

Maybe it is time for me to perish…
No matter how much time has passed my feelings for you are the same as when I first met you in my garden...
I was wondering where you have been~
I'll be right here waiting for you.
Enjoy the peace I'll be watching for you~
Don't miss the time for internship~
I'll be keeping the rewards for you you just need to reach me and claim them~
You must be a very busy person… Since you're in an Academy always having something new for you to discover~
I never thought you could be so boring~
Thank you.
Appreciate for your gift I will accept it~
Welcome back Senpai~

It's interesting to see how you can turn one substance into an entirely different substance.
Charcoal and sulphuric acid potassium cyanide. Then add chicken wings?

Hydrogen Helium Lithium Beryllium Boron Carbon Nitrogen Oxygen Fluorine Neon...name the rest and I'll admit that you are my master!

we need more doses of vaccines~

Anything fun for me?

You come right on time figure me several questions to kill time~

Don't forget your reward~

Do you think I'm dumb? I don't need this!

All I what have consumed becomes a part of me!

It's lonely without enemies.

Life is a journey of transcending yourself!
Do you want to go back with me?

I am the queen obey my command! I don't want to lose because of your stupidity!
Face death!
Thanks!
I'm unstoppable!
I shall also try to overcome others in other fields!
The stronger I become the more I'll be able to protect!
Nice gears! Thank you!
Do I… Really deserve this costume?
Wanna check out my pets today?
You've overestimated yourselves!
I lost… Completely…
And I have one more thing to protect now~
Welcome back~
Hello~
Senpai is still so cute when asleep~
Remember to finish your internship today Senpai~
Don't forget your rewards!
Something's happening? I'm not gonna miss it!
Such an exquisite thing too bad it doesn't suit me~
Gift for me? Thanks~
This is so cute… Oh umm. Thank you for the gift. And remember you saw nothing!
Oh you're finally back!

I'll purify the original sin. Let's wait for the time of redemption.
People will not be confused under God's guidance if they have faith.
Everything in the world originates from love and forgiveness.
Let God bring you salvation.
Lord give me strength.

Lord's Grace!
Please don't worry.
Bless you.
All I can do is to talk to everyone I can to spread the light of God.
The armor doesn't suit me at all.
With this... I shall release their souls from purgatory... By physical means.
Don't worry about me. I can take care of myself.
By the light of our Lord we shall prevail.
Why isn't our God standing with us?
Senpai you don't have to say anything I knew about your feelings for a while and I accept your proposal~
Senpai? Please wait outside until I put my dress on!
I think we should make some space for the lost lambs.
This rest is also a gift from God.
Complete your job! These are principles which every man of every faith can embrace!
Please remember to reap what you sow...
This is also a part of God's test!
Father please forgive his rudeness.
Thank you.
I really like your gift~ God will protect you~
Welcome back! May God bless you~

43002.text: What is the value of a human being? Everyone dies anyway.
Is life really that important? Not interested. I am just executing orders.
Blood and Water. What's the difference?
I am not listening and I don't want to. Just give me orders.
Nothing matters... Including me.
Executing... Assignment...

Attack program... Commencing...
Power up!
Machine needs no food but fuel~
Graduate? Confirmed!
Order is no longer the first priority? Please provide identification for this.
New weapon received. Is there a new order?
Order confirmed equip better gears for bigger challenges.
Engine's running ready to strike.
Objective complete moving on to the next stage.
Mission… Unable to continue…

Order confirmed rest.
No orders?… Boring…
Daily mission: Reminding Senpai to complete his internship.
Even I wasn't ordered to do so I still want to remind you of claiming the rewards.
Accidents detected awaiting orders!
Do you want to meet my blade?
I don't understand but thanks any way~
Oh... This is the best gift I have ever received in my life... I like it very much~
You're back Senpai~

43003.text: Black clothes are fitting for doing things at night. My job isn't suitable for people to see.
Freedom? I don't have that right.
I never go out during the daytime. I didn't know sunlight was so warm...
New objective received. I'll complete it within the deadline.
I have never been to school with everyone because I always carry out my mission.
Mission begins!
Are you my next target? I have to carry on the mission sooner or later.
Under the cover of darkness...
It is the fruit of my labor.
I'm waiting for the next target.
The Academy has very complicated rules there is a lot of them I can't understand.
Why do you want to give me such a good weapon?
Thank you this weapon is really good.
I'm going to wait here quietly for my target.
Another name off the list.
Mission… Failed…

Why is the light off? It does not matter I can use the darkness.
It's amazing I didn't know that important people like Senpai could have time for a snap...

If you want to get rid of me just say the word!
I'll do my best to finish the mission.

The spirit and... I... Are one... Whether this feeling is the spirit or mine... I cannot tell.
I don't know how long you'll last compared to this eternal soul... Everything is like a drop in the ocean.

Remember you got paid for all the work.

Human... What an evil species!

What can I put in my mech gourd?

No... Don't touch me... I don't deserve this... Warmth...

Ah? Have you broken your cellphone? There were no calls nor text messages for a month...
