What's up? Have you come to see me? Another new bug? That's great if there is no bug. I'll go back to work.
Delete... Delete... Delete!
The bug is fixed.
System optimization is completed.
An upgrade? Didn't they even wait for the new semester?!
The computer becomes obsolete can you give me a new processor?
Will this hardware improve the processing speed of my computer?
This annoys me greatly I cannot fix bugs when I am outside!
This is it I need to return home and fix the rest of the bugs now.
The battle system is so bugged!
I made a program to analyze your intentions but came up blank. In this case I will follow my heart...please take good care of me okay?
I'm working Senpai.
It is heaven as long as the wifi is still functional~
With nobody bothering me I can fix the problems faster~
It's time for you to go to work. What are you still doing here?
Unfortunately it is not possible to retrieve the rewards automatically~
Enemies have destroyed the internet on campus~ You have to do something quickly!
I said don't bother me with this so-called "gift" again!
Are you serious? Oh thank you.
I'm glad to receive this. Dating is more interesting than coding~
Welcome back~ I'm working on a bug don't disturb me before I'm done understood?

44001.text: Teddy do you know where are my crystal shoes?
The prince will definitely welcome me from that star~
My sister is such a lazy bum. Argh I'm sure she won't get up if she's so lazy. Do you want to tell her? Forget it.
Why not wear a fluffy skirt? Because... It's too big... It's so easy to trip and fall...
Ah? Where is this? ...Sister? Strange.
Commoners... Get out of the way...
I heard the sound of a horse. Are you my Prince? Will you come and kiss me? Or will you help me put on my crystal shoes?
Teddy Go.
I've become stronger. But why you look so surprised?
Maybe I should try some of this common food.
Hope I could meet my dream lover in the new school age.
This item is not attractive at all.
What's this? I've never seen this before!
Everyone will be impressed by my charm~
Now you low lives should have understood how much I am ahead of you.
How can I get defeated by them?!
I guess you can be my Prince Charming...as a reward for all your efforts.
Senpai you're not bringing anyone else?
It doesn't feel that bad to live in a common room~
It's the most pleasure to enjoy the afternoon-tea every day. It will be even better if someone replaces Senpai with someone else.
Internship? Is that what normal people called work? Can I come and see how you do that?
Well the reward means nothing to me but it might still be something for you. Don't miss it.
Only barbarians would ever destroy the order! Let's go and drive them away!
The stuff is surely beneath my statue.
Thank~ You~
Insignificant commoner you finally understand me. Looks like you've done your homework~ I guess you got my praise~
You're back~

44002.text: Today I will patrol this amusement park!
I want that candy and ice cream! Ah and those doughnuts! They all look so delicious!
I am a beautiful girl guarding the amusement park! Where are the bad guys? I'll protect everyone!
Get those scoundrels! Horsey!
Oh! Thanks to me today's amusement park is peaceful!
Ah! You there! What are you doing! It's you!
I am the Prince Charming who protects the princess in this amusement park. I'll protect is you!
I'm so awesome!
I've got stronger than yesterday!
Even if there are no bad guys I shall still maintain orders of this place.
My domain has expanded now I can protect even more visitors!
Get in the line I don't care who you are.
It's just for keeping orders and it won't harm the visitors.
To better protect the amusement park I have no choice but to fight the bad guys on campus.
I think that gives you a reason not to mess with me!
You only win this battle but it won't be that easy next time!
I will start protecting you just like how I protected the amusement park; you are very important to me after all.
It's another day~
This door is too small for my wooden horse!
If you're happy have fun. If you are tired you can rest. You can do anything you want in this amusement park.
You cannot spend all your time playing. Go to work quickly Senpai!
Don't forget your reward Senpai!
Where are the bad guys? Did you find any sign of them Senpai?
Senpai you need to follow the rules of the amusement park!
A present for me? Thank you~
Thank you Senpai! You're the best!
Welcome back Senpai! What do you want to play today?

44003.text: Fluffy~ Little Jelly~ Senpai what are you looking for?
Welcome. We only sell things from the sea~ Wawawa! I cannot be sold~
Ahhh! Spilled some water! Senpai I'm so sorry. (Cries)
Thank you sir~ Come back next time~
Well you're a little late by just a bit. It's sold out. Don't worry. Well have it in stock next time.
Oh~ Let's go shopping~
I'm dying of thirst. Master please give me water. Little Jelly can't live without water.
Jellyfish Jet~
It's hot today I think I will need more drinks~
Remember to be on a regular diet.
This could be a perfect chance for me to promote my store~
Special discount on that one!
Good wine needs no bush.
Maybe I should change my business strategy?
Dear customer you should pay for the merchandise before you leave!
Is it slack season already?
I'll take care of managing the Store if you agree to help advertise it~Whoops it's "our" Store now!
You come earlier than I expected Senpai.
How should I name the event for tomorrow?
I can use the peace but it's not good for making big money.
Internship? That sounds nice…
No workers will forget to take their salary~
I need a better location for my store. Maybe you can find one for me Senpai.
Haven't we just met? Please don't conduct with dignity!
Thank... you...
Appreciate your gift with my whole heart~
Welcome back Senpai!

44004.text: Priestess is my sister and teacher. She's also the strongest person I know and I like her the most. Oh you're cool too!
I can summon a spirit to see you. Who do you want to see?
Amelia? Yea she is good at predicting the future~ But she sees the future whereas I can see the past.
There are so many new things under the mountain... They're very interesting very complex...
I really want to be together all the time. It's true! You know so many things I don't know. But can someone like me come in handy?
If there's no other choice we fight.
Need my help? Besides my disciples you're the first person I've seen. From now on let's get to know each other!
Returning it back!
This is the best drink I've ever had!
Is this what they called Lunch Box? Thanks so much~
I hope I can make more new friends after this~
Can I keep this?
Sorry but I'm not an experienced fighter.
Since you've asked me to do this I'll give it a try.
Huh? Never thought I could do that.
Don't be too depressed I'm always not a good fighter…
We met by chance yet we were already bound by fate. This is not an estimation of the future; I predicted this from our past. Don't you think so?
Thanks for your time Senpai.
This is enough for me.
Let me practice this once again so I won't let Senpai down when he needs me!
You mentioned that you need to complete an internship today Senpai.
What? You missed the rewards yesterday? Please don't forget to collect your rewards today again!
I don't have much experience in combat but I will stand by your side during battles!
Sorry I don't really like this...
Thanks for the gift.
Thanks for the present truthfully I shall stay with such a nice guy with or without this.
Welcome back Senpai~

44005.text: Ah~ It's sunfish~ Turn that sunfish around~
Puku-chan you're so fat! How can you swim with all that fat~?
Eh... Where am I? Uh... I lost again...
I'm friends with a lot of fish. For example Eh... Are you Haku-chan and Hana-chan?
Ah Puku. Are you drowning? Let me resuscitate you. Eh... Fish can't drown...?
Wow ~Wow ~Wow ~Wow
... Puku-chan where are you? Hah... Where is she?... Are you my master? I have to tell Puku-chan!
Fishes~ Kill them!
What happened?
Why my fish becomes so strong?
Uh? Change my classroom for the new lessons?
I've fully remembered the route to the dorm! Wait did I?
Tool for self-improvement? It sounds nice~
My fish will remind me of the time I should use this don't worry.
Where am I again?
Even my fish won't tolerate your bad behavior.
It's my fault don't blame my fish.
I started missing you as soon as you were gone...I feel a lot more at ease when I'm with you~
My fish says "hello"~
Please have a good rest Senpai.
Shh~ Don't wake him up again!
If you need to carry something heavy for the internship today. My fish can help you~
Only the ones with a memory like a fish would miss the rewards... Did I say something Senpai?
It's time to go and protect the world Senpai!
Don't bully my fish~
Thank you~
Don't worry I will cherish it wholeheartedly.
Welcome back Master!

44006.text: SAW EVERYTHING TO PIECES!
It's difficult to handle because my chain saw is rusty. Hey Master? I wonder if I can polish it with your bones?
AHHHH I want to saw it! My bones are shaking. Saw it! Saw it!
If it is Zombia can I saw her up into pieces? That'd be okay right?
Whatever Master dislikes I will saw it with this chainsaw! But I also want to saw things Master likes! I'll saw it all down!
Oh oh oh my~ My bones are shaking~
Hey you're nice! Can you let me saw something up for you!
Into pieces!
Do you want me to cut this into smaller pieces?
No matter what it is I love it if my chainsaw can cut it!
It's really too bad that no one to have a little interaction with my chainsaw.
The most romantic weapon? In my opinion it's the chainsaw for sure!
I need something sharper.
I like this kind of enemy I can feed them to my chainsaw!
Haha that was some fun!
Oh no! My chainsaw is broken!
I dreamt that I sawed you to pieces...as a part of my wishes are now fulfilled in my dreams I will take good care of you in real life~
And I thought it was Zombia... Hello Senpai...
I need a place to refuel my chainsaw.
I think the rules are nonsense! Why can't I cut Senpai's hands when he's asleep?
Ah? Are you going to work? Ok I'll delay the plan to cut your feet off then.
I don't need your reward I just want permission to cut you into pieces!
Do I really have the right to cut them all down? Great! Let's go kill the new enemies!
Keep your hands away or I'll saw them off~
Gift? For me? What a surprise~
Thank you for your gift. It suits me well~
Welcome back...what will we saw today?!

44007.text: I'm neither human nor am I fully a monster. Please call me "Half-monster".
Human beings are unwilling to accept me. The Demons don't think I'm of the same race... So what am I supposed to do?
Born as a human being... Raised by monsters... I didn't ask for this...
Please don't be afraid. I have the habit of staring at people all the time... Ah not just at people... I stare at everything this way...
Don't be afraid~ I just want to be friends...
Don't mess with me!
Aren't you afraid of me? You are the first person to meet me without getting scared! Can I follow you?
Monster powers!
I'll do my best to become more powerful!
Take a look this is my real power!
Do I have the right to be friends with the new girls?
I‘m different but it doesn't mean I'm to be bullied by everyone!
Thank you for the update I will be careful.
Am I really qualified to use this item?
They are not human do you think they would be afraid of me too?
All who have bullied me shall pay!
I thought bullying is only a behavior between human beings...
Forgive me for my boldness but I'd be very happy if we can take our relationship to the next level...
Is that Senpai? Great!
This room is fine it suits me.
Senpai please don't sleep here! If you don't sleep somewhere warmer you'll catch a cold!
Hmmm I see! You have no choice but to go to work. Just go then you don't need to concern too much about me.
Is that okay? I don't think the mission reward is something not important for you~
Senpai you've been very kind to me very well these days and I shouldn't bother you further. Please count on me when fighting against those enemies!
I'm glad that you remembered to bring me something but it's such a waste to give me something like this...
Friend...Thank you~
Thank you! I like this a lot~ I'm so glad I became friends with you~
Welcome back~ If it doesn't bother you can you stay and chat for a while?

44008.text: Ahhh got scratched again? Really? Take care of yourself you know?
I've been here for several days. Where do you get hurt this time?
Don't be afraid. Rest Assured... Good boy~ Here's a treat.
Come to me earlier. It is the duty of our medical staff to save lives and injuries.
It's our duty to save lives and help the injured.
Ready? Start the operation!
Are you okay? If there's anything I can do to help please don't hesitate to come to me!
Now even I am angry!
My medical skill is improved everyday~
Although I cannot cure all wounds but you can count on me if you're not hurt that bad!
It's just a scratch it won't be hurting anymore by the end of today.
Doctor won't always be able to fix you up after you do something dangerous! I'm serious about this!
I need to be more cautious when using a thinner needle.
Remember to come here and have a reexamine here! This is not the kind of wound that heals easily.
Leave the wounded to me I can take care of all of them!
Don't underestimate the power of a doctor!
I didn't carry enough medicine for everyone here let's retreat first!
It's a doctor's job to look after the sick but it's my responsibility to take care of you~
Good morning Senpai.
A good rest will help the wounds to heal quicker.
It's a good habit to keep 8 hours of sleep but it's still harmful to your body if you just sleep here!
Don't let your muscles do severe exercise during the internship your wound might tear because of this.
Well done for completing the quests Senpai! But please don't forget to claim your rewards.
Combat medic is important during the war so I'm not planning to escape! Come with me and support the other students Senpai!
Little brother... I never thought you're like that!
Thanks bro~
I'll put it to good use won't let you down~
Welcome back~

45001.text: Haha~ Haven't you noticed~ It's already too late to run~
Tragic~Turning into a toy and not having a clue!
Bad little toy... Why... Why won't you play with me?
What I want is a toy that listens~ Just listen to me and play with me~
Toys can't just refuse their master's order~ You're a good boy ~ You better entertain me! Otherwise I'll throw you into the garbage can~
More toys to collect~
Oh are you my new toy? Looks good~ Hehe. Yes stay with me!
Good boy~ Disappear!
Is that it? You barely gave me a sip!
Your empress has become more powerful it's time for you to compliment her!
Remember! No matter where you are I will always be holding your chain~
I need more toys! Quickly get me some toys!
Is that all you can find? At least you've tried your best~
Finally a gear that suits my position!
Where to find some new toys today?
Why do you think you can defeat me?
I won't forget what have you done to me today...

I never imagined a mere mortal like you have what it takes to stay by my side until now. I guess that qualifies you to be promoted from "Toy" to "Servant"...That doesn't mean you can shirk your duties of playing with me understood?
You come right before I got too bored!
Have you prepared any toy for me?
I am bored~ Mortal! Try your best to entertain me!
Go to work and pay me tribute with what you've earned!
There is a reward for you you were a good toy!
I didn't do anything but it looks like something interesting find out what happens and report back to me~
Aha you're here to seek your death?
Not enough for me!
That's it! I mean it's just a toy but... Well done~
How should I play with you today...?

45002.text: Why resort to violence when we can solve problems with dialogue? I don't understand it at all.
Negotiation is a science and an art. I hope you understand that.
All conflicts in the world can be resolved through dialogue. If you don't believe it I'll show you.
The purpose of a dialogue isn't to decide whether it is a one-sided victory. It is to benefit all parties.
There are many ways to solve problems. Violence is the most stupid way. I don't understand it at all.
Let the negotiation begin!
Since our goal is to create a win-win situation we can work together. Glance over the details of the contract.
I am against it!
Is it for free? That's a generous behavior.
You've offered me power and I shall offer you help in return.
There's a lot more for you to learn about negotiation.
If possible I'd wish to solve all the problems with non-violent method but it turns out sometimes the threat of force is necessary.
The pen is mightier than the gun.
These look a lot better than the ones you offered last time thanks.
Let me show you how speechcraft actually works.
This could be ended in an easier way.
Why don't they even try to negotiate?
Here sign your name on this contract...What's it about? It's not important...There that makes you my official partner as per the contract!
You've finally decided to show up~
This room is good enough for me thanks.
If you've got nothing to do just randomly pick a topic and debate with me.
Internship is an important part of social practice you should not miss that.
Don't forget to claim your rewards. Be aware of the devil in the details.
Maybe you will be interested with the incidents happening now.
I need a reason for this!
Bonus for the contract? Thanks~
I like it very much~ Now let's renew the contract agreement. What do you think?
Welcome back Senpai!

Behind that beautiful appearance there must be something darker than darkness itself... The true face of evil...
What? I am charming and strong? Of course I am. HAHA~ Asking to die isn't very hard.

Light? Of course I hate it the most~ In the end mankind escapes the darkness and clings to the light don't they?

Oh people still want to be friends? It's all right. It'll bring you deep feelings of terror in a moment!
I won't think twice.
Drink half and dump the other half hahaha! It's funny to see the expression on your face!
That's all you've been able to prepare in a very long time and I'll eat it all in no time~ Hahaha!
Only the fools would enjoy the school life… What? You're one of them?
I am the most powerful dark mage in the world! No one can control me!
Give it to me! It's nothing for you but something for me!
It's mine now!
If you see an ant you should slowly raise your foot and---- TRAMPLE! It's so fun!
Isn't that an obvious consequence?
Uh… I let my guard down…
Alright alright I admit that there is no darkness without light...Without you I don't think I can survive much longer.
Hey don't turn on the light!
Can't you find a darker place?
It feels good to spend some of your time in darkness right?--- Darkness is not something always bad~
Go to work now I can use your salary!
If you don't get your rewards now it will not be yours anymore~
Ah! Something fun is finally happening!
Non-entities are unreasonable as expected!
Uh-huh thanks for your present~
Hmm you have good taste. Thank you for giving me something as cute as I~ You finally start to enjoy the darkness?
You're finally back~

Ah~ You're a bit clumsy. I love it~! So cute~
Why beat that guy? Oh~ Maybe because he's not pleasant to look at~
Must we do that? If I knock them out I'll get my beautiful hands dirty.
I know I'm beautiful~ But if you keep staring at me I'll pull your eyes out~ Literally~
Your life ends here~
Ah~ You called me? You're really interested~ I'm a bit gentle. If there is anything you don't understand don't hesitate to find me~
Good bye~
You're so cute~
So... Is that it?
I will not leave you~ Even after graduation~
This doesn't fit me at all.
Yes this will work~
Don't mind if I do~
This is what you will get for going against me~
Next time you won't be able to win this easily!
I wanted to protect you the moment I saw you. You will never be lonely again with me by your side~
Where are we heading today?
As long as it is provided by you~
He shouldn't be late! This is just ridiculous…
What a pity! We'd already be in an amusement park if you've finished your internship today.
Claim your rewards before thieves take them away~
They want a fight? We give them a fight!!!
Ahh~ You're really bad at choosing presents!
Present for me? Thanks~
Ahh~ Nothing is cuter than this! I really like it~
Welcome back I've been wondering where you've been~

46002.text: Ahh wait a moment... My bomb will... Blow... Up~
Fear... Dread... Trembling right? Ahaha! It's cute just like a small animal~
Did you see the smoke coming out over there? That's the smoke that frightens people~
If I don't cooperate with her she can't play with me at all. Ah so annoying.
Oh! There are so many people here. How relaxing it would be to blow everyone up?
Everything~ In Ruins~ YAHAHA~
How's that? A bold move right? Ehh let's just find everybody! It will be fun! But be careful I'm only saving you~
Boom！
Since you are still sober let's detonate the bomb at once~ Otherwise I can only have the fun alone.
If you see me on the battlefield be very careful as there will be many explosives hidden~
Can I detonate bombs during the evening? It must be fun right?
The new type of gunpowder explodes better~
If you can see it why is it called a hidden bomb?
Ahah! You arrived at the right time! After all if there's no audience how can we call this a carnival?!
Why there's no audience for the performance? Guess the explosion also blown them away~
You just got lucky.
Well well well you've grown on me. Don't worry I take good care of those that I care about...and blow the rest up~
Mind your steps when you enter I set several claymores near the door.
A bedroom is a place to rest I won't bomb it!
It's rare for the Academy to be so quiet what about detonating a bomb right now?
Is this where you work? Ok I will not explode this building!
If you don't need your reward I can blow it up for you~
It's been a long time since I blew up anything these enemies surely can do a little favor for me.
Don't you know what I hate? Or do you want to be blown away?
Well a present??
You are a nice guy. It's my cup of tea. Thanks~
Welcome back! What should we blow up today?

46003.text: The heart of justice is to guide peace. I will be the guardian of this world!
Praise thee~ This sacred light will cleanse everything!
Bright light will come mortal. Trust in God!
There is always a place where light cannot reach. My duty is to bring light to every corner.
Before I became an angel I hoped I could be a good person.
Holy Light spread all over the world~
Hello! I'm God's messenger who is sent to this world. I heard you needed help. Please tell me your wish.
Holy Light!
In the name of the light.
No need to worry everything is in the plan of fate.
All the rules are made to be obeyed.
The light cannot do anything for us so sometimes it's up to us to decide how things will be like.
My halo is not children's toy!
A staff? I've already got one.
Today will still be a day to free others from their troubles.
The darkness won't be able to hide under the light!
The power of the light is fading...
I will not stray from my path...but I would be glad if you can come with me on my journeys.
Do you need my help Senpai?
With my light magic this lamp is useless.
Looks like I can finally have a rest today~ If Senpai is around he would always cause troubles to let us get worried…
Senpai! Can you hear me? You will be late for work if you don't leave now!
Please don't forget to collect what you have earned!
Enemy in darkness? Please don't worry we just need to go and defeat them~
Hmm~ No mess with me I'll tell Michael if you do!
Is this for me? Thank you very much~
Present thanks~ You're really a nice guy!
Welcome back Senpai!

51001.text: Ah my followers again? Sorry. I don't like weaklings.
I hate muscle heads like that girl.
Using Brute force without applying your brains won't work~
The strong prey on the weak. That is the basic law of the world isn't it?
Become dependable. If we always depend on others we won't last long.
Use my power!
What I value is not strength but belief. Only with firm beliefs can anyone be strong. Well I like your spirit. Let me make you strong.
Break your soul!
I'll take that what should I give you in return? Just kidding~
The path to be stronger is like sailing against the current; if you don't advance you will retreat.
I believe this stage of education is still easy for you to handle.
Don't forget all the hard work you've done today will be paid off in the future.
According to our relationship a "Thank you" won't be necessary.
You must have paid much effort when preparing this for me.
It's a perfect chance for us to discuss the problems we've recently met~
They're just like other enemies got defeated!
I should train harder so I won't lose next time.
Thank you I will cherish this feeling...but there's something else that I should say now isn't it? Such as "I do"?
Oh Senpai… Sorry I just fell asleep when reading.
Have a seat and don't interrupt my reading.
Oh Senpai's asleep~ It's my best chance to do something to him…
Hope you haven't forgotten the internship today.
Updates for today's quest? The next step is to collect the reward~
Something happened again maybe we can check it out.
Don't interrupt me I'm trying to reflect on life.
Very grateful for this gift.
My heart has been filled by you I'll cherish it forever.
Welcome back Senpai. Long-time no see! How is everything?

51002.text: Draw a card. The chance is 50/50. But I'll definitely win~
Wealth or health~ It doesn't matter which one you choose. You'll lose for sure~
Don't pull my rabbit ears! Go away gosh I hate you!
Whoo~ How scary~ How scary~ Did I get the guess right about your aspirations?
Luck is my greatest strength~ Ah do you want me to prove that?
It's showtime～
Ah~ Congratulations this isn't a spade K~ This is the strongest card. You seem to have a lot of good things. Are you going to trust me with your life?
My turn~
Ah~ It's not bad~
What has to happen will happen~
Do you think my opponent will be stronger than before?
Why don't you give me some more materials? If you agree so I will let you win when we play trump card next time~
If you give me one piece of equipment I would win you five. How about that?
This clothes suits me I'll keep it!
What do you want to play today? Just say whatever comes into your mind.
Sorry but I'm on the lucky side today.
Huh? How? This is impossible…

Welcome~ Hope you can win your room back today~
Do you want to bet this room against what you lost the last time?
You can't sleep if you're not well covered or you'll get sick. And after that who will be playing cards with me?
It's time to go to work~
Before we start the next round why don't you claim your rewards first?
Don't worry nothing will happen to you as long as you stay with me!
Forget it... I thought you weren't doing it on purpose. I'll forgive you this time.
Is this for me? Thank you~
No playing cards? Then let's settle for the next best thing~ Your gift looks pretty fun so let's make use of it!
Yo ho~ Senpai is back!

51003.text: Taste of blood~ Delicious~ Just as expected~ Hahaha.
Master is mine and mine alone. I'll take out all who get near Master!
I want to always be with Master. Master is only mine right?
Master likes me the most right? I believe in Master.
I'm not going to let Master out of my sight~ I'll chain you up in shackles~ Hehe~
You will never make it to master!
Oh master you are the most delicious thing in the world. I can't stand it anymore!
I'm immortal~
I'll drink it all~ Only because it's given by you~
This is a miracle made by your love!
I can do anything or go anywhere as long as it's your order.
I cannot live without you anymore! Please take the responsibility for making me like this~
I will wear any clothes given by you!
OHHHHHH! I smell master on this shirt~
I'll be right back~
Death to everything that goes against my master!
It's all my fault please punish me if that can make you feel better~
Hunger thirst lust...but you will fulfill all of them today won't you Master?
Master welcome home!
Master are you inviting me to live with you?
Master if you don't say anything... Then you're not refusing me to sleep with you!
I wish you can always be here with me but it's time to work now.
Master remember to take your rewards~
Why there's always so much noise on campus I cannot let anyone disturb the time I can spend with my master!
Why did you give me this? Are you starting to dislike me?
If I find out that you are sending gifts to others guess what will happen~ Hehehe~
Ah~ Gift from master~ Is this symbol of our love?
You're finally back Master! Don't just sneak away like that again!

51004.text: Human your blood belongs to only me!
Get out of the way. Things won't go well if my prey is stolen.
Sunlight and the cross? What kind of inferior creature do you think I am?
Come to my room tonight and offer me your blood.
Guess how old I am!
Oh? You want to die?
Your blood... It tastes good. I'll let you stay at my castle. But remember to donate some blood.
Want to be a vampire?
The taste is not so bad~
I have become more powerful ~ Human! Your blood did help~
For me going up in class is not important but if it makes you happy I'll try that.
Pledge me your fealty and I will offer you my power!
We vampires don't need this kind of equipment but since you've given it to me I can show you how it works.
This equipment is said hard to be found~ Human you've shown your loyalty~
I'm going out for a walk don't leave here until I return!
That was easy~
This is not acceptable.
Hmph I have been wondering when will you bring this topic up... Are you not happy? Don't worry I'll stay with you forever~
Hey! How dare you leave me in this humble room!
Comparing with my castle this room is more like a cat box!
Hey~ I'm bored tell me a joke!
Return once you complete the internship don't make me wait too long!
Go and confirm your rewards~
It's too noisy! You should go and see what's going on~
Boring! Useless! As I claimed humans are so dull!
Hey~ You are not that boring after all mortal~
Although blood is better this may also do the job~ Your effort is commendable.
Ha! Human give me a proper greeting!

51005.text: This is Wu Kong the great! Come and kneel before me!
The Goddess peach? That's just an ordinary peach.
Come and have a look! Who's coming?
The Great Sage Heaven's Equal is here!
I'm invincible! So I'm daring enough to challenge Buddha and destroy the world! Uh! Peach! It's not that easy to bribe me... Who you want me to kill?
Vade retro satanas
I am not an ordinary monkey! I am Wu Kong the great. Remember that!
Take this!
Exp juice? Why don't they make Exp Peaches?
Senpai! Take a look! It seems my staff has become bigger!
Can I also get a promoted peach supply? Just 1... I mean 1/2 of a peach each day would be nice!
Maybe I will become the true Monkey King in the future!
Oh! Thank you Senpai! I'll be more grateful if you can bring me some peaches next time~
Only gears like this could be compared with my Golden Cudgel!
Playing outside? Let's go then~
No evil dares to stand against my mighty power!
You're stronger... For now.
I never thought I'd be willing to stay with a mere mortal but I don't mind if it is you~
Senpai! You've finally returned!
Excellent! This room reminds me of my home!
STOP SLEEPING! It's game time!
Do you also have an internship to complete like the others Senpai?
Senpai! Have you completed the quests?
Something interesting must be happening! Let's go and take a look!
Ah~ I don’t like this!
You want me to have this? But peaches are better...
I told you I only accept Peaches...hey what's that? I've never seen anything like it before thank you~
Senpai! Senpai! Welcome back! Did you bring any peaches for me today?

51006.text: Talent effort and faith. These are what is required to be a swordswoman.
Delicate and elegant. Swordsmanship is an art!
I accept your challenge! I like what is beautiful and powerful.
More than 50000 swordsmen are stronger than me in the world. That's why I aim high.
Don't retreat! Face death head-on! Retreating is worse than death!
In the name of knight attack!
Fencing is an art. It's not hard to swing a blade. But becoming a master is a different story. You must be strong and beautiful.
Draw your sword.
An Exp drink after training is the best~
More people will be saved if I can thrust faster. I must become stronger!
Well besides having proper training you should also show some effort on study!
I'm still not a qualified knight right now but I do not cease advancing on my way there!
No one shall be blamed for well-equipped.
It really is a very nice piece of equipment. I'm sure you must have paid a lot to forge it~ Thank you! I will not disappoint you!
For the ones who train hard every day this is nothing.
If you also train hard as I do you can also win like this!
It's a pity to lose this time. But we shall train harder and win back later!
I am still not strong enough and yet you still trust me. I am so happy~ I will work harder and keep practicing... Besides fencing I could also work harder on other things.
Are you here to practice fencing techniques with me?
It's a nice place for me~
I discovered new techniques maybe I can share my discoveries with you later~
It's almost the time for your internship the contract says that you can not be late~ I suggest you obey that.
You still have rewards unclaimed and they're what you deserve.
There's something interesting going on on campus maybe you would want to check it out?
Seriously??? Do you think my taste is just as bad as yours?
Haha~ You're not so lame after all~
Hmm~ I admit you've done well... On the field of sending gifts you've proven yourself... Hmph t-thank you!
Hello! Senpai did you practice fencing today?

51007.text: Let me stomp them flat!
Vegetables? You don't need that! You can't grow stronger without meat!
Break the bones to make soup.♪
You should eat meat too. The most delicious thing in the world is meat. Meat is justice!
I'm not sure if you have something more valuable than meat~
Fight for meat!
Hey hey give me some meat! It's not for me it's for the elephants!... Eh? Elephants are herbivores?
Go home!
It will taste better with meat!
I shall be faster. I don't want Quinie to take all the food I deserve next time!
What? Graduate? Does that mean more meat in Cafeteria?
No dieter ever becomes stronger!
I'll need another gear set for my pet~
Surrounded by food~ That's what I call paradise!
I hope to see you preparing a barbecue when I return~
The biggest mistake you've made is to stand between me and meat!
I need more food before I can actually fight…
Having someone to eat with is great but someone who can cook for me? I'll spend my whole life with him!
Senpai! Do you bring anything to eat today?
This is not bad as long as I'm not living with Sonya.
You don't look well Senpai. I told you that you should eat more.
Senpai! Time to go and earn meat~
Remember to collect your daily rewards. I don't want to see you have not enough money to buy me enough meat.
What happened… Not my business as long as it's not happened in Cafeteria~
Neither delicious! Nor amusing!
What's this? Can I eat it?
Meat stands for justice! Finally you're starting to understand~
Master! You're back. I want some meat!

51008.text: Cherry blossoms will fall sooner or later. Good things won't last forever.
Please don't be sad. The instant the flower blooms it is the most dazzling moment.
My sword is light... Like cherry blossoms in the wind... Gentle yet powerful... There's nothing I can't cut.
Did you see that? The even the moment it withers is so beautiful... Cherry blossoms.
Seeing the wonderful life of cherry blossom... Shouldn't we do our best to live like it?
Let the flowers blossom on the battlefield!
With the cherry blossoms I shall stand by your side as well as... My undying fealty.
Flowers seal them!
This happens every day don't get too surprised.
I will continue to protect everything.
It's almost time to go to class... Wait it's also about time for the cherry blossoms to bloom right?
People will wait for the day when the cherry blossoms bloom because they fall quickly.
Don't bother I've brought my own gears.
The metal feels cold but I can understand that's something necessary.
Understood thank you.
It takes a lot to take lives but I won't hesitate to do this to my enemies.
Retreat now there's no winning here.
No matter how long it will take the cherry blossoms here will await your arrival and bloom only for you.
I'm going out to train do you want to come with me?
What a peaceful place~
This is the first time I have seen you so calm maybe I should use this metallic device to record this moment?
Senpai don't forget your arrangement you have to go to work.
Senpai you haven't forgotten to claim your rewards right?
Senpai something is happening near the cherry trees let's go check it out!
My apologies but I have no idea how to handle this… They are too high tech for me to understand.
You have my gratitude.
I never imagined there to be something this wonderful… Thank you this means a lot to me! I really appreciate it~
Cherry blossoms will bloom in a blink of an eye Senpai. Please cherish all the times we spent.

51009.text: This dance will bring you God's blessing.
Someday I'll stand at the top. Praised by all!
Dance! Let everyone know the beauty of harmony.
Wherever there is a stage to dance at I'll be there.
Meaning of life..? To show others the beauty of harmony through dance.
Dance to a Battle Song.
Master I'll be your personal dancer.
Dance with me
Thank you~
Do I look more charming than before?
Maybe I shall celebrate this?
I will keep dancing with or without audience.
This dress can be used in my performance.
It's really nice! Can I try it on right now?
I'm happy to obey your orders~
It's already enough for me to know that I've actually helped.
Don't worry they won't win next time.
It's not important whom I dance for but I'd like it a lot if you will be there whenever I dance in the future~
I've developed a new dance it's your lucky day~
Is this the room for me? Hope it has soundproof walls~
You look tired. If you need a rest please use my tails as the pillow.
It's time for you to work I need a rest too~
Don't forget your rewards~
Anything new on campus?
Don't ever give me that gift again! It will mess up my dancing!
Are you here to enjoy my dance? Oooh a gift? Thank you~
Thanks for your gift master. And in return let me teach you how to dance~
Master. You came. Wanna see me dance?

51010.text: Sun? It's best if the sun doesn't rise. Let's shroud the world in complete darkness.
How dazzling... This is the kind of person I hate the most.
Who will I savor today? This child? But that one looks delicious too...
Sad. Angry. Melancholy. I am so full today. Can't eat anymore.
Little sister. Will you come play with me? I love you so very much.
Tell me why are you afraid. Huh?
Oh? You have some secrets. Not going to tell me? If I put on an act and play along maybe I'll enjoy it!
Let darkness... Consume everything!
Hmmm? This tastes good~
The power of darkness increases! It’s really nice.
Now I've moved into the upper class people look much more appetizing here~
The more powerful the emotions humans can express the more powerful I will become~
No matter the power is from light or darkness it's the power's owner to decide if it is evil.
Huh? You happened to pick the gears I like.
Who am I going to eat today?
Get back I believe you can take more torture from me!
Ugh… That's too shiny for me…
I have to say I am happy when I am with you... Do you want to go a little further? Hey if it is you... Then it's no problem.
Welcome back Senpai~
Can you offer a darker place? The light bothers me.
I detect no emotional readings... Ah he's asleep ...
Human it's time to go to work~
If you don't claim your rewards in time I'll take it~
I'm not interested in campus news ~ However I'm sure you should take a look.
Do you want me to eat you up?
Considering you gave me this gift I won't eat you today~
Smells like darkness~ I like that~
We meet again Human. Aren't you going to run? Hahahaha...

51011.text: ...Wait are you talking to me? Can you repeat that? I seem to have zoned out again...
I wonder if there are any new books today...
What do you think about Grand Library Ulbricht? What do you mean that there are too many storybooks? They are all very good reads!
I can't believe I drooled on a book when I was asleep last night...How can I?!
I will not sleep on top of a book today! I swear I won't!
An intruder? Where? Where is he? Where should I aim my attack?
You there help me with these books...yes you and now! Whew that was close...I'm Valeera! Nice to meet you!
It's Valeera's turn!
You're so nice~ (Drinking)
I'm not a kid anymore! Just put me in charge of this!
Does it mean I can make some new friends after this? Haha~
Hey look over there! It used to be a hill and I blasted it into atoms! I've totally become stronger!
Everyone can become cuter by putting on a dress! Do you want to try this on too?
Cute clothes are the best cure to the bad moods~ Hehe
Would you read with me?
We've won already? But I haven't even finished reading my storybook yet…
Why there's nobody standing?
Looks like something is going to happen soon but Valeera doesn't feel anything...
Huh? When did you get in?

Before I forget I think it's necessary to remind of your internship~
You still got rewards unclaimed Senpai~
Wait there must be something happening… Really? It's already a piece of old news?
Hmmm...Valeera don't want this...
Is this for me? Thank you!
Wow this is awesome! Give me more! Give me more!
Come over to the Library today will you?

51012.text: Arrows that miss narrowly...Dancing out of the way of a sharp blade...This is true excitement!
Living peacefully is so boring...
Fighting makes me happy~

I am Fenrir and don't you dare forget! I will change the world!
Let's fight!

Make me stronger!

Ugh what is that? Take it back and leave.

What kind of adventure lies ahead this time?
I’m Vivian! I’m here with the guidance from the stars! Hehe are you the person that I’m looking for?
Stars show me the way!
What a peculiar drink! Are there other flavors too? I'd love to try it!
I’m stronger! Now I can go on many more adventures!

Just like the stars said!
Hmm… that’s weird did I misinterpret the stars?

Can you prepare a room for me where I can see the stars?
Senpai let’s go… Ah fast asleep…? May the stars protect you in your dream. Oh the voices of the stars are even clearer within dreams.
Senpai are you out for your internship? I should go help out with my fortune telling.

Do you find a pale cold body charming...? You're strange.

Don't worry I have no obsession with human blood. I have always lived by drinking the blood of small animals. Although this will weaken my ability... but it's better than becoming the same monster as a vampire.

The people in my memory... although their faces are clear. But my bond with them is slowly disappearing and only the hatred for vampires remains. If this continues one day I will become a real monster right? Perhaps it's for the best...
Dracula... The vampire who made me this way and for what purpose exactly...? Once she regains her memory she will give me the answer then I will complete my revenge.
I have no interest in other prey besides vampires... but if you're seeking death then come forth.

I'm Von Helsing a vampire hunter. I'm not human nor am I a vampire. Well either way I'm a "monster". But it doesn't matter I only have one goal and that is the severed head of the vampire... So where is she?
It's hunting time.
Hmm guess it's better than the blood of small animals at least.
Is it the human part... or the vampire part that becomes stronger?
Even monsters can have a chance to learn? What an inexplicable place.

The power of the vampire... it will bring me ever closer to becoming a monster. But if it achieves my purpose and helps you accomplish your ideal... then use it. I've already accepted the various consequences.
As long as I can achieve my goal I will use whatever gear is required.
Hunting preparation...
Where is the prey...
It's over. But my hunting will continue.
Still not enough? I should bring out my monster side more.

Then you are ready to die from blood loss right? Well I do appreciate your presence. It helps me recall my humanity... and still feel the warmth.
You're here to disturb me again?
A human residence... How long has it been since I've lived in one?
Fell asleep again? Hmph you're a real slacker. Ah the neck... is defenseless...... no no no what is wrong with me...
Do you go out of your way for your companions? Hmm... I used to do that too.
I don't hunt for rewards. But it's not bad to be rewarded either.
There is movement in the woods... It's a prey hurry.
Wanna die?
To prepare a gift for a monster like me. You're strange too.
This is... nostalgic... but I don't know if I can still taste it now. In any case thank you.
You're finally here get ready and get going.

51015.text: What? You think I'm crazy? Then you must've not met my former companions.
The sound of bones breaking is truly beautiful. What do you think Senpai?
Everything of Senpai belongs to me! All! Everything! All mine!
Ah… The Senpai today is handsome too… But of course only the Senpai of mine is the most dashing~
An ordinary life is not worth wasting. My time is highly valuable~
I can take on any whether it's one-on-one or one vs many. All of you will perish in the end anyways~
I'm Blair the one and only~ Anyone that comes near you will be killed by me so you better keep your eyes on me only got that Senpai?
Assassination takes skills is it the same for love? I see a thing such as love rivalry would be easier to get rid of by killing them off.
This drink is awful! Wait what? I can be together forever with Senpai if I drink this? That's great!
If I become stronger then I can be inseparable from Senpai right?
I don't get what's the point of learning these… If we were to have an assissination exam without a doubt I'd come first…
If I become stronger then I can be inseparable from Senpai right? Now that I'm strong nothing can separate us!
Complicated things are a burden. A heavy burden…
Hmph barely a pass. But you can't expect much from the craftmanship of ordinary people.
Battle? I'll be right back. Senpai~ Wait for me~
Senpai did you see my heroic stance? Isn't it dazzling? Have you… fallen in love with me yet?
Damn it damn it damn it! Senpai you didn't see me lose right? Can't believe it…
An oath? I don't believe in such a thing. Senpai my love for you is beyond words… This love is like a heavy shackle but it'll be a weight you have to bear~ And should you betray me I will kill you~
Dearest… Senpai! You've come to see me! I'm so happy you've finally come to see me!
Senpai will you live with me? Ah… No? This home is meaningless to me then… Any place without Senpai is meaningless.
I wonder what Senpai's up to? Is he spending time with someone else? I guess they're all annoying after all when can I kill all of them.
Intern? What internship? Is it interesting? But it's not going on a date with Senpai… Well if I work hard and not hurt anyone then will you reward me by going on a date with me right?
This thing is worthless. The best reward in the world is if Senpai dates me forever~
Urgh "battling". It's delaying my date with Senpai! Let's get it over with! Senpai wait for me~
What kind of gift is this? Who do you think you're giving a gift to? Seems like you want to die.
Average standards. Ordinary taste.
Ahh this is wonderful! This is more touching than captivating Senpai's heart~
It's been awhile Senpai. I've missed you so much~ You've finally come to see me~

52001.text: Coffee tea or me?
I can do anything for you.
There's no need to be serious in front of me~ I know all about you.
Do you want to play with me? Surely you'll be satisfied!
As long as you can be happy I can do anything~
Love me~
Greetings Master. You won't be lonely in the nights with me by your side.
Hmm~ That burning sensation~
[Kisses] ~ I'll trade you a kiss for a drink I believe this is an even deal~
Why are you staring at me? Even I would somehow feel embarrassed~
You don't study enough~ Do you want me to give you private lessons?
You've taken another step closer to mature congratulations~
It's a rare opportunity ~ Maybe you should let me try one something more special? Ahaha ~
These are really nice clothes~ Maybe you prefer when I'm not wearing anything?
It's a rare chance for us to be in this place~ Don't you want us to have some fun?
I was expecting more resistance.
Stop! That's going to hurt tomorrow~
I thought we've already passed this stage by now...here come closer...mwah~
Don't leave me alone here stay with me~
Wow this place is nice~
You look so tempting when you close your eyes and let your guards down… Ah I cannot think anymore before I actually do something to you~
Senpai maybe you can skip today's work and stay with me? No I'm kidding go ahead!
Don't forget to collect your rewards~
Let's go together and see if something's happening on campus~
What's wrong? This isn't like you~
Some presents are never too small after all. Thanks for that~
Maybe I shall consider myself as a present in return? Haha~
Waited a long time Master. How do you want to have fun today?

52002.text: Since you're my master remember to dress up! Don't be lazy. Your hair needs to be constantly taken care of ~
This hair dryer will blow all your troubles away~
Welcome to visit~ Let me help wipe your back~
Should I take a rose bath or a lily bath~? Which is better?
Hehe~ I've been through a hundred battles. Don't believe me? Let's go.
Okay! I'll help you dry your hair~
Seriously? My hair isn't dried yet and I have to go out~ If you don't treat me right I won't forgive you.
Whooaaa~
The drink after shower tastes the best in the world~
Bathing is also a method to become stronger! Bubble bath current bath hot spring bath… Each one of them can make you a better person~
All work and no play will make you a dull boy. Come live a little and have a shower with me~
This is a new hair-dryer do you want to see what it can do?
I totally don't understand why they invented tights.
This is a nice bathrobe~
I will be there right after a shower.
That's what we call an absolute win!
I should take a shower before battle next time...
Starting from today I'll allow you to rub my back~I sure will look forward to that~
Are you here for a shower Senpai?
Can I take my bathtub into the room?
Take your time. It must be a tough day...
Isn't it already the time for work?
The rewards are still waiting for you to collect~
You're going to solve the problem again? I know it's your duty but... Don't put all the stress on yourself~
I hate this thing... I really don't want this~
I barely accept~ Don't let me down next time~
You didn't let me down~ Let me think about how to reward you~
Hey wanna go to the bathing spot with me?

52003.text: Even if I have one eye I won't lose to you~ Come!
That's a good way to talk. The men in our grassland are all hands-on and never say anything~
Are you provoking me? Ha~Ha~ It’s been awhile since someone is so eager to seek their own death~
Oh~ Straightforward I like people of like you! Ha ha~
See that wolf? I can take it down in three seconds. Wanna see me try?
Do you want to get cut?
If you can beat me I'll see you as my Master. Want to try me?
Cut!
That's the drink they've been talking about right?
I found myself become stronger after all this Senpai!
Guess I'm going to bother you more on study in the future...
I don't care if I can become stronger or not as long as I'm free to do anything I want.
People rely on clothes horse saddle~
As a gift I can think of few better~
Do you want a ride with me?
It always feels so good to win a battle!
Ouch maybe we shouldn't fight this one.
I want to ride with you in the sunset...it sounds weird when I'm not in my usual attire isn't it?
It's about time for you to be here~
Hope you've also prepared some fine hay for my horse…
Senpai is so cute… Ahhhhh! Better find a distraction before I commit a crime…

Just claim the rewards quickly!
Something's happening? Hope the fun part is not over when I get there!
Are you kidding me?
Oh thanks~
Looks like you truly know me~
Senpai don't run! My fist is a little itchy. Practice with me!

52004.text: Law and order are made by the strong. So I'll be the law.
No matter how dirty you play no one will be knowing that if you win.
History is written by the winners. The weak have no right to intervene.
I just want to make the college more orderly. To be the strongest in this college is my goal.
I don't like things I can't control. In order to control this I need to get stronger.
I'm no longer pulled by any strings.
Hello I heard you're nice. In my academy people like you are needed. How about rule this academy together?
Get out of the way
I want some more!
I can feel the power! Now all that I need is an excuse to use it!
I'll need others' help to achieve my ambition. Let's start with you!
Without power all ideals are just nothing!
Give me all what you got!
Nice gear! Thank--- I mean I accept your tribute~
I'll do that as long as I'm the team leader.
Let the weaklings back off this is not somewhere for them to have fun!
This defeat won't stop my campaign…
Oath? I already said yes. You just haven't realized it... How can I do it with you? Well that is just a part of rules Huh~
Please join my military counsel in the remaining part of my meeting.
I can use this room as my HQ.
Uh… Was my lecture this boring?
Don't forget to work!
Get me my rewards back!
Go and check what happened and report back to me.
This... Is useless to me.
Ah I have to admit it is a friendly exchange within the law.
I have to admit I like this present very much. Maybe you should join me on this adventure?

52005.text: Slash-the-evil!
Cut down all obstacles!
Where morality and justice is I'll be there even if I had to cut billions of them!

I've predicted all what's gonna happen~
I should welcome whatever comes my way.
It's a pleasure to talk with wise people.
Fate is never irreversible for I have foreseen a new possibility in the future!
What about trying my new idea?
I still miss my old cherry fan.
Anything to surprise me today?
The result of this battle is already been calculated before it's begun.
We cannot alternate the end of the failure. But we can work harder to avoid that from happening again.
Although I knew this day would come I just never expected so much from it! Will we have a bright future~ Let's get to know each other more~
Senpai are you the only visitor?
Parting is for making the reunion next time better.
Well I knew this would happen so I prepared an extra blanket for you~
I knew you would forget the internship! You should be thankful that I've already told your employer an excuse about your late.
Collecting rewards is something must be done by yourself Senpai!
I have an idea about what happened. But I still think we need to go and check it out ourselves just in case.
I... I don't want such a childish gift!
Alright I shall barely accept this gift.
You’re not boring after all I will accept this gift with my full gratitude~ I expect to see you again~
Good morning~ Just the person I wanted to see!

54009.text: My chest is just a lump of fat! Hmph!
The most important thing is a gentle mind~ That's why... Hey! Would you stop staring at my chest!
Oh really Pandy? Even though you're hungry you can't eat those weird corn.
Shh~ Did you hear that~ The birds are calling me.
You know how shallow it is to judge someone by the size of their chest!?
Pandy knock them out!
I'm Pandaria! If you treat me like a child you'll suffer!
Bamboos hurt! Doesn't it?!
I won't lose anyone again!
Pandy let's try that move again!
It's a fresh start all I should worry about is Pandy's attitude about this~
Pandy you can bite anyone who claims that I'm still a child!
Pandy you've become too fat to fit in any of these gears.
I'm already powerful enough with or without these gears!
Pandy let's go~
See? Just as I said Pandy is the best!
Pandy don't try anymore be a wise boy and retreat with me!
No matter what will happen in the future I will always take your side! Just ask Pandy if you have any doubts!
I'm not so happy to have you here as I appeared to be Senpai!
Pandy come quickly! This our new room!
Pandy Senpai's asleep! Now it's our chance to skip class and play outside~
Hey! You'll be late for the internship if you don't stop playing right now!
Let's just say I'm not the only person who knows you have rewards unclaimed~
Is there something happening today? I saw a lot of people assembling in the Playground.
You... Stupid! Idiot! Pervert! Stay far away from me!
Don't think giving me this will change what I think of you~ Hmph. Who knows what you're scheming~
Okay I have to admit I like it and I'll accept it gracefully~
I will seriously drink milk starting today. Senpai have I grown taller?

54010.text: Honey bees may be lovely but hornets are the most beautiful.
Sharp poison needle... Fierce attitude! Ah that's where it's at!
No matter how hard it is my drills will pulverize it... Ah! Leave it to my imagination!
Iron and steel... No matter what drills are made out of it will blunt someday. Where can I find unbreakable material?
Use this drill bit... It can even drill through iron walls!
I'll break you!
You don't look like any strong person. Hopefully you have the confidence to put me in a correct position. And I bet you will! And relax now I'm not a mean person to my friends.
Drill a hole into you!
Give me more! This is not enough!
My power has increased can't wait to try my skills!
I'm not to be controlled by the school rules I study in whatever grade I want~
Huh? Why don't you look scared when seeing me wielding such power?
I need no armor! All I do is to attack and smash! The best defense is a good offense!
With a better suit and a sharper drill no one dares to stand against me now!
Ah? How dare you ask me to do this kind of work?
Hey! I was expecting you to show me more!
Tch they just got lucky.
From now on I will use my strength to protect the ones that I cherish~
You are finally here!
A new room? Hope you have bought insurance for it.
Fell asleep already?… Even someone annoying as you are can have a cute face when asleep…
Okay get to work right now. Make yourself useful.
Hey! Have you even claimed your rewards?
What's the noise all about?
Do you want a hole in your head?
Not bad thanks~
What a wonderful gift! You know me well!
Get out of the way! Having me stab you won't do you any good.

54011.text: Are you cold? Here have my knife it is warm...it's scalding?
What is this? It smells so good...I want some too!
Hunters are family! Not pets!
Talking like humans is hard...
Meow thanks for your help!
I will protect my friends!
H-hello? My name is Mio...
Meow! (Let's go!)
Meow… It tastes nice~ May I have more?
Mio is getting stronger~
School? Can Mio bring the Hunters there?
Mio runs faster! Meow!!!
This is something not made by nature… Mio will try it on~
Mio will let you touch her tail if you give Mio that piece of steel~
It's exciting to start an adventure!
Meow... You're not qualified hunters!
Meouch... That one doesn't count!
C-can you tame me? If you tame me then you will be my most special human in the entire world! ...KongMing taught me this sentence...so will you?
Welcome to the new Hunter's Lair~
This lair is warm~ Meow~
Mio is not the only creature who became sleepy?
Intern? What is that? Mio wants to come with you~
Mio believes the spoil of your battles is still not taken~
It's the enemy! Mio has smelled their stench!
Go away!
Thank you~
Mio likes!
Good~meowing! I mean morning!

54012.text: My weight changes based on which form I am in so don't worry about not being able to carry me when I am in my Crystal form~
The energy of the Crystal is unchangeable. This means that even if I gain weight in my human form my Crystal form will not become any heavier than before...but I'd be glad if I don't.
Even in my Crystal form I'm a regular girl like everyone else and should be treated the same~

Awakening the light in people...creating life...such miracles can only be accomplished when someone wishes for it to happen. That's why I like to call myself "The Protector of Wishes" instead of the "Bringer of Miracles"...
Technically speaking I can go to other worlds but I never tried it before...it takes way too much energy~
Let me try it out~
I can't remember what people used to call me...but it's not that important anyway. You can call me Krystal now~
Power unleashed!
It also works when I interact with the liquid in my crystal form~
I've become lighter!
I study by using my crystal's power it's almost cheating without getting caught! Haha~
I've learned a new magic spell maybe I can try it in the next battle~
I wonder… If I switch to the crystal form when having this on me will it become crystal too?
I feel my power is slightly boosted~
You can solve any problem if you bring a crystal with you or Krystal with you~
So we're not having a worthy enemy today?
I think we should stop before my crystal collapses.
I wish I can be with you forever ...it might seem weird that I pray to myself but all wishes made to the Miracle Crystal will definitely come true!
Senpai do you have any story to tell me today?
Are you planning to give me the key to this room? A little box is already enough for me… Uh I take that back I was just kidding.
Since Senpai's asleep I think I'd better also sleep right now~ Shapeshifting myself into a crystal and lie on Senpai's chest should be a great idea~
It's time to work! Get up!
Here's a little tip from your reliable little Krystal: Remember to claim your reward after completing your missions~
Apparently it's been too noisy recently maybe we should go check it out and solve the problem?
It's okay everyone has something that they are bad at...it's completely normal if you are bad at picking gifts for others!
Hmmm not bad at all!
I love this! You must have listened to my prayers!
Oh it's you again~ What a coincidence~

54013.text: I did not become a Discipline Member for any great purpose. I just want everyone to feel safe that's all.
Some other Discipline Members may be too strict... although that strictness is required at times. But we should not forget that we are students too right?
Ha… how long can a peaceful day like this last? When that time comes… ah it’s nothing sorry I was just talking to myself.
I wonder what Sonya and Guan Yin are up to. If I’m not around those two often start a fight. Maybe it's time to use my privilege as a Discipline Member... ahhahahha I’m just kidding.
Once work ends I should find someone to go with to the Shopping Street. A new store seems to have opened recently… Ah Senpai do you want to come with me?
Guess I’m up next.
Discipline Member Joan at your service. Senpai do you need help? No? It's glad to hear that well then… can I offer you some tea?
Guess I need to take it seriously...
Could be better if you add some peppermint.
Well... that makes work much easier.
Not bad the grades are perfect. Hmm? I could’ve gotten better? Oh this is enough for me already.
This power... I hope there won’t be a day that I have to use it.
The gears aren’t shabby... But I’m sure there is someone that needs it more than I do.
Sorry for troubling you. My current gears would’ve been enough.
I’ll just think of it as a casual stroll.
Phew... this is thanks to you all I didn’t do much.
Don't be discouraged just try again next time.

A peaceful life school friends… and Senpai. There is now one more thing that I need to protect with my life. So what should I say for my pledge? "Although we are not born on the same day month or year I hope that we will die together on the same day month and year?” Hmm? “It’s too deep? Not like something I would say?” Well that’s true I won't let that day come.
Oh it’s Senpai. I’ve just prepared something would you like to eat with me?
Oh perfect for resting.
Senpai are you asleep? Well proper rest and relaxation are necessary too. It is not good to be tense all the time.
Off to intern? I see Senpai’s also making great contributions to the Academy. Well done!
Senpai your task rewards are ready. Want to take the opportunity to eat something nice? I know a good place...
Something’s happening... better go check it out this is my duty.
Luckily you’re giving this to me Senpai. If you were to give it to someone else you might be disliked for it.
Thank you so much I will cherish it.
How…how did you notice Senpai? I don’t think I’ve mentioned what I like before... Guess I’ll have to think of a way to repay you.
Senpai you’re here. The campus is still as peaceful as ever. Would you like to take a stroll with me?

54014.text: Hmm hmm hmm~♪ It's good to have a clean room. Ah Senpai! Don't just stare come and help out!
As all of you have been studying and training hard during the week. The Student Union will support you with our best efforts so that you won't have to worry about other things when you're tired.

What kind of new clothes should I make this time? Just as I thought Michael still suits white very well. As for KongMing... how about taking on a cute style as a challenge? Hehe... can't wait to see them try them on.

All department and guild funds are distributed by me. Most of the guild's expenses are within budget but some of the money is always spent very quickly... What exactly does it get spent on so quickly?
When you're being begged sometimes you accidentally end up giving them higher budget. This is bad I need to watch out in future... What? You want a budget increase again?...Not this time!
Be careful don't get hurt!

Student Union Accountant Vera! I'm the one who manages all of your expenses. Although it can be a little tough at times but for the sake of everyone and a well deserved campus life this is nothing! Wait really your clothes are all wrinkled Senpai! Take it off so I can iron it for you!
Disobedient ones shall be punished!
This is the drink that I prepared for everyone I know its taste very well.
Hehe now I can help everyone do much more.
Work and study should be balanced out. You too Senpai.
Senpai no matter where you go no matter what your goal is... I will always be supporting you. Don't forget that!
Hmm... This clothing can I make it myself too...?
Remember to save remember to be frugal and don't use expensive things.
It is good to go out for a stroll once in a while.
Great job everyone! Let's go back together!
Oh no... my clothes got dirty.

Is this...? Senpai... are you sure you know what this mean? Better not be joking with this! You're serious? What?! Waaaaaaaiiiiiiit...... I need a moment to calm myself...
.....
.....
Ok if that's the case... Of course! But! Don't think that you can leave all the housework to me! Senpai you need to be serious about this too!
Look Senpai! What do you think? A new look right?
Ok let's tidy everyone's rooms!
Senpai you can't fall asleep here! Really now... let me take you back.
Senpai are you going to intern? Now that's the right example for everyone I shall reward you later.
Reward time! Then again... isn't this the compensation I distributed...?
Something seems to have occurred... I hope it hasn't messed up the places I've cleaned.
Senpai... at least throw away your own trash. Oh what? That's for me?
Don't tell me it was bought through the Student Union funds? Just kidding thank you very much.
Senpai knows gratitude... I'm touched~
Senpai! You're finally back! Your room is all tidied do you still need me to help with anything else?

54015.text: Even a branch is full of life…
Listen… The forest is whispering… Everyone is praying for their happiness…
Senpai did you know? I'm always very happy when you come to see me.
Listen… to the sound of the wind passing through the trees.
All things in this world are beautiful things… And beautiful things should be celebrated in poetry.. What do you think?
Everyone! Please bestow me power!
Ah so the world beyond the forest is beautiful too. Senpai I'm so thankful that you showed me this beautiful scenery.
Everyone in the forest are with me.
I… feel your happiness.
Is this from your heart… I can feel it strongly a very warm energy…
Perhaps searching for the way to achieve happiness in the sea of knowledge is a good idea.
You are the one who gave me guidance Senpai. I wish happiness upon you…
Ah… thank you Senpai.
Senpai this is great! Thank you for all the things you have done for me~
As long as you need it… I won't hesitate… as long as you can be happy.
This isn't from my power alone… Thank you everyone!
It's my fault I'm not good enough… I'm really sorry for not meeting your expecatations.
To form an alliance with you… is the best thing I can think of… I think it's wonderful… I would give anything to keep it…
You're here… This room is well-lit and warm. Just like the forest!
This is the first time I've lived alone… Not quite use to it yet…
To rest and recuperate is quite important… Plants also need a good rest in order to better photosynthesis it's really great here!
Intern? Is it a job that can bring people happiness?
What is… this? If you don't mind I'd like to give it to you Senpai.
Do you need my explanation… If you need it… I am ready...
This… is also from you. Thank you I'll be taking it then… But if you can you don't have to give me anymore gifts.
Thank you.
This is too precious… in return… I hope to always accompany you and to witness and guard your happiness.
Senpai I'm really happy to see you again.

55002.text: Don't bother me ever again. I want to be alone.
Yes I can see through your heart... Your destiny. How about that feeling of being seen through... It's terrible isn't it?
The man who burns with fire will not give up no matter how long it takes. After all that too. Seriously... How annoying...
Got everything I wish... So what now? So what else can I get?
If I can I want to go somewhere that no one can find me... But that person will surely find me.
Get out of my world.
If my prophecies are correct I will always be with you. Let's accept our relationship Master.
Everyone... Disappear!
Exp Juice? Just leave it over there…
I can learn more information from my crystal ball now.
Fate is unstoppable and I only need to wait until mine comes upon.
I've become stronger. Can't wait to show off in front of that fire mage… Who's that again?
Just don't take my crystal ball away~
I'm just forewarning you. I ain't going anywhere no matter what you equip on me.
You won't do any help... I mean  I don't need your help.
This is a part of my fate so I don't think that's something worth being happy about.
Losing is also a part of my fate.
Our future is already decided by fate and you can't escape from it now...we are meant to be together~
Why are you here again?
Now get out of my room.
… Are you hesitating to say anything?
Time to work and leave me alone.
Don't let me remind you to claim your rewards again.
Something's happening time to make yourself useful.
Why are you making my life harder than it already is? ...Whatever I guess this is fate working its magic too...
Is this for me? Thank you~ I don't have anything to return the favor though. Would you like me to tell your fortune?
Is that for me? Thank you~ You are really destined with me.
My crystal ball says that I shouldn't meet anyone today but if it's you...I don't mind~

55003.text: Don't look back. I'm behind you...
Get out... From this house. Get out... Don't look at me...
Don't look... At me... I want to be alone.
Don't be gentle with me. I can't pay back in return...
The relaxed people are too shiny and dazzling... I can't be friends with that kind of person...
Go out... Of here...
Master... Please don't look at me all the time... I can't stand it... Warmth... What is this light...
Curse you!
Thank you~
I've become stronger?
Maybe I shall move out from the old dorm building and take some lessons?
Quit staring at me! That's embarrassing…
I don't care about dressing…
Maybe there will be no one else who's able to see me… But I'll try it on~
I shall find some more victims~♪~♪~♪
I won? That's really amazing!
Sorry I embarrassed you… I'll disappear right away…
I can finally call you mine…I'm not letting go of you again!
Senpai! Don't try to lie to me! Your act has shown that you're afraid!
It's not the first time for me to be in this room~ Walls mean nothing to me~
Wryyyyyyyy!!!… That's disappointing… You are supposed to be shocked by that one…
Maybe my ghosts can aid you during the internship?
Can I take your rewards?
School news? Do I look like someone who would be interested in that?
Ah... What a shiny gift. It's not for me...
Thanks for your kindness... But I want to be alone in silence...
Am I truly worth it? I understand... I'll try it. Thank you~
Ah! Look what I found Master~

55004.text: Fear~ That scared look of yours... I like it~
The night... This is when I feel at home. Ha~ There is a strong evil fragrance!
Protect that body of yours carefully~ I can kill you whenever I want~
The dark nights will devour everything. Yes bad things and things that people don't want to see will all be covered up in darkness~
I'm not a soul reaper. I just love to harvest souls. Being happy is the most important~
Oh your soul I accept~
Another "wicked man"? Welcome~ Oh. Let's go into the night and see what we can't see in the daytime~
Give me your life!
Don't mind if I drink!
I need more souls from lunch boxes. I can return the empty containers if you want...
New semester~ Sounds like my chance to reap from the juniors~
Another soul collected! Soon I will be able to complete my collection!
That's fine. As long as I can reap others' souls easy as usual~
Never thought you're able to get this for me… Maybe there're some other things you can do for me.
Is this the place I need to go and reap the souls today?
Bumper harvest!
Not a single grain was reaped…
Your soul belongs to me now! Don't worry I won't harvest your soul with the Scythe~
Seems you've made your decision Senpai. Don't worry it will end just in a blink of an eye~
Nice room~
Senpai~ I'll take your soul if you don't wake up now~
Time to go to work! Or have you already decided to join me?
Your rewards are blocking my way!
Accidents? Sounds like a perfect chance to reap souls!
You want to get reaped?
Bold of you to send a present to death herself~
This one is more special than the last one~ I want to show you the charm in darkness are you with me?
I'll spare your soul today...but what will you give me in return Senpai~?

55005.text: No matter how dark I become I am not afraid as long as I discover the truth.
Justice? That's funny. Justice is just an excuse for the strong to be disobedient isn't it?
I'd rather rule in hell than serve in heaven.
There may be light but there is also darkness. It's just a mask on your face. And I am what wouldn't dare admit. The darkness in your hearts.
Wonderful fantasies and cruel realities. Which side would you choose?
Justice you say? Beat me before you start spitting such nonsense!
Come with me. Accept the darkness within you. Get rid of people who see you as food. What's the significance of being polite in peace? Right?
Disappear!
Hand over your Exp Juice!
Now I'm more powerful!
No matter which class I am in nobody has anything left to teach me!
Now you've known what I can do!
Give me everything you own!
It's really amazing that you can offer me such good stuff!
Follow me!
Tremble in darkness!
Damn I should've paid more attention to that…
Don't joke around like that.... Are you serious? For situations such as this people need some time to mentally prepare themselves. Okay? .... Hey I promise you I do!
zzz~ Michael~
You'd better find me Michael~
Seriously? I've not done anything yet… Since you won't wake up anytime soon I'll go and visit Michael…
Hey! Human! Go to work!
I won't need a lackey who's not even capable to retrieve his own rewards!
No matter what's happening it's not my business. You can go on your own though~
I see you still have that piece of junk! Go to hell!
You proved your loyalty I hope you will keep fighting for me.
Nothing suits me more. I must admit that you're sincere.
Come to welcome your master and accept the embrace of darkness!
