55007.text: I'm looking for a girl named "Turin" do you know her?
Unreasonable rules in this unreasonable world need to be rewritten...no they must be rewritten.
Would you like to join me? We will shape the world with our own hands!
Li is just a ruthless machine it will do anything to maintain order… We were abandoned once a hundred years ago… You know what I mean
I would like to be more gentle if possible... But as you see I don't have any other choice now!
Move out of my way!
I am the most powerful Valkyrie...You can call me Kratos or "Enigma".
You're in my way. Die!
Become stronger~ Step by step! Until no one can ever defeat you!
Tell me why do I fight?
Normal life… That's something I wouldn't even dare to dream of in the past…
Not everyone can afford the price of power
No matter what you can provide as long as it's something I can use I want it all!
With this I can move one step closer to the world I dreamed of.
Let's go and wipe out the obstacle.
Don't try you don't even stand a chance against me.
Let's get away this is not the best time for me to unleash my strength
Now that you have chosen me I will take responsibility and fulfill your wishes for you.
Time to breathe some fresh air~
This room is too small for me. It's not a must for me to live inside of it right?
Amateur… You should never let your guard down in front of someone who was once your enemy in the past…
Hey! Get back to work at once!
Have you collected your rewards?
You can find opportunities in every incident we've got no time to waste sitting here~
Take it and leave. I don't want to see it again.
It will take more than that to make me satisfied.
Not bad.
Make yourself useful don't let me see you wandering for no reason again.

55008.text: Have you seen my lover? Has she been here before? No...? I'll look elsewhere then...
Don't look... it's ugly anyone that looks is disgusted by it...
Izanagi... Where are you hiding... I will cure myself please come back...
Although it was foreseen that this day would come sooner or later but when it really came the pain was a matter of life or death.
It's Chaos' fault that made me look like this! It's Li's fault too! Why didn't he destroy the Chaos and left them hidden within the grounds!
Go away! Go away all of you!
I'm sorry to appear in such a state... I'm Izanami.
I'm sorry!
This is enough~
This power only brings me pain...
Like this I can reminisce the old days~
The darkness let's you see more~
Perhaps in the future she will also use these gears~
Can this gear help me hide my ugliness?
I would do anything to get her back~
You asked for it.
... Stop forcing me!
It's not easy to come across someone who loves me sincerely... Thank you for giving me this opportunity I will cherish it~
You're here have a cup of tea and sit for a while.
What a cute room I'm feeling better now~
Does my chaos aura make you feel uncomfortable? ...... I'm sorry but I can't get rid of it entirely.
Isn't time to go intern?
Go collect your rewards for your task completion today.
I sense an uncertain aura~ Better go check it out.
Thanks... but it's fine.
Thank you... not many people are kind to me...
Thank you... Can I can I give you a hug?
Hi...

55009.text: Lies mixed with the truth are the most difficult to detect. However even if it is all true it can still constitute a lie right?
People only believe what they want to believe and I'm just responding to that by giving them an excuse to escape reality.
Wanna hear me sing? Sure! Just don't get too immersed that you can't pull yourself out.
Oh where have you been? Gone looking for Michael again?! Damn it why do you care so much about a naive girl...
This child of mine is called Volos. When I was locked up underground she was my only companion and my best friend. Right Volos?
It's been awhile let's begin the show♪
I'm Apate an angel from heaven~ No? I don't look the part? Don't you know there's different types of angels... A demon of deception? What? So you already know.
Dance along to my song♪
How thoughtful. Just as I needed to hydrate for vocal relief.
The magic within my song is even more powerful now...
Study? Is there such a need?
Hahaha from the current state perhaps the whole school will be entranced by my voice. Shall I test it out next time? I'm just joking I wouldn't do such a thing... Well you never know.
This won't affect my singing will it?
Will Lucifer like this...?
Who can I go play with?
How does it feel to be played?
Damn it I won't forget this!
I am the demon of deception you must be brave to swear an oath to me... They're the most easy to deceive... Oh you still want to continue? Alright then...
Oh Lucifer Lucifer have you come to see me? Oh it's just you Senpai.
Left me alone again... Whatever then.
Hmmm hmm hmmm♪
Intern? Nope not keen thanks.
Can't find your task rewards? Well I don't know maybe someone took it? Go look for it. Hahaha
So rowdy... Have my fans come to look for me?
Seems like Senpai's quite easy to fool.
You want to please me with this? You better work harder.
You've... done alright this time around.
Senpai you're finally here~ Oh I've been such an angel... hahaha.

55010.text: *Humming* What song is this? Why do you ask? Are you charmed by my beautiful voice too?
Why are you looking at me like that? Is there anything on my face?
What do you think you're doing? We're just temporary partners not friends no need to get all touchy-feely.
Do you want to hear about my great plan? Have you finally acknowledged my pranking talents?
I'm Lucifer's trusted sidekick! Not just one of the mob in the background!
This would be a nice workout for me~
Good day! I am Frexie the cleverest person you will ever meet…What? You never heard about me? But I'm a follower of the famous Lucifer!
Don't you think I'm awesome?
I am definitely better than Dracula now!
Oooh I didn't know that! I should try this trick on Estel and Apate!
People say that it's never too old to learn…but I'm too smart for studying right?
I can feel my strength growing…!
What's this? Is this edible?
Hmm so this is something to make me stronger…too bad it's not edible.
I always give my all when it comes to fights.
Hurray! I won! Did you see that?
*Sniffs* Stop trying to comfort me I didn't lose back there! This is merely a strategic retreat!

Senpai you must be so grateful that you're falling to your knees and sobbing uncontrollably right now for sharing an Oath with me. But don't worry I'm feeling more or less the same as you do so that makes the two of us!
Senpai you're just in time for my new plan! It involves various different experiences in life…hey why are you escaping?
Well it's an average room. You should be glad that I don't have impossible standards for my living quarters.
What a peaceful day and my mind is at peace as well. It's the perfect time for thinking up a new prank!
Internships? Are they even more interesting than pulling pranks? Wait there are internships for pranking others? I would love to try that!
Wooh the paycheck is a lot bigger than I expected. I guess there are some merits to the boring internships after all.
Unlike pranks enemies should be taken seriously.
Ugh what is this thing…I think Estel would like this. Why don't you gift this to her instead?
Thanks.
Wow Senpai you know me so well! I love this!!
Here Senpai this is for you…Oops it exploded way too early. Are you taken by surprise?

56001.text: Purify the demons... Don't let any escape!
Light? Dark? What does that have to do with me? I just want to... Purify those demons...
This weapon can cleansing powers. My mission is to purify all the creatures of filth and dirt.
The world doesn't need demons. All things sinister... Should never exist.
If those demons are gone then my life wouldn't have any meaning. Actually I don't like fresh air that much anyway.
It smells like... Demons.
Your body has a scent that it has been purified... The demons near you are cleansed. Please relax~
Purge and Purify!
The angel's power is growing!
Thanks for your gift. But accepting this doesn't mean I agree on your ideal.
I won't let those demons run away next time!
Do you think my opinion was wrong?
I will use this weapon to purge all demons!
I will never forget my goal!
It's time to hunt the demons~
Victory? Isn't that something normal?
Sorry I cannot defeat the enemy…
From now on I will be the sunshine and disperse all the darkness only for you!
Senpai how's life treating you?
This restroom is perfect for me ~
You look very tired I think it's time for me to leave and let you have a good rest.
Hurry to your workplace before you are late!
You've worked hard for your reward. Hope someday they could also pay me for purging all those demons.
I smell demon in this accident let's go and check it out!
Evil… Must purge…
A present? Is this for me?
Well... Thanks for your gift. I like it very much~
Today we must cleanse the demons Senpai. Let's go!

56002.text: Excuse me have you seen an angel named Selene? She's my friend and I'm looking for her.
The sound of my harp is wonderful. Isn't it?
I came from Heaven and live peacefully in this world.
Shh~ Quiet God is taking a nap.
Please lead the stray sheep to the Kingdom of Heaven.
Blessing from God.
Since my friend is alone God sent me to see her. She's a golden-haired angel. Have you seen her?
Listen to the voice of an angel!
I‘m just playing my harp.
It's a new song do you like it?
I will try my best in my study club activities and harp practice~
I hope my music can soothe you.
Is this for harp maintenance?
My harp is not only used to play music~
If you need some information you can count on me~
Now listen to this tweedle of victory~
Uh… My harp is broken…
Senpai I'm in the middle of practicing I'll get back to you after I finish...wait is that a ring? For me?
It's important to have an afternoon-break~
Good night~
It's impolite to fall asleep when I'm playing the harp for you!
Don't worry and go complete your internship Senpai. I can wait until you return~
Are you missing something? Such as your rewards?
I will uncover the truth hidden behind this incident come with me~
Who are you? Are we that close?
Are you here to listen to my harp? Then I will play something special for you~
Shh~ be careful with that! There are so many people down there~
Good morning Senpai. Have you seen Selene?

56003.text: Putting things down without any justification is nothing more than just violence.
My sword will bring peace and light to the world.
It is inevitable that those who fall will fall willingly. But I can't stand having a friend fall.
Doesn't matter what others say. I will save her.
I am the sword of justice. Protect the light!
Purge you with God's will!
Gentleness won't overcome evil! Goodness must be stronger than evil. I'm the angel who judges evil and fights against it.
Eliminate evil!
Behold the light~
The light will guide your path.
As the student representative I welcome you all!
Nothing is more important than saving lives!
Normal weapons cannot take my power.
Please take care of yourself out there.
Just give me your orders Senpai! It's my duty to protect the Academy!
This isn't the best time to celebrate carry the wounded to my sickbay.
This failure doesn't mean anything justice will prevail in the future!
I used to only think about justice and light. You've made me understand that there are even more things in this world~ From now on I'll work harder!
Why do you look so happy Senpai? Anything good happened?
It's bedtime Senpai~
I should've known that you won't wake up this early! Buying breakfast for you is really a bad idea!
The manager said that you'll be fired if you are still late for work today~
I can collect the reward for Senpai every day if you decide to join House Angel how about that?
The Chaos is spreading on campus. Let's go and check it out!
Doubting the sharpness of my blade? Want to see for yourself?
Thanks for your gift I'll keep the darkness from corrupting you as usual.
The present is so pretty I almost felt my God through this. Thank you very much.
Wishing you a good day in God's name Senpai.

56004.text: I wake up from the flames! Don't underestimate the power of the immortal bird.
You can't escape from setbacks. The first step in this new life is to transcend the flaming trials.
My flame exists to help others!
I have been reincarnated countless times so far. But no matter which time I failed to achieve what I expected.
Some things can't be burned even with flames. All I can do about this is warm it a little bit.
Burn everything.
Flames are the proof of my ancestry of this immortal birds. Master please brand my existence in your eyes.
Burn.
My flame will spread wider.
Don't worry I am able to properly control my power.
Where's the new classroom? Crap guess I just got lost again…
Every day is a fresh start for me. Which means… I will also need to figure out the path to the classroom as well QAQ.
I don't like those luxury clothes the clothes I'm wearing is already enough for me.
I think I might need a new pair of gloves I lost mine by mistake…
New enemies appeared? I won't let my friends get hurt again this time!
Sorry for hitting you too hard I'll try to go easier on you next time.
Get to safety! I'll cover you!
Every rebirth leads me back to you we must be destined for each other!
It's just like a miracle for you to reach here easily every time! What's your secret?
I wish to exchange all my knowledge and skills for a clear memory of the path to my dorm.
Oh… Sorry Senpai I wasn't listening… How long I've been got lost? It's even long enough for Senpai to take a nap?!
I‘m willing to go and complete the internship with you but the flame on my wings will cause you a lot of trouble so…
Have you claimed the rewards for today's work Senpai?
Get behind me. I got this.
Senpai if you have anything to say about me just say it!
Gift? Looking at how enthusiastic you are I will accept it.
I will save this gift well. I won’t burn things like I used to.
We meet again. How many times have we met?

56005.text: The Chaos Legion is causing more trouble than before. All thanks to them I'm getting a lot busier nowadays...Although there is no definite cure for Chaos Figure but I'll try my best~
It's okay many of the girls have healing abilities which makes my life a lot easier~I'm more worried about you. No matter what don't overwork yourself.
Turn your frown upside down no matter what... Everything's gonna be okay~

Did you know when the angels were kids Gabriel was so shy she would play her harp instead of talking to classmates and Michael would play videogames with Lucifer all night long. And now they've all grown up...
Bye~Take care don't come back all beaten up okay?
Alright let's go~
I am Raphael the school doctor of Yume Academy. Before you ask yes we have met before but most of those times you've lost consciousness when you arrived at my doorstep~
It will stop hurting soon I promise~
May I suggest to optimize the makeup of this Exp Juice?
Wow! My halo just grew bigger~
You can always find me waiting for new patients here~
Yes my legend will last forever!… Wait the "forever" sounds really old… Let me make up another sentence!!!
Maybe you can bring me a doctor's coat next time? A doctor never wears a doctor's coat just sounds too weird~
My potion is not leaving me!
Where are you taking me to?
You should try harder next time~
Ouch… You should be more gentle when treating a lady.
Wow I've never been proposed to before so this might need some time to get used to...But you will be there to accompany me through everything won't you?
I like the room you've prepared for me~
A new infirmary?
Have a good rest~ Since there's no pillow around here guess you'd have to sleep on my lap hope that's not too hard for you~
Don't forget to work~
Don't forget your reward~
Something's calling you? Please watch your back out there! I don't want to see you get hurt~
Hmm...I don't think I'll need this...
You took a lot of effort to find this for me didn't you? Thank you~
Ooooh thank you! I love this! A good child deserves some better treatment~
Come in~ There's no reservation for me today are you here for a life counseling?
Please don't be afraid to take pills from a person who is sure to become a famous doctor--- besides I've followed every step in the book to make this so nothing can go wrong.
What’s this mess about? Of course it’s… I’m creating a new medicine~ But I think it has failed. I better clear this up. Shhh… you didn’t see this!
Why do they say my expression looks scary at times? Maybe I should smile more?
Take this injection if you feel down? Don’t worry I’ve practiced for a long time I won’t inject it in the wrong place.
Please drink this cup of tea when you feel tired ♪. Don't worry I didn't add anything harmful♪.
Those who speak ill of me won't end well. Don't look at me like that or I will show you what I'm going to do to these people--- In a gentle way of course.

56007.text: Assist with training? Of course! But it'll be of a knight's standard okay?
I will obey any order. Since I have pledged to fight with you I will put my trust in you...... just like the people who believed in me.
What's the point of a shield that can't protect its ally? Where does a knight who's failed seek salvation? Without being a knight... what is left of me?

Holy knight angel…. Although I have been crowned with these names but I am not the kind of existence worthy of admiration… If that were true how great would it be then things about be a lot different?
The sunset is beautiful but it’s really hard to enjoy it for it is the last light before the sun sets leaving only endless darkness. How long do I have to wait… to see another dawn?
I will ensure your safety return... I promise.
Knight Commander of the Sun Uriel. From now on my shield will not only fight for my people and my comrades but also for the school and for you. This time I will not let anyone down......
Repent before the light of the sun.
Even with this drink I can't slack during training. How about we train together later?
Now I protect more people...
Graduate? Oh I'll just remain as a knight commander...oh what's that? Oh that's not what you meant?
If I had such power at the time… No no point in regretting it. The past cannot be changed. What I can do now is use this power to save more people… You’re with me right? Senpai?
Splendid gear. Let's share it with others.
For me? Thanks. I won't let you down.
As you wish.
Great... My efforts came of value.
Leave it to me you guys go first. I've told you I'd ensure your safety return.

I have made a knight's vow to you but why...? Not that kind of vow? Could...could it be...?! But... I still have the duty of a knight and I don't know how to respond to you. It's okay? Ha...there's no other way. Well... if it's only us two perhaps it's okay to let go of my knightly status for a while. I am in your care from now on my... sunshine.
What should I write today... Hm Senpai? When did you get here?
This place... makes you feel at ease.
Asleep? What a defenseless expression... But don't worry I will protect you.
Intern? Will it be dangerous? Let me escort you.
Your rewards are ready. Collect it as you deserve it.
Something's happening... Senpai stay close to me.
Uh... well since it's you that's given it... thanks.
For me? Thank you very much. Uhh... what should I give in return...
How... how do I repay you... All I have to do is smile? Like... like this?
Senpai welcome back. I've been waiting for you.

56008.text: Hands off. No one said you could touch me.
What is it?
Stop disturbing me I'm busy. What am I doing? I'm concentrating on staying concentrated! No I'm not joking.
The heat of the sun evaporates everything and staring into the sun burns away your eyesight. But the gentle light of the moon does nothing of these…I like the moon better…
I miss the gentle glow of the moon…
I shall shoot down the sun!
My name is Angelica. Would you mind telling me which class is Luna in or bring me to her?
My arrows shall bring me honor!
Your efforts will never betray you.
I have a better grasp of my archery skills now.
Knowledge is important for warriors too not just for scholars. Senpai why don't you join me in this training of the mind?
I understand now. I shall follow my heart's lead so shall the arrows I let fly.
Hmm this isn't restricting at all. Not bad.
Hmm? Pulling the bowstring seems easier with this on. Not to mention this seems to contain more arrows…Thank you.
I swear to my bow that I will bring you victory.
Faith can move mountains.
This is caused by my oversight. This shall not happen again.
I was betrayed once and believed that I will not be able to trust again. Thank you for showing me otherwise.
Oh it's you. If possible do remember to bring Luna with you next time.
Hmm this is a spacious room. Let's see…there should be a target here for archery practice…
I wonder…what is Luna up to right now?
Helping others is not a bad thing. Even something small could brighten up someone's day.
I don't need any of these. What I really want…is to meet Luna again.
A new challenge? I am always prepared for it.
I appreciate your sincerity but please refrain from giving this again.
Thank you though I have no idea why did you give this to me.
…Oh my I didn't see this coming. In this case I should pay you back by helping you with archery training next time.
Good day Senpai. Have you finished your training regimen today?

54016.text: A professional assassin should never be burdened by anything. That's why I'm way better than Blair.
Get out of my way.
Don't touch me or bear the consequences thereafter!
Do you have a new task for me?
Hya!!! Sorry… that was a natural reflex.
This won't be necessary but... Whatever.
It's me Kassy the guardian of the forest.
This cyan blur will be the last thing you see.
My claws are getting sharper.
My body has become more flexible.
Is this really necessary for me? Okay... you're the boss.
Even the sharpest edge needs to be wielded in the fastest speed.
Hmmmm not bad.
Hopefully this won't hinder my moves.
Objective complete ready for my next task.
Failed to complete the mission swiftly as planned I need to rethink my strategy.
Take your hand? I thought that was only for kids in kindergarten.
Which is more important to you? A peaceful life or your duty?
Just sit here with me and enjoy the scene.
Maybe I can try to let my guard down around you.
Oath? Like a long-term contract? I can take that. Maybe you can watch over the forest with me later.
What's the deal?
It's a lot noisier than the forest. But... I believe this is the best you can do.
Prepare for a journey.
Intern? Does that include killing on the job?
Get paid to get things done. This is a natural win-win form of cooperation.
New target acquired.
I strongly suggest you give this piece of beauty to Blair.
Accepted.
You've got good taste.
Good morning who's the kill target for today?
My blades are ready.

52017.text: Senpai if you keep on touching my hat like that the runes drawn on it might stop working...Actually they won't but please stop!
Senpai please don't disturb me when I'm trying to focus on my research.
Senpai are you interested in this pocket watch...?
Hmm...the craftsmanship of this watch is not bad at all. Do you happen to know something or two about the aesthetics of watch hands?
Shush I'm trying to concentrate on fixing this broken clock now. I'll get back to you later.
Lost wanderers of time I command you to return to your rightful place!
I am Monica the Spawn of Time. However I am still caught in the flow of time unable to escape...
I shall reverse the flow of time!
Can you hear the clock ticking? I feel like my powers to control time have grown.
I feel myself becoming one with the flow of time...it's peaceful...
Studying? Is it necessary for a being that lives in the crevices of time like me?
I can feel the joy of growing a joy that can only be felt as time flows freely...
Fine I'll equip it. Though I still think this is nothing but a hindrance for me.
Alright I admit that it's lighter than it looks. If only this looks prettier...a pocket watch perhaps?
I'm sorry but the flow of time urges me forward. I can't stay and wait for you.
I was careless.
Senpai do remember to take good care of the clocks and watches around you okay?
What is the difference between a clock and an hourglass? I find both of them to my tastes.
Oh this watch fits you well.
Senpai you've overslept for way too many times recently. You need to pay more attention to the time.

An Oath that lasts forever you say? Senpai do you know the significance of "forever"? It means unlimited time. Do you have unlimited time? Can you swear in the name of the God of Time that the Oath between us...will last forever?
Senpai? I wasn't expecting you at this time.
I like this room. How about hanging a clock on the wall? I'm sure it would be a great improvement.
The emotions of humankind have always been more intriguing than the flow of time to me. They are eternally complex and the complexity doesn't change no matter how much time has passed.
Senpai it's time for your Intern now. Why do I feel like I've became your personal alarm clock?
Thank you.
Trust me. I'll get the job done in time.
Senpai please tell me that you're not trying to get on my nerves intentionally. You have one last chance to change your mind.
There aren't any pocket watches in the Stores? What a pity.
Woah I love it. Thank you...
Senpai? It's Senpai right? I think I just saw you in the Dorms...oh I almost forgotten that was 10 years ago for this timeline.
The enemies have appeared. Stay vigilant.

51016.text: The starlit sky is breathtaking isn't it?
I alway felt like there's another me in the world...do you feel the same?
I wonder...where are my family?
You look tired. I heard that sugar helps with exhaustion do you want some sweets?
You look down. Here I have a trick to cheer you up.
Chaotic Moon...please grant me power!
I am Diana. Is this Yume Academy? It looks different than other places I've been to...
Sit back and enjoy the show in the moonlight.
The little ones have grown in numbers...I'm glad.
What is this feeling...? I can feel power growing within me...I seem to have retrieved some of my memories.
I see. It's nice to learn something new!
I just remembered...I see...that's what happened back then.
It shall decorate me...along with the moonlight.
This fits them well...
They're adorable aren't they? Come here~
I lost...don't worry it's not your fault. You fought well.

Senpai the stars shine bright tonight. Would you like to stargaze with me? If only my family were here to see them too...
Senpai I'm glad you chose me. I swear to the beautiful nightsky tonight that I will protect you forever.
Senpai the room looks a bit messy. Can you look for Vera for me? I'm going to clean it up with her.
Thank you this is a nice room. They can rest peacefully here.
I'm feeling sleepy so I shall be retiring to my bed earlier today. Senpai take care and don't stay up too late okay?
Intern? I'm very skilled at making children happy~
Rewards eh? I would love to receive a new sewing kit next time. The one I have now is old and worn with use...
Looks like trouble has arisen. Senpai I'm going to need some help here.
Uh this...thing...alright then.
Thank you Senpai.
You're gifting this...to me? Really? Thank you I'm ever grateful to you. What would you like in return?
Here you are Senpai. Your uniform is wrinkled. Do you need help with ironing it?
The moon and the stars will watch over me.

Shoo this gadget I'm working on is top-secret. No peeking!

I'm having a dilemma right now. You have helped me create so much happy memories but you refuse on accepting my help...Wait are you finally willing to use my inventions? Don't worry I'll take responsibility if you got hurt when using them!
Bonnie just asked me whether I should make you my second Research Assistant. What do you think? Hm? You've accepted? Very well!

Hmm let me see if there is anything I can use for my research here...
Senpai let Bonnie handle this okay?

Are these for me? Plants that originate from the Northern Lands...They remind me of home.
We shall meet again later. For now...the ice and snow will bless my travels.
I am Aurora Queen of the Ice Elves and the Northern Lands.
The snowstorms shall bring me victory!
Warriors from the North are not afraid of the cold.
I have to become stronger to fully carry out my responsibilities.

The efforts I made haven't failed me and my power has grown indeed. The snowflakes have celebrated me as well.
I will treasure this.
Thank you.
Is that all?
I have overestimated my powers it seems.
Students in the Academy are rather different from the people I've met before. They are more...passionate I'd say.
Are there any traditions that you observe here? None? Then what about rules or laws?

Look Senpai this is a plant native to the Northern Lands. I'm glad to see it flourishing in the Academy too. Here this is for you.

I will never forget this day Senpai. It is truly unfortunate that you are not able to return to my homeland with me. In the Northern Lands we will form our Oath in the falling snow. They will also witness my promises to stay by your side forever...

This is understandably inferior to the Palace in the Northern Lands but it's acceptable.
I find myself missing the endless snowfall of the North...
Internships...? This is new I never received such requests before.

It's time for a workout.
This is...My apologies but I will not accept this.
Thank you.

Good day Senpai.

53017.text: U-Um m-may you please not...? T-This is so embarrassing...
Erina likes gentle touches like this...

...Have you ever been overwhelmed by fear and desperation? I always thought that a person will show their true colors when they are afraid...

Erina activate protocol!
Erina: "Activating..."
Woah I'm stronger now. I can help you more...
I have better control over my Mecha now. Ready aim...fire!
I want to grow with Erina and experience more things in life with her...
I think I learned something...
This suits Erina well!
Maintenance for Erina must be done every day...
Erina and I will be leaving soon Senpai. See you later...
...Did you see it Senpai? I did it! I won!

Erina: "System down. Rebooting..."
Erina... (Sniffles) I knew I would fail...

Sometimes...I feel like I am a failure...do you think so too Erina?
Erina: "Analyzing...Result: Robbie is the best person in the world."
Erina always comforts me...even if I'm not worth her time. Thank you Erina thank you...
Senpai you look tired. You need to rest...
Senpai Erina misses you because you didn't visit us for a while...yes Erina said that not me. I'm just passing on the message...
Oath...? With me...? If this is what Senpai wants...I won't refuse. I want to stay by Senpai's side for as long as I am allowed for. Oh and Erina too. We will never leave Senpai...

Good afternoon Senpai. I feel sleepy...I'll take a short nap...
Internships...I feel very nervous. I'm worried that I won't be able to help at all...

L-let's go Erina. I believe that I can pull through...!
Uh...um...but...it's the thought that counts I think...

Trust me the only way for you to feel real emotions is to enjoy life like it's a game.
I'm all dressed up today and you ask me to stay in? It will be all your fault if I die of boredom!
Come on Senpai! What are you waiting for?

55012.text: Your hands are cold. Perhaps you have been staying too close to me...
You need not waste your pity on me for my punishment was well-deserved. I have no regrets: if I could choose again I would still answer the prayers of that person...
You would like to learn my thoughts on the state of humans in the current age? Hmm... You have grown well without me.
I shall protect you.
My name is Promethea... Is there anyone in this world that still recognizes this name?
Be on your guard... This power is beyond my control.
Is this the most popular drink in the Academy?
External help does help me harness this reversed magic.
The battlefield is cleared now. Is anyone hurt?
You shall not... bring them harm...
Do you find my powers frightening? If it makes you feel better you can stay away from me; I would not mind.
Don't you fear me? My appearance is typical of Dark creatures... You find it "cool"?
Ah you caught me. I am training myself to keep my powers from seeping out. I hope I can make you more at ease when you're around.
I often find myself hoping that we met before my punishment. However I am also gladdened by your acceptance of my current state.
You knew perfectly well that I would not refuse any request of yours... If I have to say it then yes I accept.
When I close my eyes I feel as if I never left the neverending darkness of the cave... Would you mind leaving a light on for me?
A new enemy has appeared. Worry not; I shall not allow any harm to befall you.
... Ah my apologies. I seem to be distracted.
I appreciate the thought put into this gift. I shall put it to good use.
How could I ever repay you for such a valuable gift?
We meet again. Would you like to spend some time with me?
My control over this reversed power grows...
This is a small but comfortable room. In my exile I was unable to lay down and rest...
Your alarm clock is ringing. If you have matters to settle feel free to do so; I will be here when you return.

53019.text: Is there anything on your mind? Have a seat and tell me all about it. Trust me I know how you feel.
If you need to vent I am always ready to listen.
Got you. It would be unwise to try to sneak up on me as your emotions will give you away.
Yet another battle... Hang in there I shall end this soon.
I am Nymphaea the First Seal and your sister. It's a pleasure to meet you.
Don't worry my hands are steady so it shouldn't hurt too much.
There's still space for improvement in the recipe of this drink.
"The manual for this piece of Gear is successfully installed."
Nothing stands between me and my goal.
Is this a repeat of the tragedy from a century ago? I have failed to save everyone again...
Worry not if you find it impossible to comprehend my actions. One day you will finally understand that everything I did was for your sake.
You are the Observer and I am the Seal. The bond we share is one of the closest in the world.
You're saying that you want to know what I'm thinking? This is new; usually I'm the one sensing the emotions of others.
I knew you would finally come around. Come with me; together we shall create a world with no war nor despair.
The word "Oath" is not enough to define the relationship we share but I understand that it signifies your enthusiasm for being with me.
I can finally relax when there's no one to influence my emotions.
Yet another battle to be fought... How much more do the people have to suffer?
If you want to see me caught off guard all you need to do was ask. I could've simulated it for you without all this hassle...
I don't have a preference if it's from you.
Is this warm feeling in my heart when I received this gift... "joy"?
You had me worried back there when you froze abruptly. Were your systems down? Or were you summoned by "Li"?
"Database upgraded successfully." ... I have to catch up with so much new knowledge that appeared in my slumber or risk becoming an outdated AI.
My Dorm room is the one next to Turin's room. If only you could live together with us...
Let's see... Don't you have something awaiting completion?

757002.text: Is she Auntie Valeera? Wasn't she supposed to be Auntie Pasha's Captain? Why does she look my age?
Powers of my Sign? I don't remember how I got them... I think I was painting for a long time when it happened...
Don't touch that painting! The paint's still wet!
Combat? How do I do that?
Wow this is the Yume Academy! Here I come~
I'll doodle all over your face!
I am super energized after drinking this!
This coat is too thick... I can't breathe when wearing it...
He-he! You can praise me to your heart's desire I won't be embarrassed!
Ow ow ow... Senpai it hurts...
Wha-Oh it's Senpai! When I'm painting I might not notice you calling me if your voice is too low.
Hmm a stroke over here should do nicely... Hey Senpai stop fidgeting! Models are supposed to stay still when the painter is working!
What do you think about this one? Personally I think this painting is an honest representation of your handsomeness Senpai!
I should be focused when I'm painting but I keep thinking about Senpai...
An Oath? Oh I know! It means that you will always stay by my side like how Papa always stays with Mama right?
What should I do in my spare time? Hmm... I can't think of anything except for painting!
Harrumph! The baddies who keep on bothering me when I paint are back again! Please drive them away for me Senpai!
Erm about this... I'm sorry! I really want to like this but I can't.
Is this for me? Thank you!
This is perfect as paint! I will paint something beautiful with it and you will be the first one to see it!
Senpai look! I finished my latest painting!
This feeling... Inspiration has struck! I need to capture them on paper! Now!
Lemme see: paint canvas easel... Yes I think that's everything! Thank you Senpai!
Oh no not another mission... Heading out is so tiring can I stay home and paint?

51019.text: Stop praising my body. I do not understand your standards for "a great body".
I don't like dreaming or fantasizing. We are no longer children after all.
If we have no control over our own emotions then what difference do we have with animals?
How can we take control of the situation if we have not set up proper procedures and protocol?
Being in control is of utmost importance. Losing control is unimaginable no matter in a professional or a private environment.
Do not try to put your ideas into my head.
This reminds me of the fresh air on the top of mountains...
These gear are very effective and the results have proven the same. No more needs to be said.
Victories are important but do not be carried away by them.
Crying isn't going to solve anything.
This is not the first time I've been described as "emotionless" and I see no reason why I should explain myself.
The past? I do get nostalgic from time to time. I used to live at the top of mountains among the clouds...
I detest losing control over my emotions but I can't stop my heart from racing when I see you.
Allegedly truly rational people do not feel heartache but I know this is not true when my heart aches when I see you in pain.
Instead of spoken vows and oaths I will prove my love with my actions.
Do you require my assistance with anything?
A new stage has been unlocked. We must always be prepared for new challenges.
Thank you but I have no need for knickknacks that serves no purpose other than taking up space.
I'll take it thank you.
How incredible I've been inspired by this gift...
I would have stayed with my beloved if the world we live in was a truly peaceful one with no conflict.
With great power comes great responsibility.
My room is clean and neat? That's because I like working in an orderly environment.
There are other things on the agenda aside from work.

52020.text: Some have compared me to a bottle driftin' in the ocean. How am I s'pposed to know what that means when I've never even seen the ocean?
You're sayin' that you understand what I've been through? Hmph that's what you think.
I do like travelin'. The further away the destination is the better.
Oh no I have to fight again...?
Why are you lookin' at me like that? Wait how long have you been waitin' here?
Would you like to see me dance?
I feel as light as a feather. I can perform more beautiful dances like this...
You're not goin' to ask me to pay for this outfit later are you?
I won. Can I leave now?
You're not disappointed in me because I lost right...?
Oh I'm not afraid of trusting others but I am scared of betrayals... Will you assuage my fears?
You want to know more about my past? Can you promise not to leave me after hearin' my story?
I thought I would no longer be fazed by praise but a compliment from you always makes me overjoyed. It feels like I've been complimented for the first time...
When I look into your eyes I know that I will never regret comin' to this Academy.
Please don't leave me alone as the others have... Is this too much to ask?
Where do you think you're goin' leaving me here like this?
Somethin' troublesome is comin' up again...
Just leave it there...
I've received somethin' like this before but I don't mind havin' another one.
Did you prepare this for me? Hmm... You care quite a lot about me don't you?
Ah you're... Uhh it's on the tip of my tongue...
I'm already quite popular. If my popularity grows any more my fans might cause traffic jams.
A dancer's stage shouldn't be in her own dorm room...
It seems like I have to try and get things done by myself again...

757003.text: Don't touch that button! It's not time to turn the camera off yet.
This is my second camera. Oh where did I get it? Erm...
Yes exactly like that! Stop squirming I want to film this scene perfectly...
Ready to start shooting anytime!
So you want to be in my movie? Awesome! As the Director I wholeheartedly agree!
O Sagittarius may your blessings last for eternity!
No one can hurt me now!
It's time to get a better camera!
I offer this breathtaking scene to the stars!
Hm shooting a scene without a script is just asking for trouble...
Why don't you join me in making this movie Senpai? This story wouldn't make sense without you!
You want to learn more about me you say? Then you should watch all of my movies!
I can't and don't really want to separate dreams from reality. Is it that important?
I feel a mysterious connection when I gaze upon the stars. It's the only time when I feel I'm not alone...
No no no I am nowhere close to the strong person you believe me to be. If the stars leave me one day... I want you to be there with me.
Please don't leave me alone... I'm begging you...
I finished writing the new screenplay!
This brings up unpleasant memories...
Oooh this would work nicely as a prop for my new movie!
Ah so you knew that I liked this! I'll treasure this for my whole life!
I'm going location scouting today. Why don't you come with me?
Reality can be cruel to the weak. That's why those tragedies happened to me in the past...
I'm sorry my room is filled with screenplay and storyboard drafts...
Come on Senpai! You don't get to shoot something like this every day!

56011.text: What? The Lord of the Seas is stern harsh and unforgiving? This is slander I tell you slander!
Me? I'm no genius. I keep things in the sea in order with my muscles not my brain.
I can't control how others feel about me can I? So there's nothing that I can do if someone doesn't like me.
Time to show everyone what my trusty trident is capable of!
Would you like to surf with me?
Don't worry leave it to me! I'm not that unreliable!
The sharks and the dolphins will be glad too~
Oooh this is nice. Is this thing water-proof?
Hurray! This is what happens when the entire ocean is on your side!
It's kinda embarrassing for the all-powerful Lord of the Seas to lose against little shrimps… I demand a rematch!
If you want to get on my good side you might want to sweeten up to my sharks and dolphins. I value their happiness more than my own!
Wouldn't you be sad if your loved ones despise you?
I don't want to be seen as a threat… Especially not by family.
I am always eager to protect everyone. After all I treasure the relationships I share with everyone!
My true feelings? Hold my hand Senpai and my blush will tell you everything.
(Yawns) When will my chance to shine come?
Take on the new challenge with me!
Are you sure this isn't just something that's sitting around in your room? It's covered with dust!
Huh I don't think this is water-proof…I can take it but I won't be responsible if it breaks!
Whoa this is awesome! I bet the dolphins and the sharks would love it!
I haven't seen you in a while. When is our next battle? My trident is thirsty for blood!
Look even my trident is shinier now!
Aren't you going to keep me company? Oh right unlike me you're very busy.
Hey let's go try something new together! Don't worry I won't mess it up with my clumsiness!

55013.text: Why do I constantly make concessions for Zeusia you ask? It has become some sort of habit for me. She could be quite a handful if her wishes were gone against.
The last time I took a rest was… approximately three centuries ago I believe. Since the Incident the Underworld has been in a state of unrest and my workload has grown exponentially.
Deities can survive without sleep yet we are not exempt from exhaustion. Hence my need for stimulating drinks.
Additional work is it? Let us bring it to a swift conclusion.
I am Hadea the Lord of the Underworld. I will be providing my assistance until this issue with Chaos is resolved.
Ashes to ashes dust to dust.
This drink tastes... stimulating.
Its design is decent. I have a helmet that grants invisibility when equipped; I shall show it to you next time.
As expected.
It is not your time to pass on yet.
While I have offered my assistance I am often busy with work. Please refrain from bothering me with such trivialities.
Well done. Your efforts have not gone unnoticed and I feel reassured that I have made the right choice in offering my aid.
You seem exhausted; a brief repose will do you some good. I will take care of the rest.
Your competence has surpassed my expectations. Would you consider working for me in the Underworld?
An Oath is not necessary for us; all living creatures eventually arrive at the Underworld and you are no exception. One day you will become mine.
I do not require sleep to function and can use this time to tend to my administrative duties to the Underworld.
How shall I complete this new task with utmost efficiency?
Take it back.
Leave it there. I will choose an appropriate gift for you when I have the time.
This would be of great assistance in dispelling sleepiness. It is very considerate of you.
As you can see I am working.
In principle I should not interfere too much with the matters of the living. However due to the irregularity of the issue with Chaos I am permitted to use more power.
All I need is a table and a chair. Having the bed in my room would be quite a waste.
You have a new task and should proceed with it.

56012.text: Such an act of disrespect towards the Ruler of Gods would have warranted severe punishment in the past... But you will be forgiven this time as I am not the Ruler of Gods now.
Which disciple do I favor the most you ask? Why it is you my dear.

I would like to clear up some misunderstandings about me that you seem to have: I never cajoled these people into becoming my disciples and offering me everything they have. They chose to do so out of their own free will.
Offer me your undying faith!
I am Zeusia the Ruler of Gods. Are you prepared to bow down at my feet?
Witness the might of the Ruler of Gods!
The taste of this is... not bad not bad at all! I would not be averse to more offerings like these oh dear disciple of mine.
Have you any idea where Promethea might have hidden my sword the Reign of Heavens?
I shall reclaim the throne one day!
Argh! I will not be defeated by these...
Hello there. Why don't you invite me to dance?
What is the relationship I share with them? You should focus on me and me only when we are together dear.
I make no promises but I want you to know that you hold a special place in my heart.
You wish to be my sole disciple? A laughable proposal. However I may consider it if you agree to some terms of mine.
I gave up on the faith of countless others in exchange for this union between us. Are you aware of the gravity of the situation? I hope what you have to offer is enough to make it up to me.
Ah how should I pass the time? Perhaps I should work on converting another attractive individual to be my disciple...
A new enemy has appeared but I doubt I will need to concern myself with it. You will take care of it won't you?
You fail as my disciple if you believe such subpar offerings are fitting for me.
Not bad; I will accept it.
Ah... What kind of reward did you hope to receive from me when you offered this?
It's been a while since you last visited me. Are you playing hard to get?
Ahh more faith powers...
This room is too shabby. Shouldn't you find me one with higher quality?
Go my dear earn more Coins so you can prepare more offerings for me.

55014.text: Can our identities stay unchanged? ... Have you heard of the Ship of Theseus Senpai? We are like those ships constantly changing in the flow of time...
Stay strong Senpai! Only the resilient can survive!
What? Did you miss me? Hee hee I'm glad to know that I'm constantly on your mind~
Nobody hides their true strength in battle right? At least I don't! I'd never do something like that!
Who told you that I like to test human nature? I would never do such a terrible thing!
It seems like sunlight isn't the only thing that invigorates me... Moonlight does so too.
I can't wait to grow up so I can protect those who I love!
The sun's power flows into me through this...
A victory? But of course!
You mustn't be discouraged by this defeat!
You wish to understand who I am...? I wouldn't do that if I were you; you probably won't be able to face the truth.
I've been told that I am like the void: nothing happens no matter how much affection they give me. Does that scare you?
Love... I don't know. I guess it is as complicated as it sounds...
I... I don't know how to react to the love and care you've shown me and I can't make empty promises. What I can say is that you hold a special place in my heart.
To love and be loved in return... I am scared by this concept but... Senpai I can trust you right?
I'm so bored that I might start doing something weird!
I can't wait to test the sun's powers in the new challenge~
What is this? I've never seen anything like this before. Let's give it to the dogs instead!
This looks expensive. You're not expecting me to gift you something with a similar value in return are you? If you are then I don't think I should take this...
This is adorable! Thank you I'll take good care of it. I will place it on the windowsill where it will accompany me from night to day. It will be as if you were there with me the whole time!
Wow it's been such a long time! If you don't visit me as soon as the sun rises next time I will be very sad...
Are the strong definitely more popular than the weak?
How long will you stay with me...? Can you stay until I fall asleep?
If you give up halfway through you're going to lose half of your attractiveness Senpai~
